					v120 = v_u_100.FloorMaterial
					if v120 == Enum.Material.Air then
						v120 = workspace:Raycast(v_u_101.Position - v_u_101.CFrame.UpVector * 2, -v_u_101.CFrame.UpVector * 2, p_u_98.values.ray_params)
						if v120 then
							v120 = v120.Material
						end
					end
				end
				v_u_26[v112](p_u_98.instance.legs, v115, v120)
				p_u_98.values.rustling:set_value((math.pow(v115, 4)))
				return
			end
		else
			v113.base(v_u_102, v114)
			if p_u_98.states.climbing:get() > 1 then
				v113.base(v_u_103, v114)
				v113.base(v_u_104, v114, true)
			else
				v113.arm0(v_u_103, v114)
				v113.arm0(v_u_104, v114, true)
			end
			if math.random(1, 2) == 1 then
				v113.leg01(v_u_105, v114)
				v113.leg02(v_u_106, v114, true)
			else
				v113.leg02(v_u_105, v114)
				v113.leg01(v_u_106, v114, true)
			end
			v113.base(v_u_107, v114)
		end
	end)
	p_u_98.values.last_move = Vector3.new()
	p_u_98.values.walk_time = v_u_2.new(0)
	p_u_98.values.walk_time:hook(function(p121, p122)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_44, (copy) p_u_98
		if 0.2 / v_u_44(p_u_98) <= p121 then
			p_u_98.values.walk_time.value = 0
		elseif p122 == 0 then
			p_u_98.values.key:update(function(p123)
				return p123 >= 4 and 1 or p123 + 1
			end)
		end
	end)
	p_u_98.values.walking:hook(function(p124)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_98
		if not p124 then
			p_u_98.values.walk_time.value = 0
			p_u_98.values.key.value = math.random(1, 2) == 1 and 2 or 4
			p_u_98.values.key:update()
		end
	end)
end

function setup_running(p_u_136) -- name: setup_running
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_28, (copy) v_u_26, (copy) v_u_27
	local v_u_137 = p_u_136.values.cframes
	local v138 = p_u_136.values.viewmodels
	local v_u_139 = p_u_136.instance.Humanoid
	local v_u_140 = CFrame.new(1.125, v138.torso.Size.Y * 0.5, 0)
	v_u_137:get("arm1"):create_pivot("running", function(p141)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_137, (copy) p_u_136, (copy) v_u_140
		return v_u_137:get("torso"):render(p141) * p_u_136.values.cframes:get("arms"):render(p141) * v_u_140
	end)
	local v_u_142 = CFrame.new(-1.125, v138.torso.Size.Y * 0.5, 0)
	v_u_137:get("arm2"):create_pivot("running", function(p143)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_137, (copy) p_u_136, (copy) v_u_142
		return v_u_137:get("torso"):render(p143) * p_u_136.values.cframes:get("arms"):render(p143) * v_u_142
	end)
	v_u_137:get("arms"):create_pivot("running", function(p144)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_137, (copy) p_u_136
		local v145, _, _ = v_u_137:get("head"):render(p144):ToOrientation()
		if p_u_136.values.camera:get() and p144 then
			return CFrame.new(0, 0, -v145 * 1) * CFrame.Angles(v145 * 0.5, 0, 0)
		else
			return CFrame.new(0, 0, 0.5) * CFrame.Angles(-0.5 + v145 * 0.1, 0, 0)
		end
	end)
	local v_u_146 = p_u_136.values.cframes:get("arms"):create_offset("run")
	local v_u_147 = v_u_137:get("arms"):set_offset("brake")
	local v_u_149 = v_u_7.ov(function(p148)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_136, (ref) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_146
		if p148 then
			p_u_136.values.cframes:get("arms"):set_offset("run")
		else
			v_u_7.tween(v_u_146, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, 0, false, 0), {
				["Value"] = CFrame.new()
			}).Completed:Wait()
			p_u_136.values.cframes:get("arms"):remove_offset("run")
		end
	end)
	p_u_136.values.move_diff = v_u_2.new(0)
	p_u_136.states.running:hook(function(p150, p151)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_149, (copy) p_u_136, (ref) v_u_28, (copy) v_u_139, (ref) v_u_26, (ref) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_147
		if p150 then
			v_u_149(true)
			if not p_u_136.values.equip_debounce:get() then
				local v152 = p_u_136.values.equipped
				local v153 = p_u_136.values.holding
				if v153 and (v153.running_state and v153.instance:GetAttribute("item_type") >= 0) then
					v153.running_state:set(true)
				elseif v152 and v152.running_state then
					v152.running_state:set(true)
				end
			end
			p_u_136.states.lean:set(0)
			p_u_136.states.walking:set(false)
			if p_u_136.states.walk_state:get() == "stand" then
				p_u_136.values.key:update()
			else
				p_u_136.states.walk_state:set("stand")
			end
		else
			if p151 then
				v_u_149(false)
				if p_u_136.values.move_diff:get() > 60 and (not p_u_136.values.falling:get() and (p_u_136.states.vault:get() == 0 and table.find(v_u_28, v_u_139.FloorMaterial))) then
					v_u_26.Squeak(p_u_136.instance.legs)
					task.spawn(function()
						-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_27, (ref) v_u_147
						v_u_27.Movement.brake_arms(v_u_147).Completed:Wait()
						v_u_27.Movement.base(v_u_147)
					end)
				end
				p_u_136.values.key:update()
			end
			return
		end
	end)
end
function prone_movement(p_u_154, p_u_155, p156) -- name: prone_movement
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_34
	local v_u_157 = p_u_154.values.cframes
	local _ = p_u_154.values.viewmodels
	local v_u_158 = v_u_157:get("arm2"):set_absolute("prone", true)
	task.spawn(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_157, (copy) p_u_155, (ref) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_158
		v_u_157:get("arm2"):set_pivot("base")
		if p_u_155 == -1 then
			v_u_27.Prone.arm2_start2(v_u_158).Completed:Wait()
		else
			v_u_27.Prone.arm2_start(v_u_158).Completed:Wait()
		end
		v_u_157:get("arm2"):remove_absolute("prone")
		v_u_157:get("arm2"):remove_pivot("base")
	end)
	if not p156 then
		local v_u_159 = v_u_157:get("leg1"):set_absolute("prone", true)
		local v_u_160 = v_u_157:get("leg2"):set_absolute("prone", true)
		task.spawn(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_155, (ref) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_159, (copy) v_u_157
			if p_u_155 == -1 then
				v_u_27.Prone.leg1_start(v_u_159).Completed:Wait()
			else
				v_u_27.Prone.leg1_start2(v_u_159).Completed:Wait()
			end
			v_u_157:get("leg1"):remove_absolute("prone")
		end)
		task.spawn(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_155, (ref) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_160, (copy) v_u_157
			if p_u_155 == -1 then
				v_u_27.Prone.leg2_start(v_u_160).Completed:Wait()
			else
				v_u_27.Prone.leg2_start2(v_u_160).Completed:Wait()
			end
			v_u_157:get("leg2"):remove_absolute("prone")
		end)
	end
	task.spawn(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_154, (ref) v_u_34
		p_u_154.instance.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = v_u_34(p_u_154) * 0.5
		p_u_154.values.prone_debounce = true
		task.wait(0.4)
		p_u_154.values.prone_debounce = false
		p_u_154.values.key:update()
	end)
	if p_u_155 == -1 then
		p_u_154.values.fov:set(40)
	else
		p_u_154.values.fov:set(80)
	end
end
function setup_walk_states(p_u_161) -- name: setup_walk_states
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_26, (copy) v_u_27
	local v162 = p_u_161.values.cframes
	local v_u_163 = v162:get("camera_offset"):set_offset("walk_state")
	local v_u_164 = v162:get("arms"):set_offset("drop")
	p_u_161.values.drop_cframe = v_u_164
	local v165 = v162:get("torso"):set_offset("walk_direction")
	p_u_161.values.torso_cframe = v165
	local v_u_166 = v162:get("torso"):set_offset("walk_state")
	p_u_161.states.walk_state:hook(function(p167, p168)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_26, (copy) p_u_161, (ref) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_163, (copy) v_u_166, (copy) v_u_164
		if p167 == "prone" or p168 == "prone" then
			v_u_26.ClothHeavy(p_u_161.values.viewmodels.torso)
		else
			v_u_26.Cloth(p_u_161.values.viewmodels.torso)
		end
		local v169 = p_u_161.values.equipped
		if v169 and v169.walk_state then
			task.spawn(v169.walk_state, v169, p_u_161, p167, p168)
		end
		if p167 == "crouch" then
			p_u_161.values.key:update()
			if p168 == "prone" then
				v_u_27.Movement.crouch_slow(v_u_163)
				v_u_27.Movement.crouch_torso_slow(v_u_166)
				prone_movement(p_u_161, 1, true)
				v_u_27.Movement.rise(v_u_164).Completed:Wait()
				v_u_27.Movement.drop(v_u_164)
			else
				v_u_27.Movement.crouch(v_u_163)
				v_u_27.Movement.crouch_torso(v_u_166)
			end
		else
			if p167 == "prone" then
				v_u_27.Movement.prone(v_u_163)
				v_u_27.Movement.prone_torso_down(v_u_166)
				if p168 == "crouch" or p168 == "stand" then
					prone_movement(p_u_161, -1)
					v_u_27.Movement.down(v_u_164).Completed:Wait()
					v_u_27.Movement.drop(v_u_164)
					return
				end
			elseif p167 == "stand" then
				if p168 == "prone" then
					v_u_27.Movement.base_slow(v_u_163)
					v_u_27.Movement.base_slow(v_u_166)
					prone_movement(p_u_161, 1)
					v_u_27.Movement.rise(v_u_164).Completed:Wait()
					v_u_27.Movement.rise2(v_u_164)
					return
				end
				p_u_161.values.key:update()
				v_u_27.Movement.base(v_u_163)
				v_u_27.Movement.base(v_u_166)
			end
			return
		end
	end)
end
function setup_interacting(p_u_170) -- name: setup_interacting
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_26, (copy) v_u_27

	local v_u_173 = script.AlignOrientation:Clone()

				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_171

			local v185 = Vector3.new(v183, 0, v184)

			local v192 = CFrame.Angles(v191, 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(2.2689280275926285, 0, -0.17453292519943295)

				["Value"] = CFrame.new(0.2, 0, 0.3) * CFrame.Angles(v191, 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(1.0471975511965976, 0, -0.3490658503988659)

			local v195 = CFrame.Angles(v194, 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(2.2689280275926285, 0, 0.17453292519943295)

				["Value"] = CFrame.new(-0.2, 0, 0.3) * CFrame.Angles(v194, 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(1.0471975511965976, 0, 0.3490658503988659)

				["Value"] = v195
			}, v196).Completed:Wait()
		else
			v_u_171:get("arm2"):set_pivot("interact", function(p197)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_171
				return v_u_171:get("torso"):render(p197) * CFrame.new(-1.125, 1, 0)
			end)
			local v198 = v_u_171:get("arm2"):set_absolute("interact", true)
			local v199 = v177.head.Position.X
			local v200 = v177.head.Position.Z
			local v201 = Vector3.new(v199, 0, v200)
			local v202 = v175.Position.X
			local v203 = v175.Position.Z
			local v204 = Vector3.new(v202, 0, v203)
			local v205 = CFrame.lookAt(v201, v204)
			local v206 = (v177.head.Position - v175.Position).Magnitude - 2
			v_u_172.Position = v_u_172.Position + v205.LookVector * v206
			v_u_173.CFrame = v205.Rotation
			local v207, _, _ = CFrame.lookAt(v177.arm2:GetPivot().Position, v175.Position):ToOrientation()
			local v208 = CFrame.Angles(v207, 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(1.9198621771937625, 0, 0.17453292519943295)
			local v209 = {
				["Value"] = CFrame.new(-0.3, 0, 0.3) * CFrame.Angles(v207, 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(1.2217304763960306, 0, 0.6981317007977318)
			}
			v_u_7.quad_tween(v198, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine), {
				["Value"] = v208
			}, v209).Completed:Wait()
		end
	end)
	local function v_u_211()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_172, (copy) v_u_173, (copy) v_u_171
		v_u_172.Parent = nil
		v_u_173.Parent = nil
		v_u_171:get("torso"):remove_pivot("lock")
		v_u_171:get("arm1"):remove_pivot("interact")
		v_u_171:get("arm2"):remove_pivot("interact")
		v_u_171:get("arm1"):remove_absolute("interact")
		v_u_171:get("arm2"):remove_absolute("interact")
		v_u_171:get("torso"):remove_absolute("interact")
	end
	v_u_210:cancelled(function(...)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_211, (copy) p_u_170
		v_u_211(...)
		p_u_170.states.interact:set(nil)
		p_u_170.values.requip_items()
	end)
	v_u_210:done(function(...)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_211, (copy) p_u_170
		v_u_211(...)
		p_u_170.values.requip_items()
	end)
	p_u_170.states.interact:hook(function(p212, p213)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_210
		if p212 then
			v_u_210(p212)
		elseif not p213 then
			v_u_210:cancel()
		end
	end)
end

function setup_body_parts(p_u_216) -- name: setup_body_parts
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_2

	local v_u_218 = p_u_216.values.viewmodels

	local v_u_220 = v_u_219.CFrame
	local v_u_221 = v_u_16.new(1, 0.1)
	function p_u_216.values.third_person_torso(p222)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_217, (copy) v_u_219, (ref) v_u_220, (ref) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_221, (copy) v_u_218
		local v223 = v_u_217:get("camera"):render(p222)
		local _, v224, v225 = v223:ToOrientation()
		local v226 = CFrame.new(v223.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, v224, v225)
		if v_u_219.Anchored or p222 == nil then
			v_u_220 = v_u_219.CFrame
		else
			local v227 = v_u_219:GetAttribute("Position")
			if v227 == nil or (v_u_219.Position - v227).Magnitude < 8 then
				v_u_220 = v_u_7.frame_lerp(v_u_220, v_u_219.CFrame, v_u_221:get(), p222)
				v_u_221:set(1)
			else
				v_u_221.value = 0.1
				v_u_221.target = 0.1
				v_u_220 = v_u_7.frame_lerp(v_u_220, CFrame.new(v227) * v_u_219.CFrame.Rotation, v_u_221:get(), p222)
			end
		end
		return v_u_220 * CFrame.new(0, -1.35 + v_u_218.torso.Size.Y * 0.5 + 0.475, 0.1) * v_u_217:get("camera_offset"):render(p222) * v226
	end

	local v_u_270 = CFrame.new(0.375, 0, 0)
	local v_u_271 = CFrame.new(-0.375, 0, 0)
	local v_u_272 = CFrame.new(0, -v_u_218.torso.Size.Y * 0.5, 0)
	v_u_217:get("hip1", true):set_pivot("base", function(p273)

		local v274 = v_u_217:get("leg1"):render(p273)

		local v276, _, _ = v_u_217:get("torso"):render(p273):ToOrientation()
		local v277 = (v_u_217:get("torso"):render(p273) * v_u_272 * v_u_270 * CFrame.fromOrientation(-v276 * 1.1, 0, 0) * v_u_217:get("camera"):get_offset("reverse").Value).Position
		local v278 = v_u_7.adjust_reach(v277, v275, v_u_218.hip1.Size.Z)
		return v_u_7.look_at_with_stable_roll(v278, v275, v274.LookVector, v274.RightVector)

	v_u_217:get("hip2", true):set_pivot("base", function(p279)

		local v281 = (v280 * CFrame.new(0, -v_u_218.leg2.Size.Y, 0)).Position
		local v282, _, _ = v_u_217:get("torso"):render(p279):ToOrientation()

			local v309 = 0.1 / (os.clock() - v_u_303) * 0.1
			v308.t = math.clamp(v309, 0.1, 0.3)
			v_u_303 = os.clock()

function setup_climbing(p_u_316) -- name: setup_climbing
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_7
	local _ = p_u_316.instance
	local v_u_317 = p_u_316.values.cframes
	local v_u_318 = v_u_317:get("camera"):set_offset("reverse")
	p_u_316.values.reverse_negative = v_u_16.new(1, 0.1)
	p_u_316.values.reversed = v_u_2.new(false)
	p_u_316.values.reversed:hook(function(p319)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_318, (copy) p_u_316
		if p319 then
			v_u_7.tween(v_u_318, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {
				["Value"] = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 3.141592653589793)
			})
			p_u_316.values.reverse_negative:set(-1)
		else
			v_u_7.tween(v_u_318, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {
				["Value"] = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0)
			})
			p_u_316.values.reverse_negative:set(1)
		end
	end)
	p_u_316.states.climbing:hook(function(p320, p321)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_316, (copy) v_u_317
		if p320 == p321 then
			return
		else
			if p320 == 3 then
				p_u_316.values.reversed:set(true)
			elseif p321 == 3 then
				p_u_316.values.reversed:set(false)
			end
			if p320 == 1 and p321 == 0 then
				v_u_317:get("torso"):set_pivot("lock")
			elseif p320 == 0 and p321 == 1 then
				v_u_317:get("torso"):remove_pivot("lock")
			end
			if p320 > 0 and p321 == 0 then
				p_u_316.states.lean:set(0)
				p_u_316.states.walk_state:set("stand")
				p_u_316.values.key:update()
			elseif p320 == 0 and p321 > 0 then
				p_u_316.values.key:update()
			end
		end
	end)
end
function setup_vaulting(p_u_322) -- name: setup_vaulting
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_26
	local v_u_323 = p_u_322.values.cframes
	local v_u_324 = p_u_322.instance
	p_u_322.states.vault:hook(function(p_u_325)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_322, (copy) v_u_323, (ref) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_324, (ref) v_u_26
		local v326 = p_u_322.values.equipped
		if v326 and v326.vault then
			task.spawn(v326.vault, v326, p_u_322, p_u_325)
		end
		if p_u_325 > 0 then
			local v_u_327 = v_u_323:get("torso"):set_offset("vault")
			local v_u_328 = v_u_323:get("leg1"):set_absolute("vault", true)
			local v_u_329 = v_u_323:get("leg2"):set_absolute("vault", true)
			local v330 = v_u_323:get("camera"):set_offset("vault")
			task.spawn(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_322, (ref) v_u_323, (ref) v_u_27
				if p_u_322.values.holding and p_u_322.values.holding.instance:GetAttribute("item_type") >= 0 then
					local v331 = v_u_323:get("arm2"):set_offset("vault")
					v_u_27.Vault.arm1_start(v331).Completed:Wait()
					v_u_27.Vault.base(v331).Completed:Wait()
					v_u_323:get("arm2"):remove_offset("vault")
				else
					local v332 = v_u_323:get("arm2"):set_absolute("vault", true)
					v_u_323:get("arm2"):set_pivot("base")
					v_u_27.Vault.arm2_start(v332).Completed:Wait()
					v_u_27.Vault.arm2_vault(v332).Completed:Wait()
					v_u_27.Vault.base(v332).Completed:Wait()
					v_u_323:get("arm2"):remove_absolute("vault")
					v_u_323:get("arm2"):remove_pivot("base")
				end
			end)
			task.spawn(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_323, (ref) v_u_27
				local v333 = v_u_323:get("arm1"):set_offset("vault")
				v_u_27.Vault.arm1_start(v333).Completed:Wait()
				v_u_27.Vault.base(v333).Completed:Wait()
				v_u_323:get("arm1"):remove_offset("vault")
			end)
			task.spawn(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_27, (copy) p_u_325, (copy) v_u_328, (ref) v_u_323
				v_u_27.Vault[p_u_325 == 1 and "leg1_start" or "leg1_start_over"](v_u_328).Completed:Wait()
				v_u_323:get("leg1"):remove_absolute("vault")
			end)
			task.spawn(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_27, (copy) p_u_325, (copy) v_u_329, (ref) v_u_323
				v_u_27.Vault[p_u_325 == 1 and "leg2_start" or "leg2_start_over"](v_u_329).Completed:Wait()
				v_u_323:get("leg2"):remove_absolute("vault")
			end)
			task.spawn(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_27, (copy) p_u_325, (copy) v_u_327, (ref) v_u_323
				v_u_27.Vault[p_u_325 == 1 and "torso1" or "torso2"](v_u_327).Completed:Wait()
				v_u_27.Vault.base(v_u_327).Completed:Wait()
				v_u_323:get("torso"):remove_offset("vault")
			end)
			v_u_324.collision.CollisionGroup = "char_anim"
			v_u_323:get("torso"):set_pivot("lock")
			p_u_322.states.lean:set(0)
			v_u_26.Vault(p_u_322.values.viewmodels.torso)
			v_u_26.Tap(p_u_322.values.viewmodels.torso)
			v_u_27.Vault.vault_camera(v330).Completed:Wait()
			v_u_27.Vault.base_vault(v330).Completed:Wait()
			v_u_323:get("camera"):remove_offset("vault")
		else
			v_u_324.collision.CollisionGroup = "char"
			v_u_323:get("torso"):remove_pivot("lock")
		end
	end)
end
function setup_falling(p334) -- name: setup_falling
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_26
	local v_u_335 = p334.values.cframes:get("arms"):set_offset("drop")
	p334.values.drop_cframe = v_u_335
	p334.values.falling = v_u_2.dependency({ p334.values.hum_state, p334.states.vault, p334.states.climbing }, function(p336, p337, p338)
		local v339
		if p336 == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall and p337 == 0 then
			v339 = p338 == 0
		else
			v339 = false
		end
		return v339
	end)
	local v_u_340 = p334.instance:WaitForChild("legs")
	local v_u_341 = 0
	p334.values.falling:hook(function(p342, p343)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_335, (ref) v_u_341, (ref) v_u_26, (copy) v_u_340
		if p342 then
			v_u_27.Fall.fall(v_u_335)
		elseif p343 then
			if os.clock() - v_u_341 >= 0.1 then
				v_u_26.Land(v_u_340)
			end
			v_u_27.Fall.drop(v_u_335)
		end
		v_u_341 = os.clock()
	end)
end

function setup_equipping(p_u_393) -- name: setup_equipping
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_7
	p_u_393.owner:get()
	local v394 = p_u_393.values.Items:WaitForChild("Hands")
	p_u_393.values.hands = v394
	local v395 = v_u_4.get_item(v394)
	p_u_393.values.hands_item = v395
	local v_u_396 = v_u_2.new(false)
	local v_u_397 = v_u_2.new(false)
	p_u_393.values.db1 = v_u_396
	p_u_393.values.equip_debounce = v_u_2.dependency({ v_u_396, v_u_397 }, function(p398, p399)
		return p398 or p399
	end)
	p_u_393.values.equip_debounce:hook(function(p400)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_393
		if p400 then
			p_u_393.states.running:set(false)
		else
			p_u_393.states.running:update()
		end
	end)
	p_u_393.values.last_equipped = p_u_393.values.hands
	local v_u_405 = v_u_7.ov(function(p_u_401)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_396, (copy) p_u_393, (copy) v_u_397, (ref) v_u_4
		while v_u_396:get() do
			v_u_396:wait()
		end
		task.spawn(function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_396, (ref) p_u_393, (copy) p_u_401, (ref) v_u_397, (ref) v_u_4
			v_u_396:set(true)
			local v402 = p_u_393.states.holding:get()
			if v402 and (p_u_401 and v402:GetAttribute("item_type") + p_u_401:GetAttribute("item_type") > 3) then
				p_u_393.states.holding:set(p_u_393.values.hands, true)
				while v_u_397:get() do
					v_u_397:wait()
				end
			end
			local v403 = p_u_393.values.equipped
			if v403 then
				if v403.running_state then
					v403.running_state:set(false)
				end
				v403:equip(p_u_393, false)
				p_u_393.values.equipped = nil
				v403.unequip_stamp = os.clock()
			end
			if p_u_401 then
				local v404 = v_u_4.get_item(p_u_401)
				p_u_393.values.equipped = v404
				v404:equip(p_u_393, true)
			else
				p_u_393.values.equipped = nil
			end
			v_u_396:set(false)
		end)
	end)
	p_u_393.states.equipped:hook(function(p406)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_405
		v_u_405(p406)
	end)
	p_u_393.values.last_holding = p_u_393.values.hands
	local v_u_411 = v_u_7.ov(function(p_u_407)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_397, (copy) p_u_393, (ref) v_u_4
		while v_u_397:get() do
			v_u_397:wait()
		end
		task.spawn(function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_397, (ref) p_u_393, (copy) p_u_407, (ref) v_u_4
			v_u_397:set(true)
			local v408 = p_u_393.states.equipped:get()
			if v408 and (p_u_407 and v408:GetAttribute("item_type") + p_u_407:GetAttribute("item_type") > 3) then
				p_u_393.states.equipped:set(p_u_393.values.hands, true)
			end
			local v409 = p_u_393.values.holding
			if v409 then
				if v409.running_state then
					v409.running_state:set(false)
				end
				v409:equip(p_u_393, false)
				p_u_393.values.holding = nil
				v409.unequip_stamp = os.clock()
			end
			if p_u_407 then
				local v410 = v_u_4.get_item(p_u_407)
				p_u_393.values.holding = v410
				v410:equip(p_u_393, true)
			else
				p_u_393.values.holding = nil
			end
			v_u_397:set(false)
		end)
	end)
	p_u_393.states.holding:hook(function(p412)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_411
		v_u_411(p412)
	end)
	p_u_393.clean:hook(function(p413)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_405, (copy) v_u_411
		if p413 then
			v_u_405:cancel()
			v_u_411:cancel()
		end
	end)
	v_u_7.hook_first_child(p_u_393.values.Items, "Phone", function(p414)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_393
		p_u_393.values.phone = p414
	end)
	function p_u_393.values.requip_items() end
end

	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_4

	v_u_7.hook_child_added(v_u_416, function(p_u_417)

		task.defer(function()

			p_u_415.values.items:add(v418)
		end)
	end)
	p_u_415.values.items:on_add(function(p_u_419)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_415, (ref) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_416
		local v_u_420 = p_u_419.instance
		p_u_415.values.items:attach_connection(p_u_419, v_u_7.watch_parent(v_u_420, function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_420, (ref) v_u_416, (ref) p_u_415, (copy) p_u_419
			if v_u_420.Parent ~= v_u_416 and not v_u_420:IsDescendantOf(p_u_415.values.viewmodels) then
				p_u_415.values.items:remove(p_u_419)
			end
		end))
	end)
end
function setup_attire(p_u_421) -- name: setup_attire
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_19, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_7
	p_u_421.states.skin_color:hook(function(p422)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_421, (ref) v_u_19
		for _, v423 in p_u_421.values.viewmodels:GetChildren() do
			if not v423:IsA("BasePart") or v423.Transparency ~= 0 then
				continue
			end
			v423.Color = v_u_19.skin_colors[p422].color
		end
	end)
	p_u_421.states.hat:hook(function(p424)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_4, (copy) p_u_421, (ref) v_u_7
		if p424 ~= "" then
			for _, v425 in string.split(p424, ",") do
				local v_u_426 = v_u_4.get_item_class(v425):apply({
					["character"] = p_u_421.values.viewmodels
				})
				v_u_426.Destroying:Connect(p_u_421.values.camera:hook(function(p427, _)
					-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_426
					if p427 then
						for _, v428 in v_u_426:GetDescendants() do
							if v428:IsA("BasePart") then
								if v428:GetAttribute("OriginalTransparency") == nil then
									v428:SetAttribute("OriginalTransparency", v428.Transparency)
								end
								v428.Transparency = 1
							elseif v428:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
								v428.Enabled = false
							else
								if not v428:IsA("Light") then
									continue
								end
								if v428:GetAttribute("OriginalBrightness") == nil then
									v428:SetAttribute("OriginalBrightness", v428.Brightness)
								end
								v428.Brightness = 0
							end
						end
					else
						for _, v429 in v_u_426:GetDescendants() do
							if v429:IsA("BasePart") then
								if not v429:GetAttribute("OriginalTransparency") then
									continue
								end
								v429.Transparency = v429:GetAttribute("OriginalTransparency")
							elseif v429:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
								v429.Enabled = true
							else
								if not (v429:IsA("Light") and v429:GetAttribute("OriginalBrightness")) then
									continue
								end
								v429.Brightness = v429:GetAttribute("OriginalBrightness")
							end
						end
					end
				end).unhook)
				local v_u_430 = v_u_426:GetScale()
				local v_u_432 = v_u_7.watch_property(p_u_421.values.viewmodels.head, "Size", function(p431)
					-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_426, (copy) v_u_430
					v_u_426:ScaleTo(v_u_430 * p431.Y)
				end)
				v_u_426.Destroying:Connect(function()
					-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_432
					v_u_432:Disconnect()
				end)
			end
			if p_u_421.values.camera:get() then
				p_u_421.values.viewmodels.head.Transparency = 0
			end
		end
	end)
	p_u_421.states.outfit:hook(function(p433)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_4, (copy) p_u_421
		if p433 ~= "" then
			v_u_4.get_item_class(p433):apply({
				["character"] = p_u_421.values.viewmodels
			})
		end
	end)
end
function setup_flashed(p_u_434) -- name: setup_flashed
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_22, (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_25
	local v_u_435 = p_u_434.values.cframes
	local v_u_438 = v_u_7.ov(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_22, (ref) v_u_7, (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_21
		task.spawn(function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_22, (ref) v_u_7
			local v436 = v_u_22.add_ear_muffle()
			v436.Value = -80
			task.wait(1.5)
			v_u_7.tween(v436, TweenInfo.new(3.5), {
				["Value"] = 0
			}).Completed:Wait()
			v_u_22.remove_ear_muffle(v436)
		end)
		v_u_17.Flash(game.Workspace.CurrentCamera)
		local v437 = v_u_21.get("Flash")
		v_u_7.tween(v437.Frame, TweenInfo.new(0), {
			["BackgroundTransparency"] = 0
		})
		task.wait(1.5)
		v_u_7.tween(v437.Frame, TweenInfo.new(3.5), {
			["BackgroundTransparency"] = 1
		}).Completed:Wait()
	end)
	local v_u_440 = v_u_7.ov(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_435, (ref) v_u_27
		if v_u_435:get("arm2"):current_pivot() ~= "holding" then
			local v439 = v_u_435:get("arm2"):set_absolute("flashed", true)
			v_u_435:get("arm2"):set_pivot("base")
			v_u_27.Movement.ram1(v439)
			task.wait(1.5)
		end
	end)
	v_u_440:cancelled(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_435
		v_u_435:get("arm2"):remove_absolute("flashed")
		v_u_435:get("arm2"):remove_pivot("base")
	end)
	v_u_440:done(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_435
		v_u_435:get("arm2"):remove_absolute("flashed")
		v_u_435:get("arm2"):remove_pivot("base")
	end)
	local v_u_442 = v_u_7.ov(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_22, (ref) v_u_7, (ref) v_u_17
		task.spawn(function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_22, (ref) v_u_7
			local v441 = v_u_22.add_ear_muffle()
			v441.Value = -40
			task.wait(1)
			v_u_7.tween(v441, TweenInfo.new(3), {
				["Value"] = 0
			}).Completed:Wait()
			v_u_22.remove_ear_muffle(v441)
		end)
		v_u_17.Ringing(game.Workspace.CurrentCamera)
	end)
	p_u_434.states.effect:hook(function(p443)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_434, (ref) v_u_25, (copy) v_u_438, (copy) v_u_440, (copy) v_u_442, (ref) v_u_17
		if p443 == "flash" then
			if p_u_434.values.camera:get() == v_u_25 then
				v_u_438()
			end
			v_u_440()
		elseif p443 == "ringing" then
			if p_u_434.values.camera:get() == v_u_25 then
				v_u_442()
				return
			end
		elseif p443 == "electrified" then
			v_u_17.Electrified(p_u_434.values.viewmodels.torso)
		end
	end)
end
function ragdoll(p444) -- name: ragdoll
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_17
	if v_u_10.settings ~= nil and v_u_10.settings.character_ragdolls then
		local v445 = p444.values.viewmodels
		local v446 = p444.instance:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
		local v447 = v445:Clone()
		local v448 = nil
		for _, v449 in v447:GetChildren() do
			if not v449:IsA("Model") then
				continue
			end
			for _, v450 in v449:GetTags() do
				v449:RemoveTag(v450)
			end
			if v449.PrimaryPart then
				for _, v451 in v449:GetDescendants() do
					if v451:IsA("BasePart") then
						v451.CollisionGroup = "ragdoll"
						v451.CanCollide = true
						v451.CanQuery = false
						if not v451.Anchored then
							continue
						end
						v451.Anchored = false
						v_u_7.weld_c(v449.PrimaryPart, v451)
					else
						if not (v451:IsA("Light") or v451:IsA("Sound")) then
							continue
						end
						v451:Destroy()
					end
				end
				v449.Parent = game.Workspace
				v_u_17.mark_for_killcam(v449)
				v_u_7.debris(v449, 5)
				if not (v446 and v446:GetAttribute("LookImpulse")) then
					break
				end
				local v452 = v449.PrimaryPart.AssemblyMass * 2.5
				local v453 = v446:GetAttribute("LookImpulse")
				if not v453 then
					local v454 = math.random() * 2 - 1
					local v455 = math.random() * 2 - 1
					local v456 = math.random() * 2 - 1
					v453 = Vector3.new(v454, v455, v456)
				end
				v449.PrimaryPart:ApplyImpulse(v453 * 5 * v452)
			else
				for _, v457 in v449:GetChildren() do
					local v458 = v447:FindFirstChild(v457.Name)
					if not v458 then
						continue
					end
					v457.Parent = v458
					v_u_7.weld_c(v457.PrimaryPart, v458)
				end
			end
		end
		for _, v459 in v447:GetChildren() do
			if not v459:IsA("BasePart") or v459.Transparency == 1 and v459.Name ~= "head" then
				continue
			end
			for _, v460 in v459:GetDescendants() do
				if v460:IsA("Model") then
					for _, v461 in v460:GetTags() do
						v460:RemoveTag(v461)
					end
				elseif v460:IsA("BasePart") and v460.Anchored then
					v460.Anchored = false
					v_u_7.weld_c(v459, v460)
				elseif v460.Name == "RagdollConstraint" then
					v460.Enabled = true
				else
					if not (v460:IsA("Light") or v460:IsA("Sound")) then
						continue
					end
					v460:Destroy()
				end
			end
			v459.Parent = game.Workspace
			v_u_17.mark_for_killcam(v459)
			v459.Anchored = false
			v459.CanQuery = false
			v459.CanCollide = true
			v459.CollisionGroup = "ragdoll"
			v459.Transparency = v459:GetAttribute("OriginalTransparency") or 0
			v459.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			v_u_7.debris(v459, 5)
			if v459.Name == "torso" then
				v448 = v459
			else
				if v459.Name ~= "head" then
					break
				end
				for _, v462 in v459:GetChildren() do
					if not v462:IsA("BillboardGui") then
						continue
					end
					v462:Destroy()
				end
			end
		end
		if v446 and v446:GetAttribute("LookImpulse") then
			local v463 = v448.AssemblyMass * 5
			v448:ApplyImpulse(((v446:GetAttribute("LookImpulse") or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)) + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)) * 5 * v463)
		end
	end
end
function render_camera(p464, p465) -- name: render_camera
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7
	local v466 = p464.values.camera:get()
	local v467 = p464.instance.HumanoidRootPart
	local v468 = p464.values.viewmodels
	local v469
	if v466 == nil or v466.CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then
		local v470 = p464.states.look:get()
		local v471 = v470.X
		local v472 = v470.Z
		local v473 = Vector3.new(v471, 0, v472).Unit
		local v474 = v473.Magnitude
		if v474 == 0 or v474 ~= v474 then
			v473 = v467.CFrame.LookVector
		end
		v469 = CFrame.lookAt(v467.Position, v467.Position + v473)
	else
		v469 = nil
	end
	if v466 then
		local v475 = p464.instance.Humanoid
		local v476 = p464.values.cframes
		v475.CameraOffset = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) + v476:get("camera_offset"):render(p465).Position
		if v466.CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then
			local v477 = v467.Position
			local v478 = v468.torso.Size.Y * 0.5 + v468.head.Size.Y * 0.5 + 0.15
			local v479 = v477 + Vector3.new(0, v478, 0) - v467.CFrame.LookVector * 0.1 + v475.CameraOffset
			v466.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(v479, v479 + p464.values.look_ease:get())
		end
		local v480 = v_u_7.clamp_look_vector(v467.CFrame.LookVector, v466.CFrame.LookVector, p464.values.fov:get())
		v466.CFrame = CFrame.new(v466.CFrame.Position, v466.CFrame.Position + v480)
		local v481 = v476:get("camera"):render(p465)
		local v482, v483, v484 = v481:ToOrientation()
		if p464.values.reversed:get() then
			local v485 = -v483
			local v486 = -v484
			local v487 = -v481.Position
			v481 = CFrame.new(v487) * CFrame.fromOrientation(v482, -v485, -v486)
			v466.CFrame = v466.CFrame * p464.values.old_cam_render
			p464.values.old_cam_render = CFrame.fromOrientation(-v482, v485, 0)
		else
			v466.CFrame = v466.CFrame * p464.values.old_cam_render:Inverse()
			p464.values.old_cam_render = CFrame.fromOrientation(v482, v483, 0)
		end
		v466.CFrame = v466.CFrame * v481
		if v466.CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Custom then
			local v488 = v466.CFrame
			local v489 = v488.LookVector
			local v490 = v489.X
			local v491 = v489.Z
			local v492 = Vector3.new(v490, 0, v491).Unit
			v469 = CFrame.lookAt(v488.Position, v488.Position + v492)
		end
	end
	return v469
end

function render_collisions(p501, p502) -- name: render_collisions
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_24, (copy) v_u_7
	local v503 = p501.values.viewmodels
	local v504 = p501.values.cframes
	local v505 = p501.instance.HumanoidRootPart
	local v506 = p501.values.camera:get()
	if v_u_24.Character == p501.instance or p501.values.last_coll >= 0.1 then
		p501.values.last_coll = 0
		local v507 = p501.instance.collision
		local v508 = v507.JointMotor
		local v509, _, _ = v503.torso.CFrame:ToOrientation()
		local v510 = v504:get("camera_offset"):render(p502)
		local _, v511, _ = p501.values.torso_cframe.Value:ToOrientation()
		local _, _, v512 = v504:get("torso"):get_offset("lean").Value:ToOrientation()
		local v513 = v510 * CFrame.Angles(0, v511, 0) * v504:get("torso"):get_offset("walk_state").Value:Inverse()
		local v514 = v507.Size
		local v515 = CFrame.new
		local v516 = v512 * 2
		local v517 = -v509
		local v518 = math.map(p501.values.fov:get(), 60, 80, 1, 0)
		local v519 = math.clamp(v518, 0, 1)
		local v520 = v513 * v515(v516, 0, (math.lerp(v517, 0, v519)))
		local v521 = CFrame.new
		local v522 = 4 - v514.X
		local v523 = v520 * v521(0, math.clamp(v522, -1, 1) * 0.5, 0)
		local v524 = CFrame.new(0, 0.5, 0.5)
		local v525 = CFrame.new()
		local v526 = math.map(p501.values.fov:get(), 40, 60, 0, 1)
		local v527 = v523 * v524:Lerp(v525, (math.clamp(v526, 0, 1)))
		local v528 = v507.CollisionGroup == "char_anim" and Vector3.new(1, 1.5, 1.5) or (p501.states.walk_state:get() == "crouch" and Vector3.new(3.5, 2, 2) or Vector3.new(4.5, 2, 2))
		if v514 ~= v528 then
			local v529 = v_u_7.frame_lerp(v514, v528, 0.25, p502)
			if (v529 - v528).Magnitude >= 0.01 then
				v528 = v529
			end
			v507.Size = v528
		end
		v508.Transform = v527
	else
		local v530 = p501.values
		v530.last_coll = v530.last_coll + p502
	end
	if v506 and not p501.instance.Humanoid.AutoRotate then
		local v531 = p501.states.walk_state:get() == "prone"
		local _, v532, _ = v506.CFrame:ToOrientation()
		if not v505:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("AlignOrientation") then
			local v533 = v505.CFrame
			local _, v534, _ = v533:ToOrientation()
			local v535 = (v532 - v534 + 3.141592653589793) % 6.283185307179586 - 3.141592653589793
			if math.abs(v535) > 0.002617993877991494 then
				v505.CFrame = v_u_7.frame_lerp(v533, CFrame.new(v533.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, v532, 0), v531 and 0.05 or 0.5, p502)
			end
		end
	end
end
function is_moving(p536, _) -- name: is_moving
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7
	local v537 = p536.instance.Humanoid
	local v538 = v537.MoveDirection
	local v539 = p536.instance.HumanoidRootPart
	local v540 = os.clock() - p536.values.reposition < 0.2
	if p536.states.controller:get() ~= nil and (v538.X ~= 0 or (v538.Z ~= 0 or v540)) and p536.states.vault:get() == 0 then
		if v540 and p536.values.custom_movement then
			return true
		end
		if not p536.values.falling:get() and (not v539:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("AlignPosition") and p536.states.climbing:get() < 1) then
			return true
		end
		if p536.states.climbing:get() > 1 and workspace:Spherecast(v539.Position, 1, v539.CFrame.LookVector * 2, p536.values.ray_params) then
			return true
		end
		if p536.states.climbing:get() == 1 then
			local v541 = v_u_7.is_moving_forward_or_backward
			local v542 = v537.MoveDirection
			local v543 = p536.states.look:get().X
			local v544 = p536.states.look:get().Z
			if v541(v542, Vector3.new(v543, 0, v544).Unit) ~= 0 then
				return true
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end
function render_walking(p_u_545, p546, p547) -- name: render_walking
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_24, (copy) v_u_34
	local v548 = p_u_545.instance.Humanoid
	local _ = p_u_545.instance.HumanoidRootPart
	if p_u_545.values.move_vector then
		local v549 = v_u_7.rotate_humanoid_movement_to_cframe(p_u_545.values.move_vector, game.Workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame)
		if v_u_24:GetAttribute("CameraInverted") then
			v549 = v549 * Vector3.new(-1, 1, -1)
		end
		v548:Move(v549)
	end
	local v550 = v548.MoveDirection
	local v_u_551 = p_u_545.states.controller:get() == nil and Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) or v550
	p_u_545.values.walking:set(is_moving(p_u_545))
	if v_u_7.ownership(p_u_545.states.controller:get()) >= 3 then
		p_u_545.values.move_diff:update(function(p552)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_551, (copy) p_u_545
			local v553 = v_u_551:Dot(p_u_545.values.last_move)
			local v554 = math.clamp(v553, -1, 1)
			local v555 = math.acos(v554)
			local v556 = math.deg(v555)
			if p552 < v556 then
				return v556
			else
				return math.lerp(p552, v556, 0.1)
			end
		end)
		if p_u_545.values.falling:get() then
			v548.WalkSpeed = 0
		elseif not p_u_545.values.prone_debounce then
			local v557 = v_u_34(p_u_545)
			v548.WalkSpeed = v_u_7.frame_lerp(v548.WalkSpeed, v557 * math.map(p_u_545.values.move_diff:get(), 0, 90, 1, 0.5), 0.1, p546)
		end
	end
	p_u_545.values.last_move = v_u_551
	local v558 = p547:VectorToObjectSpace(v_u_551)
	p_u_545.values.move_direction = v558
	local v559, _, _ = p_u_545.values.viewmodels.head.CFrame:ToOrientation()
	local v560 = v559 * 0.2 * p_u_545.values.reverse_negative:get()
	if p_u_545.values.cframes:get("torso"):current_pivot() == "lock" then
		p_u_545.values.torso_direction:set(CFrame.Angles(v560, 0, 0), 0.05)
	else
		local v561 = p_u_545.states.walk_state:get() == "prone" and 0.02 or 0.05
		if v558.Z < 0.1 then
			local v562 = p_u_545.values.torso_direction
			local v563 = CFrame.Angles
			local v564 = -v558.X * 40
			v562:set(v563(v560, math.rad(v564), 0), v561)
		else
			local v565 = p_u_545.values.torso_direction
			local v566 = CFrame.Angles
			local v567 = v558.X * 40
			v565:set(v566(v560, math.rad(v567), 0), v561)
		end
	end
end

function setup_bobbing(p_u_577) -- name: setup_bobbing

		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_582, (copy) v_u_581
		local v584 = p583 * 0.5
		local v585 = v584 - v_u_582
		if math.abs(v585) > 0.005 then
			v_u_582 = v584

		end
	end)
	p_u_577.clean:hook(function(p586)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_577

			p_u_577.values.rustling:set_value(0)
		end

	p_u_577:destroying(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_581
		v_u_581:Destroy()
	end)
	p_u_577.values.reposition_rotate = 0
	p_u_577.values.last_rot = p_u_577.instance.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.Rotation
end
function render_bobbing(p587, p588) -- name: render_bobbing
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_44, (copy) v_u_26
	local v589 = p587.values.viewmodels
	local v590, v591 = v589.head.CFrame.Rotation:ToOrientation()
	local v592, v593 = p587.values.last_rot:ToOrientation()
	local v594, v595 = v_u_7.angle_distance_and_direction(v592, v590)
	local v596, v597 = v_u_7.angle_distance_and_direction(v593, v591)
	local v598 = v594 * v595 * 0.5
	local v599 = v596 * v597 * 0.5
	local v600 = (math.deg(v598) + math.deg(v599)) * 1
	local v601 = math.abs(v600)
	local v602 = p587.values.equipped
	if v602 and (v602.states.sights and v602.states.sights:get()) then
		p587.values.bob_cframe.Value = v_u_7.frame_lerp(p587.values.bob_cframe.Value, CFrame.new(0, 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0), 0.1, p588)
	else
		p587.values.bob_cframe.Value = v_u_7.frame_lerp(p587.values.bob_cframe.Value, CFrame.new(v599 * 1.5, -v598 * 3, 0) * CFrame.Angles(v598 * 3, v599 * 1.5, 0), 0.1, p588)
	end
	if not p587.values.walking:get() and p587.states.climbing:get() == 0 then
		local v603 = v_u_7.angle_distance_and_direction(p587.values.reposition_rotate, v591)
		if math.deg(v603) >= 80 then
			local v604 = get_step_ids(p587)
			local _, v605 = v_u_44(p587)
			local v606 = p587.instance.Humanoid.FloorMaterial
			v_u_26[v604](p587.instance.legs, v605, v606)
			p587.values.key:update()
			p587.values.reposition = os.clock()
			p587.values.reposition_rotate = v591
		end
	end
	local v607 = p587.values.rustling
	local v608 = p587.values.rustling.value
	local v609 = math.min(1.5, v601)
	v607:set_value((math.max(v608, v609)))
	p587.values.last_rot = v589.head.CFrame.Rotation
end
function render_item_safety(p610, p611) -- name: render_item_safety
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7
	local v612 = nil
	local v613 = p610.values.viewmodels
	local _ = v613.head
	local v614 = p610.values.holding
	if v614 then
		v614 = p610.values.holding.instance:GetAttribute("item_type") >= 0
	end
	if p610.values.equipped and (not v614 and (p610.values.equipped.loadout_type == "primary" or p610.values.holding and p610.values.holding.loadout_type ~= "primary")) then
		v612 = p610.values.equipped.instance
	elseif p610.values.holding and (p610.values.holding.loadout_type == "primary" or v614) then
		v612 = p610.values.holding.instance
	end
	if v612 and v612.PrimaryPart then
		local v615 = p610.values.camera:get() == game.Workspace.CurrentCamera
		local v616 = v612:GetExtentsSize()
		local _, v617, _ = v612.PrimaryPart.PivotOffset:ToOrientation()
		if math.abs(v617) > 0.78 then
			local v618 = v616.X
			local v619 = v616.Z
			local v620 = v616.Y
			v616 = Vector3.new(v618, v619, v620)
		end
		local v621 = v612:GetPivot()
		local v622 = p610.values.equipped
		if v622 then
			v622 = p610.values.equipped.states.sights
		end
		if v622 and (v622:get() and v615) then
			local v623 = v616.X
			local v624 = v616.Y
			local _ = math.min(v623, v624) * 0.1
			local _ = p610.values.equipped.scope_part
			if p610.values.safety_cframe.Value ~= CFrame.new() and p611 < os.clock() - p610.values.safety_elapsed then
				v_u_7.tween(p610.values.safety_cframe, TweenInfo.new(p611), {
					["Value"] = CFrame.new()
				})
				p610.values.safety_elapsed = os.clock()
			end
			return
		end
		local v625 = v616.X
		local v626 = v616.Y
		local v627 = math.max(v625, v626) * 0.1
		local v628 = math.min(v627, 2)
		local v629 = (v621.Position - v613.head.CFrame.Position).Magnitude
		local v630 = math.min(v629, 2)
		local v631 = v621.Position - v613.head.CFrame.LookVector * v630
		local v632 = v613.head.CFrame.LookVector * (v630 + v616.Z * 0.5)
		local v633 = workspace:Spherecast(v631, v628, v632, p610.values.ray_params)
		local v634 = v621.Position - v613.head.CFrame.LookVector * p610.values.safety_cframe.Value.Position.Y
		local v635 = v613.head.CFrame.LookVector * (v616.Z * 0.5 + 1)
		if v633 and (v633.Instance.Transparency ~= 1 or v633.Instance.Parent:HasTag("Character")) then
			p610.values.safety_elapsed = os.clock()
			local v636 = p610.values
			local v637 = p610.values.safety_value + (v633.Position - (v634 + v635)).Magnitude
			v636.safety_value = math.min(v637, v615 and 1.5 or 2.25)
			v_u_7.tween(p610.values.safety_cframe, TweenInfo.new(p611), {
				["Value"] = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0.5 * p610.values.safety_value)
			})
			return
		end
		if p610.values.safety_cframe.Value ~= CFrame.new() then
			local v638 = workspace:Spherecast(v634, v628, v635, p610.values.ray_params)
			if v638 and (v638.Instance.Transparency ~= 1 or v638.Instance.Parent:HasTag("Character")) then
				return
			end
			if p611 < os.clock() - p610.values.safety_elapsed then
				v_u_7.tween(p610.values.safety_cframe, TweenInfo.new(p611), {
					["Value"] = CFrame.new()
				})
				p610.values.safety_elapsed = os.clock()
			end
			p610.values.safety_value = 0
		end
	end
end
function v_u_23.dead_screen() -- name: dead_screen
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_20, (copy) v_u_22, (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_1
	local v639 = v_u_21.get("LoadingScreen")
	v639.Tip.Visible = false
	v_u_20.transition_on(0)
	local v640 = v_u_22.add_ear_muffle(2)
	v640.Value = -80
	v_u_22.update_sounds()
	if v_u_10.first_time_dead then
		task.wait(1)
	else
		task.wait(3)
		v639.Tip.TextTransparency = 1
		v639.Tip.Text = "Darkness"
		v639.Tip.Visible = true
		v_u_7.tween(v639.Tip, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {
			["TextTransparency"] = 0
		}).Completed:Wait()
		task.wait(2.5)
		v_u_7.tween(v639.Tip, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {
			["TextTransparency"] = 1
		}).Completed:Wait()
		v639.Tip.Text = "Who will be next in line?"
		v_u_7.tween(v639.Tip, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {
			["TextTransparency"] = 0
		}).Completed:Wait()
		task.wait(2.5)
		v_u_7.tween(v639.Tip, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {
			["TextTransparency"] = 1
		}).Completed:Wait()
		task.wait(1)
		v_u_1.send("first_time_dead")
	end
	v_u_22.remove_ear_muffle(v640)
	v_u_22.update_sounds()
end

function load_character(p_u_643) -- name: load_character
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_5, (ref) v_u_642, (copy) v_u_15, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_25, (copy) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_17

function v_u_32.FireExtinguisher(p139, p140, p141) -- name: FireExtinguisher
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_1
	v_u_32.break_prop(p139, true, p140, p141)
	local v_u_142 = p139:GetPivot().Position
	v_u_32.Smoking(p139.Base, 3)
	for _ = 1, 10 do
		task.spawn(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_142, (ref) v_u_1
			local v143 = script.SmokePart:Clone()
			local v144 = game.Lighting.ThermalColor.Enabled and 0.6 or 0
			v143.Transparency = v144
			v143.Size = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
			v143.CFrame = CFrame.new(v_u_142) * CFrame.Angles(v_u_1.rand(-1.7, 1.7), v_u_1.rand(-1.7, 1.7), v_u_1.rand(-1.7, 1.7))
			v143.Parent = game.Workspace
			local v145 = CFrame.Angles(v_u_1.rand(-1.7, 1.7), v_u_1.rand(-1.7, 1.7), v_u_1.rand(-1.7, 1.7))
			v_u_1.tween(v143, TweenInfo.new(0.6), {
				["Size"] = Vector3.new(8, 8, 8),
				["CFrame"] = nil,
				["CFrame"] = v143.CFrame * v145
			})
			local v146 = {
				["Size"] = Vector3.new(5, 5, 5),
				["Transparency"] = nil,
				["CFrame"] = nil,
				["Transparency"] = v144
			}
			local v147 = CFrame.new
			local v148 = v_u_142
			local v149 = v_u_1.rand(-3, 3)
			local v150 = v_u_1.rand(-3, 3)
			local v151 = v_u_1.rand
			v146.CFrame = v147(v148 + Vector3.new(v149, v150, v151(-3, 3))) * v145
			local v152 = {
				["Size"] = Vector3.new(3, 3, 3),
				["Transparency"] = nil,
				["CFrame"] = nil,
				["Transparency"] = v144
			}
			local v153 = CFrame.new
			local v154 = v_u_142
			local v155 = v_u_1.rand(-3, 3)
			local v156 = v_u_1.rand(0, 3)
			local v157 = v_u_1.rand
			v152.CFrame = v153(v154 + Vector3.new(v155, v156, v157(-3, 3))) * v145
			v_u_1.quad_tween(v143, TweenInfo.new(v_u_1.rand(2, 3)), v146, v152).Completed:Wait()
			v_u_1.tween(v143, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {
				["Transparency"] = 1
			}).Completed:Wait()
			v143:Destroy()
		end)
		task.wait()
	end
end
function v_u_32.break_shards(p158, p159, p160) -- name: break_shards
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_32
	local v161 = { p158.Size.X, p158.Size.Y, p158.Size.Z }
	table.sort(v161)
	local v162 = v161[2]
	for _ = 1, 4 do
		local v163 = Instance.new("Part")
		v163.Name = "Shard"
		local v164 = v162 * 0.5
		local v165 = v162 * 0.5
		local v166 = v162 * 0.5
		v163.Size = Vector3.new(v164, v165, v166)
		v163.Transparency = p158.Transparency
		local v167
		if p158.Material == Enum.Material.Neon then
			v167 = Enum.Material.Glass
		else
			v167 = p158.Material
		end
		v163.Material = v167
		v163.Color = p158.Color
		v163.Parent = game.Workspace
		v163.Shape = Enum.PartType.CornerWedge
		v163.Anchored = false
		v163.CanCollide = true
		v163.CanTouch = false
		v163.CollisionGroup = "prop"
		v163.CFrame = p158.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(math.random(), math.random(), math.random())
		local v168 = v163.Mass * 1
		v163:ApplyAngularImpulse(Vector3.new(1, 1, 1) * v_u_1.rand(-3, 3) * v168)
		p160 = p160 or Vector3.new(1, 1, 1) * v_u_1.rand(-1, 1)
		v163:ApplyImpulse(p160 * 10 * v168)
		v_u_32.mark_prop(v163, p159)
	end
end
function v_u_32.Shards(p169, p170, p171) -- name: Shards
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_32
	local v172 = p169:FindFirstChild("Glass") or p169
	v_u_32.break_shards(v172, p170, p171)
end
local v_u_173 = v_u_1.create_debris_queue("props", 32, 5)
function v_u_32.break_prop(p174, p175, p176, p177) -- name: break_prop
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_32
	if p174:IsA("Model") then
		local v178 = 0
		for _, v179 in p174:GetDescendants() do
			if v179:IsA("BasePart") and (not p175 or v179.Transparency < 1) then
				local v180 = { v179.Size.X, v179.Size.Y, v179.Size.Z }
				table.sort(v180)
				local v181 = v179:IsA("UnionOperation")
				if v180[3] < 0.3 then
					continue
				end
				if v180[2] > 2 or not v181 and v180[2] > 0.5 then
					v178 = v178 + #v_u_32.break_part_apart(v179, p176, p177)
				else
					v_u_32.break_part(v179, p176, p177)
					v178 = v178 + 1
				end
			end
			if v178 < 8 then
				continue
			end
			return
		end
		return
	else
		local v182 = { p174.Size.X, p174.Size.Y, p174.Size.Z }
		table.sort(v182)
		local v183 = p174:IsA("UnionOperation")
		if v182[2] > 2 or not v183 and v182[2] > 0.5 then
			v_u_32.break_part_apart(p174, p176, p177)
		else
			v_u_32.break_part(p174, p176, p177)
		end
	end
end
function v_u_32.mark_for_killcam(p_u_184, p185) -- name: mark_for_killcam
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_8
	if p185 then
		p_u_184.Destroying:Connect(p185:hook(function(p186)
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_184
			if p186 then
				p_u_184.Parent = game.Workspace
			else
				p_u_184.Parent = game.ReplicatedStorage.Garbage
			end
		end).unhook)
	elseif not (v_u_8.playing:get() or v_u_8.paused:get()) then
		local v_u_187 = {
			["stamp"] = os.clock(),
			["func"] = function() -- name: func
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_184

function toggle_crouching(p_u_59) -- name: toggle_crouching
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_19
	p_u_59.states.walk_state:update(function(p60)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_19, (copy) p_u_59
		if p60 == "crouch" and not v_u_19.tightspace(p_u_59, CFrame.new(0, 1, 0)) then
			return "stand"
		end
		if p60 == "stand" or not v_u_19.tightspace(p_u_59, CFrame.new(0, 0.5, 0)) then
			return "crouch"
		end
	end)
end
function toggle_proning(p_u_61) -- name: toggle_proning
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_19
	p_u_61.states.walk_state:update(function(p62)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_19, (copy) p_u_61
		if p62 ~= "prone" then
			return "prone"
		end
		if not v_u_19.tightspace(p_u_61, CFrame.new(0, 2, 0)) then
			return "stand"
		end
		if not v_u_19.tightspace(p_u_61, CFrame.new(0, 0.5, 0)) then
			return "crouch"
		end
	end)
end
function setup_crouching(p_u_63) -- name: setup_crouching
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_19
	local v64 = p_u_63.values.inputs
	local v_u_65 = p_u_63.instance.HumanoidRootPart
	local v_u_66 = v_u_5.ov(function(_)
		task.wait(0.15)
	end)
	v_u_66:cancelled(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_63, (copy) v_u_65
		if not (p_u_63.states.running:get() or (v_u_65:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("AlignPosition") or p_u_63.values.prone_debounce)) then
			toggle_crouching(p_u_63)
		end
	end)
	v_u_66:done(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_63, (copy) v_u_65
		if not (p_u_63.states.running:get() or (v_u_65:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("AlignPosition") or p_u_63.values.prone_debounce)) then
			toggle_proning(p_u_63)
		end
	end)
	v64:get("stance"):press(function(p67)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_63, (copy) v_u_65, (copy) v_u_66
		if p67 and (not p_u_63.states.running:get() and (not v_u_65:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("AlignPosition") and (not p_u_63.values.prone_debounce and p_u_63.values.holding.can_crouch ~= false))) then
			v_u_66()
		else
			v_u_66:cancel()
		end
	end)
	v64:get("crouch"):press(function(p68)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_63, (copy) v_u_65, (ref) v_u_9, (ref) v_u_19
		if p68 and (not p_u_63.states.running:get() and (not v_u_65:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("AlignPosition") and (not p_u_63.values.prone_debounce and p_u_63.values.holding.can_crouch ~= false))) then
			toggle_crouching(p_u_63)
		elseif not v_u_9.settings.toggle_crouch and (p_u_63.states.walk_state:get() == "crouch" and not v_u_19.tightspace(p_u_63, CFrame.new(0, 1, 0))) then
			p_u_63.states.walk_state:set("stand")
		end
	end)
end

require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Modules.CastVisuals).new()
function v_u_19.can_vault(p73) -- name: can_vault
	if p73.values.inputs.enabled:get() then
		local v74 = p73.instance
		local v75 = v74.HumanoidRootPart
		local v76 = p73.values.ray_vault
		if (p73.instance.Humanoid:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall or p73.states.climbing:get() > 0) and (p73.states.walk_state:get() ~= "prone" and (p73.states.vault:get() == 0 and (not p73.values.prone_debounce and (not v75:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("AlignPosition") or p73.states.climbing:get() > 1)))) then
			if p73.values.holding and p73.values.holding.can_vault == false then
				return
			end
			local v77 = CFrame.new(v74.collision.Position) * v75.CFrame.Rotation + Vector3.new(0, -0.7, 0) - v75.CFrame.LookVector * 0.5
			local v78 = workspace:Blockcast(v77, Vector3.new(0.3, 2, 0.3), v75.CFrame.LookVector * 3, v76)
			if v78 and (v78.Instance and v78.Normal:Dot(Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)) < 0.5) then
				local v79 = workspace:Spherecast(v78.Position + v77.UpVector * 2.5 - v75.CFrame.LookVector * 1.5, 0.5, v75.CFrame.LookVector * 3.5, v76)
				local v80
				if v79 then
					v80 = v79.Position - v75.CFrame.LookVector * 1
				else
					v80 = v78.Position + v75.CFrame.LookVector * 2 + v77.UpVector * 2.5
				end
				local v81 = workspace:Spherecast(v80, 0.3, Vector3.new(0, -2.5, 0), v76)
				if v81 and not (workspace:Spherecast(v77.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0), 0.3, v75.CFrame.UpVector * 4 + v75.CFrame.LookVector * 1, v76) or (workspace:Spherecast(v81.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0), 0.3, v75.CFrame.UpVector * 4 - v75.CFrame.LookVector * 1, v76) or workspace:Spherecast(v81.Position + Vector3.new(0, 4.5, 0), 0.3, -v75.CFrame.UpVector * 4 - v75.CFrame.LookVector * 1, v76))) then
					local v82 = v78.Position.X
					local v83 = v81.Position.Y + 1
					local v84 = v78.Position.Z
					local v85 = Vector3.new(v82, v83, v84) - v75.CFrame.LookVector * 1
					local v86 = workspace:Spherecast(v85, 0.3, v75.CFrame.LookVector * 3, v76)
					if not v86 then
						return v78, v81, nil, v77
					end
					local v87 = v86.Position.X
					local v88 = v86.Position.Z
					local v89 = Vector3.new(v87, 0, v88)
					local v90 = v78.Position.X
					local v91 = v78.Position.Z
					if (v89 - Vector3.new(v90, 0, v91)).Magnitude > 1 then
						local v92 = v86.Position.X
						local v93 = v81.Position.Y
						local v94 = v86.Position.Z
						return v78, v81, nil, v77, Vector3.new(v92, v93, v94) - v75.CFrame.LookVector * 1
					end
				end
				local v95 = workspace:Blockcast(CFrame.new(v78.Position + v75.CFrame.LookVector * 2.5), Vector3.new(0.5, 1, 0.5), -v75.CFrame.LookVector * 2.5, v76)
				if v95 and not (workspace:Spherecast(v95.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), 0.3, Vector3.new(0, -3, 0) + v75.CFrame.LookVector * 2, v76) or workspace:Spherecast(v78.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), 0.3, Vector3.new(0, -3, 0) - v75.CFrame.LookVector * 1, v76)) then
					local v96 = workspace:Spherecast(v95.Position + v75.CFrame.UpVector * 2.5 - v75.CFrame.LookVector * 0.1, 0.5, Vector3.new(0, -4, 0), v76)
					if v96 and not (workspace:Spherecast(v96.Position + v75.CFrame.UpVector * 0.5, 0.3, v75.CFrame.UpVector * 1.6, v76) or workspace:Spherecast(v96.Position + v75.CFrame.UpVector * 2.5, 0.3, -v75.CFrame.UpVector * 1.6, v76)) then
						local v97 = workspace
						local v98 = v78.Position.X
						local v99 = v96.Position.Y + 1
						local v100 = v78.Position.Z
						if not v97:Spherecast(Vector3.new(v98, v99, v100) - v75.CFrame.LookVector * 1, 0.3, v75.CFrame.UpVector * 1.5 + v75.CFrame.LookVector * 3, v76) then
							return v78, workspace:Spherecast(v95.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0) + v75.CFrame.LookVector * 2, 0.3, Vector3.new(0, -5, 0), v76), v95, v77, v96
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end
function v_u_19.vault(p101) -- name: vault
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_19, (copy) v_u_5
	local v102 = p101.instance
	local _ = p101.values.viewmodels
	local v103 = v102.HumanoidRootPart
	local _ = p101.values.inputs
	local v104, v105, v106, _, v107 = v_u_19.can_vault(p101)
	if v106 then
		p101.states.vault:set(2)
		local _ = v107.Instance
		local _ = v103.CFrame.Rotation
		local _ = v103.CFrame.Position
		local v108 = v107.Position.Y + 2 - p101.values.cframes:get("camera_offset"):get_offset("walk_state").Value.Y
		local v109 = v104.Position.X
		local v110 = v104.Position.Z
		local v111 = Vector3.new(v109, v108, v110) + v103.CFrame.UpVector * 0 - v103.CFrame.LookVector * 2
		local v112 = v106.Position.X
		local v113 = v106.Position.Z
		local v114 = Vector3.new(v112, v108, v113) + v103.CFrame.UpVector * 0 + v103.CFrame.LookVector * 2
		local v115
		if v105 then
			local v116 = v105.Position.Y - v103.CFrame.Position.Y + 3.6
			v115 = math.max(0, v116)
		else
			v115 = 0
		end
		local v117 = v106.Position.X
		local v118 = v103.Position.Y + v115
		local v119 = v106.Position.Z
		local v120 = Vector3.new(v117, v118, v119) + v103.CFrame.UpVector * 0 + v103.CFrame.LookVector * 2
		local v121 = script.AlignPosition:Clone()
		v121.Parent = v103
		v121.Attachment0 = v103.RootAttachment
		v121.Position = v103.CFrame.Position
		local v122 = script.AlignOrientation:Clone()
		v122.Parent = v103
		v122.Attachment0 = v103.RootAttachment
		v122.CFrame = v103.CFrame
		v_u_5.cubic_tween(v121, TweenInfo.new(0.7, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), {
			["Position"] = v111
		}, {
			["Position"] = v114
		}, {
			["Position"] = v120
		}).Completed:Wait()
		v121:Destroy()
		v122:Destroy()
		p101.states.vault:set(0)
	elseif v105 then
		p101.states.vault:set(1)
		local _ = v103.CFrame.Rotation
		local _ = v103.CFrame.Position
		if not v107 then
			local _ = v105.Position
		end
		local v123 = v105.Position + v103.CFrame.UpVector * 4.6 - v103.CFrame.LookVector * 2
		local v124 = v105.Position + v103.CFrame.UpVector * 3.6
		local v125 = script.AlignPosition:Clone()
		v125.Parent = v103
		v125.Attachment0 = v103.RootAttachment
		v125.Position = v103.CFrame.Position
		local v126 = script.AlignOrientation:Clone()
		v126.Parent = v103
		v126.Attachment0 = v103.RootAttachment
		v126.CFrame = v103.CFrame
		v_u_5.quad_tween(v125, TweenInfo.new(0.7, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), {
			["Position"] = v123
		}, {
			["Position"] = v124
		}).Completed:Wait()
		v125:Destroy()
		v126:Destroy()
		p101.states.vault:set(0)
	end
end
local v_u_127 = RaycastParams.new()
v_u_127.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
v_u_127.FilterDescendantsInstances = {}
v_u_127.RespectCanCollide = true
v_u_127.CollisionGroup = "weak"

function setup_vaulting(p_u_128) -- name: setup_vaulting
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_127, (copy) v_u_19
	local _ = p_u_128.instance.HumanoidRootPart
	local v129 = p_u_128.values.inputs
	p_u_128.values.ray_vault = v_u_127
	local v_u_132 = v_u_19.setup_action(v129, function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_19, (copy) p_u_128
		local _, v130, v131, _ = v_u_19.can_vault(p_u_128)
		if not v130 and v131 or v130 then
			p_u_128.values.can_vault = true
			return true
		end
		p_u_128.values.can_vault = false
	end, "Vault", "vault", nil, 1)
	local v_u_133 = 0
	v129:get("vault"):press(function(p134)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_132, (ref) v_u_19, (copy) p_u_128, (ref) v_u_133
		if p134 then
			if v_u_132.conflict then
				v_u_133 = os.clock()
			else
				task.spawn(v_u_19.vault, p_u_128)
			end
		else
			if v_u_132.conflict and os.clock() - v_u_133 < 0.2 then
				task.spawn(v_u_19.vault, p_u_128)
			end
			return
		end
	end)
end
function can_climb(p135) -- name: can_climb
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_5
	if p135.values.inputs.enabled:get() then
		if p135.instance.Humanoid:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall and (p135.states.walk_state:get() ~= "prone" and (p135.states.vault:get() == 0 and (p135.states.climbing:get() == 0 and not p135.values.prone_debounce))) then
			local v136 = p135.values.camera:get()
			local v137 = p135.instance.HumanoidRootPart
			local v_u_138 = nil
			local v_u_139 = nil
			if v136 == nil then
				return
			end
			v_u_5.parts_on_ray(v136.CFrame.Position, v136.CFrame.LookVector * 5, {}, function(p140)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_138, (ref) v_u_139
				local v141 = p140.Instance
				if not v141:HasTag("Ladder") or v141:GetAttribute("Disabled") then
					return (v141:GetAttribute("Soft") or (v141.Parent:GetAttribute("Soft") or (v141.CanCollide ~= true or v141.Transparency >= 1))) and true or false
				end
				v_u_138 = v141
				v_u_139 = p140.Normal
				return false
			end)
			if v_u_138 then
				local v142 = v_u_138.start
				local v143 = v_u_138.finish
				local v144 = v_u_138.final
				if (v142.WorldCFrame.Position - v137.CFrame.Position).Magnitude < 2 and v_u_5.normal_to_face(v_u_139, v_u_138) == Enum.NormalId.Front then
					return v_u_138, v142
				end
				if (v144.WorldCFrame.Position - v137.CFrame.Position).Magnitude < 2 then
					return v_u_138, v143
				end
			end
		end
	end
end
function can_drop_ladder(p145) -- name: can_drop_ladder
	if p145.values.inputs.enabled:get() then
		if p145.states.climbing:get() == 1 then
			return true
		end
	end
end
function prepare_climbing(p146) -- name: prepare_climbing
	if can_drop_ladder(p146) then
		p146.states.climbing:set(0)
	else
		local v147, v148 = can_climb(p146)
		if v147 then
			p146.values.climbing:set(v148.Name == "start" and 0 or 1)
			p146.values.climbing_ladder:set(v147)
		end
	end
end
function setup_climbing(p_u_149) -- name: setup_climbing
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_19, (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_21
	local v150 = p_u_149.values.inputs
	v_u_19.setup_action(v150, function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_149
		return can_drop_ladder(p_u_149)
	end, "Drop", "vault", nil, 5)
	local v_u_151 = v_u_19.setup_action(v150, function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_149
		return can_climb(p_u_149)
	end, "Climb", "vault", nil, 5)
	local v_u_152 = 0
	v150:get("vault"):press(function(p153)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_151, (copy) p_u_149, (ref) v_u_152
		if p153 then
			if v_u_151.conflict then
				v_u_152 = os.clock()
			else
				prepare_climbing(p_u_149)
			end
		else
			if v_u_151.conflict and os.clock() - v_u_152 < 0.2 then
				prepare_climbing(p_u_149)
			end
			return
		end
	end)
	local v_u_154 = script.AlignPosition:Clone()
	local v_u_155 = script.AlignOrientation:Clone()
	local v_u_156 = p_u_149.instance.HumanoidRootPart
	p_u_149.values.climbing = v_u_1.new(0)
	p_u_149.values.climbing_ladder = v_u_1.new(nil)
	local v_u_157 = nil
	local v_u_158 = v_u_5.ov(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_149
		task.wait(0.2)
		p_u_149.values.requip_items()
	end)
	p_u_149.values.climb_moving = v_u_1.new(0)
	p_u_149.values.climb_moving:hook(function(p159, p160)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_158
		if p160 == nil then
			return
		elseif p159 == 0 or p160 ~= 0 then
			if p159 == 0 and p160 ~= 0 then
				v_u_158()
			end
		else
			v_u_158:cancel()
		end
	end)
	p_u_149.states.climbing:hook(function(p161)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_149, (ref) v_u_157
		if p161 == 0 then
			p_u_149.values.climbing_ladder:set(nil)
		elseif p161 == 1 and p_u_149.values.climbing_ladder:get() == nil then
			p_u_149.values.climbing_ladder:set(v_u_157)
			p_u_149.values.climbing:update()
		end
	end)
	p_u_149.values.climbing_ladder:hook(function(p162, p163)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_154, (copy) v_u_156, (copy) v_u_155, (copy) p_u_149, (ref) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_158, (ref) v_u_157
		if p162 then
			v_u_154.Position = v_u_156.CFrame.Position
			v_u_155.CFrame = v_u_156.CFrame.Rotation
			v_u_154.Parent = v_u_156
			v_u_155.Parent = v_u_156
			v_u_154.Attachment0 = v_u_156.RootAttachment
			v_u_155.Attachment0 = v_u_156.RootAttachment
			local v164 = p162.start
			local v165 = p162.finish
			local v166 = v164.WorldCFrame:Lerp(v165.WorldCFrame, p_u_149.values.climbing:get())
			if p_u_149.values.climbing:get() == 1 then
				local v167 = v166.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
				local v168 = v_u_154.Position.X
				local v169 = v167.Y
				local v170 = v_u_154.Position.Z
				local v171 = Vector3.new(v168, v169, v170) + v_u_156.CFrame.LookVector * 1
				v_u_5.cubic_tween(v_u_154, TweenInfo.new(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), {
					["Position"] = v171
				}, {
					["Position"] = v167
				}, {
					["Position"] = v166.Position
				})
				p_u_149.values.climb_time = 0.6
				p_u_149.instance.collision.CollisionGroup = "char_anim"
			else
				v_u_5.tween(v_u_154, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine), {
					["Position"] = v166.Position
				})
				p_u_149.values.climb_time = 0.3
			end

local v_u_211 = { "BreachingHammer", "MilitaryKnife" }
function setup_meleeing(p_u_212) -- name: setup_meleeing
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_211, (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_5
	local v213 = p_u_212.values.inputs
	local v_u_214 = os.clock()
	p_u_212.values.camera:get()
	v213:get("melee"):press(function(p215)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_212, (ref) v_u_214, (ref) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_211, (ref) v_u_6, (ref) v_u_5
		local v216 = os.clock()
		local v217 = p_u_212.values.holding
		local v218 = p_u_212.values.equipped
		if not v217 or v217.can_melee ~= false then
			if p215 and (v216 - v_u_214 > 0.7 and not p_u_212.values.equip_debounce:get()) then
				p_u_212.states.running:set(false)
				if v218 and v_u_2.current_device:get() == "console" then
					if v218.states.sights and v218.states.sights:get() then
						return
					end
					if v218.states.aiming and v218.states.aiming:get() then
						return
					end
				end
				for _, v219 in v_u_211 do
					local v_u_220 = p_u_212.values.Items:FindFirstChild(v219, true) or p_u_212.values.viewmodels:FindFirstChild(v219, true)
					if not v_u_220 then
						continue
					end
					if p_u_212.states.holding:get() == v_u_220 then
						return
					end
					if v217.melee ~= nil then
						continue
					end
					local v_u_221 = v_u_6.get_item(v_u_220)
					if v_u_221:equip_item(p_u_212) ~= false then
						p_u_212.states.holding:set(v_u_220)
						while p_u_212.values.equip_debounce:get() do
							p_u_212.values.equip_debounce:wait()
						end
						if p_u_212.states.holding:get() == v_u_220 then
							v_u_214 = v216
							v_u_221:send_melee()
						end
						return
					end
					v_u_5.ov(function()
						-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_221, (ref) p_u_212, (copy) v_u_220
						v_u_5.tween(v_u_221.button, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {
							["BackgroundColor3"] = Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
						}).Completed:Wait()
						if p_u_212.states.holding:get() ~= v_u_220 then
							v_u_5.tween(v_u_221.button, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {
								["BackgroundColor3"] = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
							})
						end
					end, v_u_221.button)()
				end
				if v217 and v217.melee then
					if v217.is_stunned then
						return
					end
					if v217.safety == nil or not v217.safety:get() then
						v_u_214 = v216
						v217:send_melee()
						return
					end
				end
				if v218 and (v218.melee and v218.can_melee ~= false) then
					if v218.states.sights then
						v218.states.sights:set(false)
					end
					v_u_214 = v216
					v218:send_melee()
					return
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end
function get_item_from_index(p222, p223) -- name: get_item_from_index
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_22
	local v224 = v_u_22[p223]
	if v224 then
		for _, v225 in p222.values.items:get_items() do
			if v225.instance:GetAttribute("key") ~= v224 then
				continue
			end
			return v225.instance
		end
	end
end
function get_image_from_index(p226) -- name: get_image_from_index
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_18
	for _, v227 in v_u_18.get("BackpackItems"):GetChildren() do
		if v227.Name ~= "Item" then
			continue
		end
		local v228 = v227.LayoutOrder
		if p226 ~= math.abs(v228) then
			continue
		end
		return v227
	end
end
function get_total_items() -- name: get_total_items
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_18
	local v229 = 0
	for _, v230 in v_u_18.get("BackpackItems"):GetChildren() do
		if v230.Name ~= "Item" then
			continue
		end
		v229 = v229 + 1
	end
	return v229
end
function equip_item(p_u_231, p_u_232) -- name: equip_item
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_5
	if p_u_231.values.climb_moving:get() == 0 then
		local v233 = p_u_231.values.equipped
		local v234 = p_u_231.values.holding
		if v233 and v233.is_stunned or v234 and v234.is_stunned then
			return
		else
			local v_u_235 = v_u_6.get_item(p_u_232)
			if v_u_235:equip_item(p_u_231) == false then
				v_u_5.ov(function()
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_235, (copy) p_u_231, (copy) p_u_232
					v_u_5.tween(v_u_235.button, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {
						["BackgroundColor3"] = Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
					}).Completed:Wait()
					if p_u_231.states.equipped:get() == p_u_232 then
						v_u_5.tween(v_u_235.button, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {
							["BackgroundColor3"] = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
						})
					else
						v_u_5.tween(v_u_235.button, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {
							["BackgroundColor3"] = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
						})
					end
				end, v_u_235.button)()
			end
		end
	else
		return
	end
end

			v_u_5.tween(v_u_245, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
				["BackgroundColor3"] = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
			})
			v_u_5.tween(v_u_245.InfoLabel, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
				["TextColor3"] = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			})
			v_u_5.tween(v_u_245.ImageLabel, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
				["ImageColor3"] = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			})
		end
	end)
	v_u_240:add(p_u_236.states.equipped:hook(function(p253, p254)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_241, (copy) v_u_252
		if v_u_241 == p253 then
			v_u_252(true)
		elseif v_u_241 == p254 then
			v_u_252(false)
		end
	end).unhook)
	v_u_240:add(p_u_236.states.holding:hook(function(p255, p256)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_241, (copy) v_u_252
		if v_u_241 == p255 then
			v_u_252(true)
		elseif v_u_241 == p256 then
			v_u_252(false)
		end
	end).unhook)
	if v_u_241:GetAttribute("loadout_type") == "primary" then

			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_236, (copy) v_u_241
			equip_item(p_u_236, v_u_241)
		end)

function setup_backpack(p_u_265) -- name: setup_backpack
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_257, (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_18, (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_19
	local v266 = p_u_265.values.inputs
	local v_u_267 = p_u_265.values.Items
	v_u_257:set(0)
	v266:get("switch_item"):change(function(p268)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_9, (ref) v_u_257, (copy) p_u_265
		if p268.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
			return
		elseif not v_u_9.settings.item_wheel then
			local v269 = p268.Position and p268.Position.Z > 0 and 1 or -1
			local v270 = v_u_257:get() == 0 and 1 or v_u_257:get() + v269
			if get_item_from_index(p_u_265, v270) == nil then
				if v270 < 1 then
					v_u_257:set(get_total_items())
				else
					v_u_257:set(1)
				end
			else
				v_u_257:set(v270)
			end
			if v_u_9.settings.quick_equip_cycle then
				local v271 = v_u_257:get()
				local v272 = get_item_from_index(p_u_265, v271)
				if v272 then
					equip_item(p_u_265, v272)
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	v266:get("confirm_switch"):press(function(p273)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_9, (ref) v_u_257, (copy) p_u_265
		if p273 and not (v_u_9.settings.quick_equip_cycle or v_u_9.settings.item_wheel) then
			local v274 = v_u_257:get()
			local v275 = get_item_from_index(p_u_265, v274)
			v_u_257:set(0)
			if v275 then
				equip_item(p_u_265, v275)
			end
		end
	end)
	v266:get("item_wheel"):press(function(p276)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_9, (ref) v_u_18, (copy) p_u_265, (ref) v_u_16
		if p276 and v_u_9.settings.item_wheel then
			if not v_u_18.get("BlackBackground").Visible then
				local v277 = p_u_265.values.equipped
				if v277 and v277.wheel_button then
					v_u_16.selection_arrow_rotation.target = v277.wheel_button.Rotation
					v_u_16.selection_arrow_rotation.value = v277.wheel_button.Rotation
				else
					v_u_16.selection_arrow_rotation.target = 0
					v_u_16.selection_arrow_rotation.value = 0
				end
				v_u_16.selection_arrow_rotation:update()
				v_u_16.selection_wheel:set("items")
			end
		else
			v_u_16.selection_wheel:set("")
			return
		end
	end)
	v266:get("switch_gun"):press(function(p278)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_265, (copy) v_u_267
		if p278 then
			local v279 = p_u_265.states.equipped:get():GetAttribute("loadout_type")
			if p_u_265.states.holding:get():GetAttribute("loadout_type") == "primary" then
				p_u_265.states.holding:set(p_u_265.values.hands)
				for _, v280 in v_u_267:GetChildren() do
					if v280:GetAttribute("loadout_type") ~= "secondary" then
						continue
					end
					equip_item(p_u_265, v280)
					return
				end
				return
			end
			for _, v281 in v_u_267:GetChildren() do
				if (v281:GetAttribute("loadout_type") ~= "secondary" or v279 ~= "primary") and (v281:GetAttribute("loadout_type") ~= "primary" or v279 == "primary") then
					continue
				end
				equip_item(p_u_265, v281)
				return
			end
		end
	end)
	p_u_265.clean:hook(function(p282)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_16
		if p282 then
			v_u_16.selection_wheel:set("")
		end
	end)
	p_u_265.values.items:on_add(function(p283)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_19, (copy) p_u_265
		v_u_19.setup_item(p_u_265, p283)
	end)
	function p_u_265.values.requip_items()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_265, (ref) v_u_9
		local v284 = p_u_265.states.equipped:get()
		if v284 and not table.find({ "primary", "secondary" }, v284:GetAttribute("loadout_type")) then
			if v_u_9.settings.smart_requip and p_u_265.values.last_equipped then
				p_u_265.states.equipped:set(p_u_265.values.last_equipped)
			else
				p_u_265.states.equipped:set(p_u_265.values.hands)
			end
		end
		local v285 = p_u_265.states.holding:get()
		if v285 and not table.find({ "primary", "secondary" }, v285:GetAttribute("loadout_type")) then
			if v_u_9.settings.smart_requip and p_u_265.values.last_holding then
				p_u_265.states.holding:set(p_u_265.values.last_holding)
				return
			end
			p_u_265.states.holding:set(p_u_265.values.hands)
		end
	end
	p_u_265.states.equipped:hook(function(p286, _, p287)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_265
		if p286 and (table.find({ "primary", "secondary" }, p286:GetAttribute("loadout_type")) or p286 == p_u_265.values.hands and not p287) then
			p_u_265.values.last_equipped = p286
		end
	end)
	p_u_265.states.holding:hook(function(p288, _, p289)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_265
		if p288 and (table.find({ "primary", "secondary" }, p288:GetAttribute("loadout_type")) or p288 == p_u_265.values.hands and not p289) then
			p_u_265.values.last_holding = p288
		end
	end)
end

function create_radial_value(p_u_301) -- name: create_radial_value
	local v302 = Instance.new("NumberValue")
	v302.Changed:Connect(function(p303)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_301
		p_u_301.Rotation = 90 - 180 * p303
		local v304 = {}
		local v305 = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new
		table.insert(v304, v305(0, 0))
		local v306 = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new
		local v307 = p303 - 0.001
		local v308 = math.max(0, v307)
		table.insert(v304, v306(v308, 0))
		local v309 = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new
		local v310 = p303 + 0.001
		local v311 = math.min(0.999, v310)
		table.insert(v304, v309(v311, 1))
		local v312 = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new
		table.insert(v304, v312(1, 1))
		p_u_301.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(v304)
	end)
	return v302
end

function setup_protected(p331) -- name: setup_protected
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_18, (copy) v_u_5
	local v_u_332 = v_u_18.get("Effects")
	local v_u_333 = script.Effect:Clone()
	v_u_333.ImageLabel.Image = "rbxassetid://16516561161"
	v_u_333.ImageLabel.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 200)
	v_u_333.UIStroke.UIGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 200))
	local v_u_334 = create_radial_value(v_u_333.UIStroke.UIGradient)
	local v_u_336 = v_u_5.ov(function(p335)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_333, (copy) v_u_332, (copy) v_u_334, (ref) v_u_5
		v_u_333.Parent = v_u_332
		if p335 >= 1000 then
			v_u_334.Value = 1
			return
		elseif p335 > 0 then
			v_u_334.Value = 1
			v_u_5.tween(v_u_334, TweenInfo.new(p335, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
				["Value"] = 0
			}).Completed:Wait()
			v_u_333.Parent = nil
		elseif p335 < 0 then
			v_u_334.Value = 0
			v_u_5.tween(v_u_334, TweenInfo.new(-p335, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
				["Value"] = 1
			}).Completed:Wait()
			v_u_333.Parent = nil
		end
	end)
	v_u_336:cancelled(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_334, (copy) v_u_333
		v_u_5.tween(v_u_334, TweenInfo.new(0, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
			["Value"] = 0
		})
		v_u_333.Parent = nil
	end)
	v_u_5.watch_attribute(p331.instance, "Protected", function(p337)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_336, (copy) v_u_333
		if p337 then
			v_u_336(p337)
		else
			v_u_336:cancel()
			v_u_333.Parent = nil
		end
	end)
	p331.clean:hook(function(p338)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_336, (copy) v_u_333
		if p338 then
			v_u_336:cancel()
			v_u_333.Parent = nil

function setup_generic_effect(p339, p_u_340, p341, p342, p_u_343) -- name: setup_generic_effect
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_18, (copy) v_u_5
	local v_u_344 = v_u_18.get("Effects")
	local v_u_345 = script.Effect:Clone()
	v_u_345.ImageLabel.Image = p341
	v_u_345.ImageLabel.ImageColor3 = p342
	v_u_345.UIStroke.UIGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(p342)
	local v_u_346 = create_radial_value(v_u_345.UIStroke.UIGradient)
	local v_u_348 = v_u_5.ov(function(p347)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_345, (copy) v_u_344, (copy) p_u_343, (copy) v_u_346, (ref) v_u_5

			v_u_346.Value = 0
			v_u_5.tween(v_u_346, TweenInfo.new(p347, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
				["Value"] = 1
			}).Completed:Wait()
		else
			v_u_346.Value = 1
			v_u_5.tween(v_u_346, TweenInfo.new(p347, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
				["Value"] = 0
			}).Completed:Wait()
			v_u_345.Parent = nil
		end
	end)
	v_u_348:cancelled(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_343, (ref) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_346, (copy) v_u_345
		if p_u_343 then
			v_u_5.tween(v_u_346, TweenInfo.new(0, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
				["Value"] = 1
			})
		else
			v_u_5.tween(v_u_346, TweenInfo.new(0, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
				["Value"] = 0
			})
		end
		v_u_345.Parent = nil
	end)
	p339.states.effect:hook(function(p349, p350)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_340, (copy) v_u_348, (copy) v_u_345
		if p349 == p_u_340 then
			if p350 > 0 then
				v_u_348(p350)
				return
			end
			v_u_348:cancel()
			v_u_345.Parent = nil
		end
	end)
	p339.clean:hook(function(p351)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_348, (copy) v_u_345
		if p351 then
			v_u_348:cancel()
			v_u_345.Parent = nil
		end
	end)
end

function v_u_4.get_limited_seconds_left(p6) -- name: get_limited_seconds_left
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4
	local v7 = v_u_4.limited_time[p6]
	if v7 == nil then
		return nil
	end
	local v8 = v7.end_stamp
	local v9 = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	return v8 - math.floor(v9)
end
function v_u_4.is_mode_available(p10) -- name: is_mode_available
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4
	if p10 == nil then
		return true
	end
	for v11, v12 in v_u_4.limited_time do
		if v12.mode ~= p10 or v_u_4.get_limited_seconds_left(v11) > 0 then
			continue
		end
		return false
	end
	return true
end
function v_u_4.is_track_available(p13) -- name: is_track_available
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4
	for v14, v15 in v_u_4.limited_time do
		if v15.track ~= p13 or v_u_4.get_limited_seconds_left(v14) > 0 then
			continue
		end
		return false
	end
	return true
end

function v_u_4.get_bundle_seconds_left(p85) -- name: get_bundle_seconds_left
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4
	local v86 = v_u_4.bundles[p85]
	if v86 == nil or v86.off_sale_stamp == nil then
		return nil
	end
	local v87 = v86.off_sale_stamp
	local v88 = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	return v87 - math.floor(v88)
end
function v_u_4.is_bundle_on_sale(p89) -- name: is_bundle_on_sale
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4
	local v90 = v_u_4.bundles[p89]
	if v90 == nil or v90.hidden then
		return false
	end
	local v91 = v_u_4.get_bundle_seconds_left(p89)
	return v91 == nil and true or v91 > 0
end
