	end
	local v_u_17 = {
		["inputs"] = {},
		["keys"] = {},
		["values"] = {},
		["enabled"] = v_u_1.new(true),
		["inst"] = p_u_16
	}
	dictionaries[p_u_16] = v_u_17
	v_u_17.enabled:hook(function(p18)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_16, (copy) v_u_17
		if p18 then
			active_dictionaries[p_u_16] = v_u_17
		else
			active_dictionaries[p_u_16] = nil
			for _, v19 in v_u_17.inputs do
				for _, v20 in v19.hooks do
					if not v20.set then
						continue
					end
					v20:set(false)
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	if typeof(p_u_16) == "Instance" then
		p_u_16.Destroying:Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_8, (copy) p_u_16
			v_u_8.delete_input_dictionary(p_u_16)
		end)
	end
	local v21 = {
		["__index"] = dict
	}
	return setmetatable(v_u_17, v21)
end
function v_u_8.delete_input_dictionary(p22) -- name: delete_input_dictionary
	if dictionaries[p22] then
		dictionaries[p22].enabled:set(false)
		dictionaries[p22] = nil
	end
	active_dictionaries[p22] = nil
end

function get_movement_vector(p42, p43, p44, p45) -- name: get_movement_vector
	local v46 = 0
	local v47 = 0
	if p42 then
		v46 = v46 - 1
	end
	if p43 then
		v46 = v46 + 1
	end
	if p44 then
		v47 = v47 + 1
	end
	if p45 then
		v47 = v47 - 1
	end
	local v48 = v46 * v46 + v47 * v47
	return math.sqrt(v48) == 0 and Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) or Vector3.new(v46, 0, v47).Unit
end
function get_move_vector(p49, p50) -- name: get_move_vector
	local v51 = p49.AbsolutePosition
	local v52 = p49.AbsoluteSize
	local v53 = v51 + v52 * 0.5
	local v54 = Vector2.new(p50.X - v53.X, p50.Y - v53.Y)
	local v55 = v52.X
	local v56 = v52.Y
	local v57 = math.min(v55, v56)
	local v58 = v57 * 0.35
	local v59 = v54.Magnitude
	local v60 = math.min(v59, v58)
	local v61 = v54.Unit * (v60 / v58)
	local v62 = v61.X
	local v63 = -v61.Y
	local v64 = Vector3.new(v62, 0, v63)
	local v65
	if v54.Y < -v57 * 1 then
		local v66 = v54.X
		v65 = math.abs(v66) < v57 * 1
	else
		v65 = false
	end
	return v64, v65
end
function joystick_position(p67, p68) -- name: joystick_position
	local v69 = p67.AbsolutePosition
	local v70 = p67.AbsoluteSize
	local v71 = v69 + v70 / 2
	local v72 = v70.X
	local v73 = v70.Y
	local v74 = math.min(v72, v73) / 2
	local v75 = Vector2.new(p68.X - v71.X, p68.Y - v71.Y)
	if v74 < v75.Magnitude then
		v75 = v75.Unit * v74
	end
	p67.MoveJoystick.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(v75.X + v70.X / 2, v75.Y + v70.Y / 2)
end

function dict.hook_movement(p_u_76, p_u_77, p_u_78) -- name: hook_movement
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_7
	local v_u_79 = v_u_3.new()
	local v_u_111 = v_u_1.dependency({ p_u_76.enabled, v_u_8.current_device, v_u_8.unlocked_joystick }, function(p80, p81, p82)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_79, (ref) v_u_1, (copy) p_u_76, (copy) p_u_77, (ref) v_u_5, (ref) v_u_7, (copy) p_u_78
		v_u_79:clean()
		if p80 then
			if p81 == "pc" then
				local function v83() -- name: empty end
				v_u_79:add(v_u_1.dependency({
					p_u_76:get("move_left"):press(v83).state,

				return
			elseif p81 == "console" then
				v_u_79:add(p_u_76:get("move"):change(function(p89, _)
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_5, (ref) p_u_77
					if not game:GetService("GamepadService").GamepadCursorEnabled then
						local v90 = v_u_5.clamp_deadzone(p89.Position, 0.2)
						local v91 = p_u_77
						local v92 = v90.X
						local v93 = v90.Y
						v91((Vector3.new(v92, 0, v93)))
					end
				end).unhook)
			elseif p81 == "mobile" then
				local v_u_94 = v_u_7.get("MoveJoystickFrame")
				local v_u_95 = v_u_7.get("MoveJoystickArea")
				v_u_79:add(function()
					-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_94, (copy) v_u_95
					v_u_94.Visible = false
					v_u_95.Visible = false
				end)
				v_u_94.RunArrow.Visible = p_u_78 and true or false
				v_u_94.RunArrow2.Visible = p_u_78 and true or false
				if p82 then
					v_u_94.Visible = false
					v_u_95.Visible = v_u_95:GetAttribute("Visibility")
					v_u_79:add(v_u_7.holding(v_u_95, function(p96, p97)
						-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_94, (ref) p_u_77
						if p96 == true then
							local v98 = Vector2.new(p97.Position.X, p97.Position.Y) - v_u_94.Parent.AbsolutePosition
							v_u_94.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(v98.X, v98.Y)
							v_u_94.Visible = true
						end
						local v99 = v_u_94.AbsolutePosition
						local v100 = v_u_94.AbsoluteSize
						local v101 = p97.Position
						if p96 == false then
							local v102 = v99.X + v100.X * 0.5
							local v103 = v99.Y + v100.Y * 0.5
							v101 = Vector3.new(v102, v103, 0)
							v_u_94.Visible = false
						end
						joystick_position(v_u_94, v101)
						p_u_77(get_move_vector(v_u_94, v101))
					end, true))
					return
				end
				v_u_94.Position = v_u_94:GetAttribute("OriginalPosition") or v_u_94.Position
				v_u_94.Visible = v_u_94:GetAttribute("Visibility")
				v_u_95.Visible = false
				v_u_79:add(v_u_7.holding(v_u_94, function(p104, p105)
					-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_94, (ref) p_u_77
					local v106 = v_u_94.AbsolutePosition
					local v107 = v_u_94.AbsoluteSize

					end
					joystick_position(v_u_94, v108)
					p_u_77(get_move_vector(v_u_94, v108))
				end, true))
			end
		else
			return
		end
	end)
	return {
		["unhook"] = function() -- name: unhook

function v_u_8.holding(p114) -- name: holding
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_10
	local v115 = typeof(p114)
	if v115 == "string" then
		return v_u_7.get(p114).GuiState == Enum.GuiState.Press
	end
	if v115 == "EnumItem" then
		if p114.EnumType == Enum.KeyCode then
			return v_u_10:IsKeyDown(p114)
		end
		if p114.EnumType == Enum.UserInputType then
			return v_u_10:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType)
		end
	end
	return false
end

	end

end

		if p123 ~= p124 then
			p_u_121:SetAttribute("Connections", (p_u_121:GetAttribute("Connections") or 0) + (p123 and 1 or -1))

				v126 = p_u_121:GetAttribute("Visibility")
			else

	end
	local v127
	if p_u_121:GetAttribute("Connections") > 0 then

function v_u_8.update_key_image(p_u_135, p_u_136) -- name: update_key_image

			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_136, (copy) p_u_135, (ref) v_u_10

			if v139 and typeof(v139) == "EnumItem" then

					v144.Parent = p_u_135
					if string.find(v144.Name, "KeyCode") then
						p_u_135.BackgroundTransparency = 0
					else
						p_u_135.BackgroundTransparency = 1
					end
				end
				if v139.EnumType == Enum.KeyCode then

					if v145 and v145 ~= "" then

function get_keybind_override_change_event(p_u_158) -- name: get_keybind_override_change_event
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_2
	if p_u_158 ~= nil then
		local v159 = v_u_8.override_changed[p_u_158]
		if v159 == nil then
			v159 = v_u_2.new()
			v_u_8.override_changed[p_u_158] = v159
			v159:hook(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_158
				local v160 = get_action_keybind(p_u_158)
				for _, v161 in dictionaries do
					local v162 = v161.inputs[p_u_158]
					if not v162 then
						continue
					end
					local v163 = v162.key
					v162.key = v160
					local v164 = v161.keys[v163]
					if v164 then
						v164 = table.find(v161.keys[v163], v162)
					end
					if v164 then
						table.remove(v161.keys[v163], v164)
					end
					if not v160 then
						continue
					end
					v161.keys[v160] = v161.keys[v160] or {}
					local v165 = v161.keys[v160]
					table.insert(v165, v162)
				end
			end)
		end
		return v159
	end
end
function v_u_8.override_keybind(p166, p167, p168) -- name: override_keybind
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_8
	local v169 = v_u_8.override_keybinds[p167][p166]
	v_u_8.override_keybinds[p167][p166] = p168
	local v170 = p168 ~= v169 and get_keybind_override_change_event(p166)
	if v170 then
		v170:fire()
	end
end
function get_preferred_device(_) -- name: get_preferred_device
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_9
	local v171 = v_u_10.PreferredInput
	local v172 = v171 == Enum.PreferredInput.Touch and "mobile" or (v171 == Enum.PreferredInput.Gamepad and "console" or (v171 == Enum.PreferredInput.KeyboardAndMouse and "pc" or nil))
	if game.Workspace:GetAttribute("Devices") and not v_u_9:GetAttribute("Spectator") then
		local v173 = string.split(game.Workspace:GetAttribute("Devices"), ",")
		if #v173 > 0 and (not table.find(v173, "any") and v172 ~= v173[1]) then
			require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Loadout).notify((("This is a %* only lobby! You cannot change your input device"):format((string.upper(v173[1])))))
			return v173[1]
		end
	end
	return v172
end

function v_u_8.free_mouse(p177, p178) -- name: free_mouse
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_174, (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_8
	local v179 = v_u_174
	table.insert(v179, {
		["state"] = p177,
		["func"] = p178
	})
	p177:hook(function(_)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_174, (ref) v_u_10, (ref) v_u_8
		if not is_mouse_force_locked() then
			for _, v180 in v_u_174 do
				if not v180.func(v180.state:get()) then
					continue
				end
				v_u_10.MouseIconEnabled = true
				v_u_10.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
				return
			end
			local v181 = v_u_8.mouse_locked:get()
			v_u_10.MouseIconEnabled = not v181
			local v182 = v_u_10
			local v183
			if v181 then
				v183 = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
			else
				v183 = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
			end
			v182.MouseBehavior = v183
		end
	end)
end
function v_u_8.force_mouse_lock(p184, p185) -- name: force_mouse_lock
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_175, (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_174, (copy) v_u_8
	v_u_175[p184] = p185 and true or nil
	if is_mouse_force_locked() then
		v_u_10.MouseIconEnabled = false
		v_u_10.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
	else
		for _, v186 in v_u_174 do
			if not v186.func(v186.state:get()) then
				continue
			end
			v_u_10.MouseIconEnabled = true
			v_u_10.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default

		if p_u_50.owner then
			p_u_50:reload(p_u_50.owner, true)
		end
	end)
	p_u_50.states.accuracy:hook(function(_)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_50
		if p_u_50.accuracy then
			p_u_50.accuracy.Value = p_u_50.states.accuracy:get() - 1
		end
	end)
	p_u_50.states.cock:hook(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_50
		if p_u_50.owner then
			p_u_50:cock(p_u_50.owner, true)
		end
	end)
	p_u_50.states.melee:hook(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_50
		if p_u_50.owner then
			p_u_50:melee(p_u_50.owner)
		end
	end)
	p_u_50.states.shoot:hook(function(p57, p58)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_50
		if p_u_50.owner then
			p_u_50:shoot(p_u_50.owner, p57, p58)
		end
	end)
	p_u_50.states.hit:hook(function(p59, p60)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_50
		if p_u_50.owner then
			p_u_50:hit(p_u_50.owner, p59, p60)
		end
	end)
	p_u_50.states.loaded:hook(function(p61, p62)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_50
		if p61 == p62 or not p_u_50.owner then
			return
		elseif p61 and (p62 == false and not p_u_50.states.single_load:get()) then
			local v63 = p_u_50.states.mag_size:get()
			local v64 = p_u_50.states.bullets
			local v_u_65 = math.min(v63, v64:get())
			p_u_50.states.mag:update(function(p66)
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_65
				return p66 + v_u_65
			end)
			p_u_50.states.bullets:update(function(p67)
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_65
				return p67 - v_u_65
			end)
		elseif p62 then
			local v68 = p_u_50.instance:FindFirstChild("BulletEject", true)
			if v68 then
				v68 = p_u_50.feed_cover == nil
			end
			local v69 = p_u_50.states.mag:get() - (v68 and 1 or 0)
			local v_u_70 = math.max(0, v69)
			p_u_50.states.mag:update(function(p71)
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_70
				return p71 - v_u_70
			end)
			p_u_50.states.bullets:update(function(p72)
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_70
				return p72 + v_u_70
			end)
		end
	end)
	p_u_50.states.load_bullet:hook(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_50
		if p_u_50.owner and p_u_50.states.single_load:get() then
			p_u_50.states.mag:update(function(p73)
				return p73 + 1
			end)
			p_u_50.states.bullets:update(function(p74)
				return p74 - 1
			end)
		end
	end)
	p_u_50.states.chambered:hook(function(p75, p76)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_50
		if p75 ~= p76 then
			if p_u_50.owner then
				p_u_50:chamber(p_u_50.owner, p75)
			end
		end
	end)
	p_u_50:hook_attachment_states()
	p_u_50.safety:hook(function(p77, p78)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_50
		if p_u_50.owner then
			p_u_50:safety_function(p_u_50.owner, p77, p78)
		end
	end)
	local v_u_79 = v_u_15.new()
	p_u_50.object:destroying(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_79
		v_u_79:clean()
	end)
	v_u_79:add(p_u_50.owner.values.camera:hook(function(p80, p81)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_50
		if p_u_50.states.sights:get() then
			if p80 then
				p_u_50:update_sight_lens(true)
			elseif p81 then
				p_u_50:update_sight_lens(false)
			end
		else
			return
		end
	end).unhook)
	v_u_79:add(p_u_50.owner.values.camera:hook(function(p82, p83)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_50, (ref) v_u_9, (ref) v_u_10
		if p_u_50.states.sights:get() then
			if p82 == game.Workspace.CurrentCamera then
				v_u_9.tween(v_u_10.get("RedDot").UIStroke, TweenInfo.new(0), {
					["Transparency"] = 1
				})
				local v84 = workspace.CurrentCamera
				v_u_9.tween(v84, TweenInfo.new(0, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
					["FieldOfView"] = v84:GetAttribute("OriginalFOV") / p_u_50.states.zoom:get()
				})
			elseif p82 == nil and p83 == game.Workspace.CurrentCamera then
				local v85 = workspace.CurrentCamera
				v_u_9.tween(v85, TweenInfo.new(0, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
					["FieldOfView"] = v85:GetAttribute("OriginalFOV")
				})
			end
		else
			return
		end
	end).unhook)
end

function v_u_3.sights(p_u_90, p91, p92) -- name: sights
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_10
	p_u_90.sound.Handle(p_u_90.instance.Root)
	local v93 = p91.values.cframes:get("arm1"):get_offset("sights")
	local v94 = p91.values.cframes:get("arm2"):get_offset("sights")
	local v95 = p_u_90.cframes:get(p_u_90.instance.Root):get_offset("sights")
	local v96 = p_u_90.states.ads:get()
	if p92 then
		local v97 = false
		if p91.values.holding and p91.values.holding.safety then
			if p91.values.holding.states.ads then
				v96 = v96 + p91.values.holding.states.ads:get()
			end
			if p91.states.holding:get() == p91.values.holding.instance then
				p91.values.holding.safety:set(true)
				v97 = true
			end
		end
		p_u_90:reload(p91, false)
		p91.values.cframes:get("arm1"):set_offset("sights")
		if not v97 then
			p91.values.cframes:get("arm2"):set_offset("sights")
		end
		p_u_90.anim.Equip.arm1_hold(p91.values.cframes:get("arm1"):set_absolute("sights", true), p_u_90, v96)
		p_u_90.cframes:get(p_u_90.instance.Root):set_offset("sights")
		p_u_90.anim.Sight.arm1(v93, p_u_90.instance, v96)
		p_u_90.anim.Sight.arm2(v94, p_u_90.instance, v96)
		p_u_90.anim.Sight.gun(v95, p_u_90.instance, v96)
		if p91.values.camera:get() then
			if p_u_90.inputs and p_u_90.inputs.enabled:get() then
				local v98 = string.gsub
				local v99 = p_u_90.states.zoom
				local v100 = ("camera_sensitivity_%*"):format((v98(tostring(v99:get()), "[.]", "_")))
				if v_u_12.settings[v100] then
					v_u_4.mouse_base_sensitivity:set(v_u_9.map_sensitivity(v_u_12.settings[v100]))
					task.spawn(function()
						-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_90, (ref) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_9, (ref) v_u_12
						while p_u_90.states.sights:get() do
							p_u_90.states.sights:wait()
						end
						v_u_4.mouse_base_sensitivity:set(v_u_9.map_sensitivity(v_u_12.settings.camera_sensitivity))
					end)
				end
			end
			v_u_9.tween(p_u_90.accuracy, TweenInfo.new(v96, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
				["Value"] = 1
			})
			return
		end
	else
		p91.values.cframes:get("arm1"):remove_absolute("sights")
		if p91.values.holding and (p91.values.holding.safety and not p91.values.equip_debounce:get()) then
			p91.values.holding.safety:set(false)
			if p91.values.holding.states.ads then
				v96 = v96 + p91.values.holding.states.ads:get()
			end
		end
		if p91.values.camera:get() then
			v_u_9.tween(p_u_90.accuracy, TweenInfo.new(v96, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
				["Value"] = p_u_90.states.accuracy:get() - 1
			})
		end
		if p_u_90.inputs and p_u_90.inputs.enabled:get() then
			v_u_10.get("CancelScope").Visible = false
		end
		p_u_90.anim.Sight.base(v95, p_u_90.instance, v96)
		p_u_90.anim.Sight.base(v94, p_u_90.instance, v96)
		p_u_90.anim.Sight.base(v93, p_u_90.instance, v96).Completed:Wait()
		if v93.Value == CFrame.new() then
			p91.values.cframes:get("arm1"):remove_offset("sights")
			p91.values.cframes:get("arm2"):remove_offset("sights")
		end
		p_u_90.cframes:get(p_u_90.instance.Root):remove_offset("sights")
	end
end

function v_u_3.chamber(p107, _, p108) -- name: chamber
	if p107.slide then
		local v109 = p107.cframes:get(p107.slide):get_offset("shoot")
		if p108 then
			p107.anim.Gun.slide_off(v109)
		else
			p107.anim.Gun.slide_on(v109).Completed:Wait()
		end
	end
	if not p107.states.single_load:get() and p108 then
		p107.sound.Reload4(p107.instance.Root)
	end
end
function v_u_3.render(p110, p111, p112) -- name: render
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_8
	local v113 = p110.cframes
	v_u_8.pivot(p110.instance.Root, v113:get(p110.instance.Root):render(p112))
	v_u_8.flush()
	if p110.hammer then
		v_u_8.pivot(p110.hammer, v113:get(p110.hammer):render(p112))
	end
	if p110.feed_cover then
		v_u_8.pivot(p110.feed_cover, v113:get(p110.feed_cover):render(p112))
	end
	if p110.slide then
		v_u_8.pivot(p110.slide, v113:get(p110.slide):render(p112))
	end
	if p110.load_slide then
		v_u_8.pivot(p110.load_slide, v113:get(p110.load_slide):render(p112))
	end
	if p110.magazine then
		v_u_8.pivot(p110.magazine, v113:get(p110.magazine):render(p112))
	elseif p110.cylinder then
		v_u_8.pivot(p110.cylinder, v113:get(p110.cylinder):render(p112))
		if p110.loader and p110.loader.Parent == p111.values.viewmodels then
			v_u_8.pivot(p110.loader.Case, v113:get(p110.loader.Case):render(p112))
		end
	end
	if p110.end_bullet then
		v_u_8.pivot(p110.end_bullet, v113:get(p110.end_bullet):render(p112))
	end
	if p110.charm_model and p110.charm_model.PrimaryPart then
		v_u_8.pivot(p110.charm_model.PrimaryPart, v113:get(p110.charm_model.PrimaryPart):render(p112))
	end
	v_u_8.flush()
	if p110.inputs and p110.inputs.enabled:get() then
		p110:input_render(p112)
	end
end
function v_u_3.auto_shoot_check(p114, _) -- name: auto_shoot_check
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_5
	local v115 = os.clock()
	if v115 - p114.auto_shoot_dt > 0.25 then
		p114.auto_shoot_dt = v115
		if v_u_10.get("Flash").Frame.BackgroundTransparency == 0 then
			return
		end
		local v116 = p114.owner
		local v117 = p114:get_shoot_look()
		local v118 = CFrame.new(v_u_9.validate_position(game.Workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position, v117.Position, v116.values.ray_params)) * v117.Rotation
		for _, v119 in p114:ray_damage(v118.Position, v118.LookVector * 500, { v116.values.viewmodels, v116.instance }, nil, true) do
			local v120 = v119.Instance
			if v119.HitHum then
				p114:input_shoot(true)
			else
				if not v120 or v120.Transparency >= 1 then
					continue
				end
				local v121 = v_u_9.get_breakable_instance(v120)
				if not v121 or v_u_9.ownership(v_u_5.get("Breakable", v121).owner:get()) ~= 0 then
					continue
				end
				p114:input_shoot(true)
			end
		end
		if p114.shoot_hold and not (p114.inputs:get("shoot"):holding() or p114.inputs:get("shoot_joystick"):holding()) then
			p114:input_shoot(false)
		end
	end
end
function v_u_3.input_render(p122, _) -- name: input_render
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_12
	local v123 = p122.owner
	if v123.values.prone_debounce or (v123.values.equip_debounce:get() or v123.states.vault:get() > 0) then
		p122:reload(v123, false)
		p122:cock(v123, false)
	elseif not p122.cock_thread.running and (not p122.reload_thread.running and (not p122.states.chambered:get() and (not v123.values.equip_debounce:get() and (not p122.states.reload:get() and (v123.states.vault:get() == 0 and (p122.states.loaded:get() and p122.states.mag:get() > 0)))))) then
		p122.states.cock:fire_instant()
	end
	local _ = v123.values.viewmodels.head
	if not v_u_12.settings.toggle_aim then
		if p122.ads_hold and not (p122.reload_thread.running or (p122.meleeing or (v123.states.running:get() or (v123.values.prone_debounce or v123.values.equip_debounce:get())))) then
			p122.states.sights:set(true)
		else
			p122.states.sights:set(false)
		end
	end
	if p122.automatic and (p122.shoot_hold and p122.burst == nil or p122.burst_left and p122.burst_left > 0) and ((not p122.safety:get() or p122.accuracy.Value >= 1) and not (v123.values.equip_debounce:get() or v123.states.running:get())) then
		local v124 = v123.values.holding
		if v124 and (v124.safety and not v124.safety:get()) then
			return
		end
		local v125 = os.clock()
		local v126 = p122.states.firerate:get()
		if v126 == 0 or v125 - p122.last_shot > 1 / (v126 / 60) then
			if p122.states.mag:get() > 0 and p122.states.chambered:get() then
				p122.last_shot = v125
				p122:send_shoot()
				if p122.burst_left then
					p122.burst_left = p122.burst_left - 1
					if p122.burst_left == 0 then
						p122.last_shot = p122.last_shot + 1 / (v126 / 60)
					end
				end
			else
				p122.burst_left = 0
			end
		end
	end
	if p122.states.reload:get() and v123.values.equip_debounce:get() then
		p122:reload(v123, false)
	end
end
function v_u_3.kickback(p127, p128) -- name: kickback
	local v129 = p128.values.cframes:get("arms"):set_offset("shoot")
	p127.anim.Shoot.key1(v129).Completed:Wait()
	p127.anim.Shoot.key2(v129).Completed:Wait()
	p127.anim.Shoot.key3(v129).Completed:Wait()
	p128.values.cframes:get("arms"):remove_offset("shoot")
end
function v_u_3.recoil_function(p130, p131) -- name: recoil_function
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_9
	p131.values.cframes:get("camera"):remove_offset("shoot")
	local v132 = p131.values.cframes:get("camera"):set_offset("shoot")
	local v133 = v132.Value
	if p131.values.camera:get() then
		local v134 = p131.values
		v134.old_cam_render = v134.old_cam_render * v133:Inverse()
	end
	local v135 = p130.states.recoil_up:get()
	local v136 = p130.states.recoil_side:get()
	if v_u_4.current_device:get() ~= "pc" then
		v135 = v135 * 0.7
		v136 = v136 * 0.7
	end
	if p130.prone_recoil and p131.states.walk_state:get() == "prone" then
		v135 = v135 * p130.prone_recoil
		v136 = v136 * p130.prone_recoil
	end
	v_u_9.tween(v132, TweenInfo.new(0), {
		["Value"] = CFrame.new()
	})
	v132.Value = CFrame.new()
	if p131.values.cframes:get("arm2"):current_pivot() == "equipped" then
		v135 = v135 * 0.8
	else
		v136 = v136 * 1.2
	end
	local v137 = CFrame.Angles
	local v138 = v_u_9.rand(v135 * 1, v135 * 2)
	local v139 = math.rad(v138)
	local v140 = v_u_9.rand(-v136 * 1, v136 * 1)
	local v141 = v137(v139, math.rad(v140), 0)
	local v142 = (v135 + v136) / 30
	local v143 = math.exp(v142)
	local v144 = 60 / p130.states.firerate:get()
	local v145 = math.min(0.1, v144)
	local v146 = v143 * 0.06
	local v147 = math.max(v145, v146)
	local v148 = v143 * 0.24
	v_u_9.tween(v132, TweenInfo.new(v147, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		["Value"] = v141
	}).Completed:Wait()
	v_u_9.tween(v132, TweenInfo.new(v148, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		["Value"] = CFrame.new()
	}).Completed:Wait()
end
function v_u_3.shoot(p_u_149, p_u_150, _, p151) -- name: shoot
	p_u_149.states.mag:update(function(p152)
		local v153 = p152 - 1
		return math.max(0, v153)
	end)
	if p_u_149.states.firerate:get() == 0 then
		p_u_149.states.chambered:set(false)
	else
		local v154 = p_u_149.instance:FindFirstChild("BulletEject", true)
		if v154 then
			p_u_149:eject_bullet(v154, p_u_149.bullet_type)
		end
	end
	if p_u_149.supressed then
		p_u_149.sound.SilencedShoot(p_u_149.shot)
	else
		p_u_149.sound.Shoot(p_u_149.shot)
	end
	p_u_149:reload(p_u_150, false)
	local v155 = p_u_149.states.pellets:get() > 1
	if p_u_149.owner.values.camera:get() == nil and (not v155 and (p151 and #p151 > 0)) then
		for _, v156 in p151 do
			if #v156 <= 0 then
				continue
			end
			p_u_149:trail(p_u_149.shot.CFrame.Position, v156[#v156].Position)
		end
	end
	task.spawn(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_149, (copy) p_u_150
		p_u_149:kickback(p_u_150)
	end)
	if p_u_150.values.camera:get() then
		p_u_149.recoil(p_u_149, p_u_150)
	end
	task.spawn(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_149
		local v157 = p_u_149.shot:FindFirstChild("Smoke")
		if v157 then
			for _ = 1, 3 do
				v157:Emit(1)
				task.wait(0.1)
			end
		end
	end)
	if p_u_149.shot:FindFirstChild("Flash") then
		p_u_149:flash()
	end
	if p_u_149.states.firerate:get() > 0 then
		p_u_149:slide_shoot()
	end
	if p_u_149.hammer then
		task.spawn(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_149
			local v158 = p_u_149.cframes:get(p_u_149.hammer):set_offset("shoot")
			p_u_149.anim.Gun.hammer_on(v158).Completed:Wait()
			p_u_149.anim.Gun.hammer_off(v158).Completed:Wait()
			p_u_149.cframes:get(p_u_149.hammer):remove_offset("shoot")
		end)
	end
	if p151 then
		p_u_149:bullet_hit(p_u_150, p151)
	end
end
function v_u_3.bullet_hit(p159, _, p160) -- name: bullet_hit
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_15, (copy) v_u_5
	for _, v161 in p160 do
		if #v161 == 0 then
			continue
		end
		local v162 = {}
		for _, v163 in v161 do
			local v164 = v163.Instance
			if v164 == nil then
				continue
			end
			if v164:HasTag("Water") and not v164.CanCollide then
				local v165 = v163.Position
				local v166 = Instance.new("Attachment")
				v_u_9.debris(v166, 2)
				local v167 = v164.Size.X
				local v168 = v164.Size.Y
				local v169 = v164.Size.Z
				local v170 = math.min(v167, v168, v169)
				v166.WorldCFrame = CFrame.new(v165.X, v164.CFrame.Y + v170 * 0.5, v165.Z)
				v166.Parent = game.Workspace.Terrain
				v_u_16.Ring(v166, v164.Color)
				v_u_16.Splash(v166, 3, v164.Color)
				v_u_16.WaterSplash(v166)
			else
				if not v163.HitHum or (not v164.Parent or v162[v164.Parent]) then
					continue
				end
				v162[v164.Parent] = true
				local v171 = Instance.new("Attachment")
				v171.Parent = game.Workspace.Terrain
				v171.WorldCFrame = CFrame.new(v163.Position) * CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), v163.Normal)
				v_u_9.debris(v171, 1)
				p159:emit_blood(v171, v164.Color)
				p159.sound.BulletHit(v171)
			end
		end
		local v172 = v161[#v161]
		if not v172 then
			break
		end
		local v173 = v172.Instance
		local v174 = v172.Normal
		local v175 = v172.Position
		if v172.HitHum or (not v173 or (v173.Transparency >= 1 or not v173.Anchored)) then
			break
		end
		local v_u_176 = v_u_16.create_point(v175, v174, math.random(8, 12))
		local v_u_177 = v_u_9.get_breakable_instance(v173)
		if v_u_177 then
			local v_u_178 = v_u_15.new()
			v_u_178:add(v_u_5.get("Breakable", v_u_177).states.destroyed:hook(function(p179)
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_176
				if p179 then
					task.defer(function()
						-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_176
						v_u_176:Destroy()
					end)
				end
			end).unhook)
			v_u_178:add(v_u_177.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_177, (copy) v_u_176
				if v_u_177.Parent == nil or v_u_177.Parent == game.ReplicatedStorage.Garbage then
					task.defer(function()
						-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_176
						v_u_176:Destroy()
					end)
				end
			end))
			v_u_176.Destroying:Connect(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_178
				v_u_178:clean()
			end)
		end
		local v180 = script.BulletHoles.Normal:Clone()
		v180.Parent = v_u_176
		v180.Color = ColorSequence.new(v173.Color)
		v180:Emit(2)
	end
end
function v_u_3.slide_shoot(p181) -- name: slide_shoot
	if p181.slide then
		local v182 = p181.cframes:get(p181.slide):get_offset("shoot")
		p181.anim.Gun.slide_on(v182).Completed:Wait()
		if p181.states.mag:get() > 0 then
			p181.anim.Gun.slide_off(v182).Completed:Wait()
		end
		if p181.states.mag:get() == 0 then
			p181.states.chambered:set(false)
			p181.sound.Empty(p181.instance.Root)
			return
		end
	elseif p181.load_slide then
		local v183 = p181.cframes:get(p181.load_slide):get_offset("shoot")
		p181.anim.Gun.slide_on(v183).Completed:Wait()
		p181.anim.Gun.slide_off(v183).Completed:Wait()
		if p181.states.mag:get() == 0 then
			p181.states.chambered:set(false)
			p181.sound.Empty(p181.instance.Root)
		end
	end
end
function v_u_3.melee(p184, p185, _) -- name: melee
	p184:reload(p185, false)
	p184:cock(p185, false)
	p184.meleeing = true
	local v186 = p185.values.cframes:get("arm1"):set_absolute("melee", true)
	local v187 = nil
	if p184.anim.Melee.arm2_hold then
		local v188 = p185.values.cframes:get("arm2"):set_absolute("melee", true)
		p184.anim.Melee.arm2_hold(v188)
	else
		p185.values.cframes:get("arm2"):set_absolute("melee", CFrame.new())
		p185.values.cframes:get("arm2"):set_pivot("base")
	end
	if p184.anim.Melee.gun_hold then
		v187 = p184.cframes:get(p184.instance.Root):set_absolute("melee", true)
		p184.anim.Melee.gun_hold(v187)
	end
	p184.sound.Handle(p184.instance.Root)
	p184.anim.Melee.arm1_hold(v186).Completed:Wait()
	p185.values.cframes:get("arm1"):remove_absolute("melee")
	p185.values.cframes:get("arm2"):remove_absolute("melee")
	if not p184.anim.Melee.arm2_hold then
		p185.values.cframes:get("arm2"):remove_pivot("base")
	end
	if v187 then
		p184.cframes:get(p184.instance.Root):remove_absolute("melee")
	end
end
function v_u_3.hit(p189, p190, p191, p192) -- name: hit
	local v193 = p190.values.cframes:get("arm1"):set_absolute("melee")
	local v194 = nil
	local v195
	if p189.anim.Melee.arm2_hit then
		v195 = p190.values.cframes:get("arm2"):set_absolute("melee")
	else
		v195 = nil
	end
	if p189.anim.Melee.gun_hit then
		v194 = p189.cframes:get(p189.instance.Root):set_absolute("melee")
	end
	if p189:process_hit_results(p191, p192) then
		p189.sound.Swing(p189.instance.Root)
		if v194 then
			p189.anim.Melee.gun_miss(v194)
		end
		if v195 then
			p189.anim.Melee.arm2_miss(v195)
		end
		p189.anim.Melee.arm1_miss(v193).Completed:Wait()
	else
		if v194 then
			p189.anim.Melee.gun_hit(v194)
		end
		if v195 then
			p189.anim.Melee.arm2_hit(v195)
		end
		p189.anim.Melee.arm1_hit(v193).Completed:Wait()
	end
	p190.values.cframes:get("arm1"):remove_absolute("melee")
	if v195 then
		p190.values.cframes:get("arm2"):remove_absolute("melee")
	end
	if v194 then
		p189.cframes:get(p189.instance.Root):remove_absolute("melee")
	end
	p189.meleeing = false
end
function v_u_3.safety_function(p196, p197, p198, p199) -- name: safety_function
	local v200 = p197.values.cframes:get("arm1"):get_absolute("equipped")
	local v201 = p197.values.cframes:get("arm2"):get_absolute("equipped")
	if p198 == true then
		p196.anim.Equip.arm1_hold_safety(v200)
		if p199 == false then
			p197.values.cframes:get("arm2"):remove_pivot("equipped")
			p197.values.cframes:get("arm2"):remove_absolute("equipped")
			return
		end
	elseif p198 == false then
		p197.values.cframes:get("arm2"):set_absolute("equipped", true)
		p197.values.cframes:get("arm2"):set_pivot("equipped")
		p196.anim.Equip.arm2_hold(v201, p196)
		p196.anim.Equip.arm1_hold(v200, p196).Completed:Wait()
	end
end
function v_u_3.equip(p202, p203, p204) -- name: equip
	local v205 = p203.values.cframes:get("arm1"):get_absolute("equipped")
	p203.values.cframes:get("arm2"):get_absolute("equipped")
	local v206 = p202.instance:FindFirstChild("Root")
	if v206 == nil then
		return
	elseif p204 == true then
		p202:unholster(p203)
		p203.values.cframes:get("arm1"):set_absolute("equipped", true)
		p202.anim.Equip.arm1_grab(v205).Completed:Wait()
		p202.sound.Equip(v206)
		p202.cframes:get(v206):set_pivot("equipped")
		p202.cframes:get(v206).pivot_time = 0.2
		p203.values.cframes:get("arm1"):set_pivot("equipped")
		local v207 = p202.safety
		local v208 = p203.values.holding
		if v208 then
			if p203.states.holding:get() == p203.values.holding.instance then
				v208 = p203.values.holding.loadout_type == "primary"
			else
				v208 = false
			end
		end
		v207:set_instant(v208)
	else
		p202.states.sights:set(false)
		p202:reload(p203, false)
		p202:cock(p203, false)
		p202.sound.Handle(v206)
		p202.burst_left = nil
		p203.values.cframes:get("arm1"):remove_pivot("equipped")
		if p202.safety:get() == false then
			p203.values.cframes:get("arm2"):remove_pivot("equipped")
			p203.values.cframes:get("arm2"):remove_absolute("equipped")
		end
		p202.safety:set_instant(nil)
		if p203.values.holding and p203.values.holding.safety then
			p203.values.holding.safety:set(false)
		end
		p202.anim.Equip.arm1_grab(v205).Completed:Wait()
		p202.cframes:get(v206).pivot_time = 0.2
		p202.cframes:get(v206):remove_pivot("equipped")
		p203.values.cframes:get("arm1"):remove_absolute("equipped")
		p202:holster(p203)
	end
end
function v_u_3.trail(p209, p210, p211, _) -- name: trail
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_9
	local v212 = Instance.new("Attachment")
	local v213 = Instance.new("Attachment")
	v_u_9.debris(v212, 0.5)
	v_u_9.debris(v213, 0.5)
	v212.Parent = workspace.Terrain
	v213.Parent = workspace.Terrain
	v212.Position = p210
	v213.Position = p211
	local v214 = Instance.new("Beam", game.Workspace)
	v_u_9.debris(v214, 0.5)
	v214.Width0 = p209.states.trail_size:get() or 0.1
	v214.Width1 = p209.states.trail_size:get() or 0.1
	v214.Attachment0 = v212
	v214.Attachment1 = v213
	if p209.supressed then
		v214.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.95) })
	else
		v214.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.75) })
	end
	v_u_9.tween(v214, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, 0, false, 0), {
		["Width0"] = 0,
		["Width1"] = 0
	})
	if p209.owner.values.camera:get() == nil then
		local v215 = Instance.new("Attachment")
		v_u_9.debris(v215, 0.5)
		v215.Parent = workspace.Terrain
		v215.WorldCFrame = CFrame.new(v_u_9.closest_point_on_segment(game.Workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position, v212.WorldCFrame.Position, v213.WorldCFrame.Position))
		local v216 = (p210 - p211).Magnitude
		local v217 = p209.sound.BulletWoosh(v215)
		local v218 = v216 / 50
		v217.Volume = math.min(1, v218) * 0.5
	end
end
local v_u_219 = v_u_9.create_debris_queue("casings", 16, 5)
function v_u_3.eject_bullet(_, p220, p221, _) -- name: eject_bullet
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_219, (copy) v_u_16
	if not v_u_12.settings or v_u_12.settings.debris then
		local v222 = script.Bullets[p221]:Clone()
		v222.Parent = workspace
		v222.CanCollide = true
		v222:PivotTo(p220.WorldCFrame)
		v222.AssemblyLinearVelocity = p220.WorldCFrame.RightVector * math.random(8, 12) + p220.WorldCFrame.UpVector * math.random(8, 12)
		v222.CastShadow = false
		v222.CanQuery = false
		v_u_219:add_item(v222)
		v_u_16.mark_for_killcam(v222)
		return v222
	end
end
function v_u_3.setup_shot(_, p223) -- name: setup_shot
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_9
	local v224 = script.Shot:Clone()
	v224.Flash.Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.3), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.3) })
	v224.Parent = p223.Parent
	v224.CFrame = p223.WorldCFrame
	v_u_9.weld_c(v224, p223.Parent)
	return v224
end
function v_u_3.hide_mag(p225, p226) -- name: hide_mag
	if p226 then
		p225.magazine.Parent = nil
	else
		p225.magazine.Parent = p225.instance
	end
end
function v_u_3.reload_begin(p_u_227, p_u_228) -- name: reload_begin
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_9
	p_u_227.sound.Handle(p_u_227.instance.Root)
	p_u_227.safety:set(false)
	local v229 = p_u_228.values.cframes:get("arm1"):set_absolute("reload", true)
	local v230 = p_u_228.values.cframes:get("arm2"):set_absolute("reload", true)
	local v231 = p_u_227.cframes:get(p_u_227.instance.Root):set_absolute("reload", true)
	local v232 = p_u_227.states.reload_speed:get()
	local v233 = false
	if p_u_227.feed_cover then
		p_u_227.anim.Reload.arm2_empty1(v230, v232)
		p_u_227.anim.Reload.gun_empty1(v231, v232)
		p_u_227.anim.Reload.arm1_empty1(v229, v232).Completed:Wait()
		local v234 = p_u_227.cframes:get(p_u_227.feed_cover):get_offset("reload")
		p_u_227.sound.FeedOpen(p_u_227.instance.Root)
		v_u_9.tween(v234, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
			["Value"] = CFrame.Angles(0, -0.5235987755982988, 0)
		})
		p_u_227.anim.Reload.arm2_empty2(v230, v232).Completed:Wait()
		if p_u_227.states.loaded:get() and not p_u_227.states.single_load:get() then
			p_u_227.anim.Reload.arm1_start(v229, v232)
			p_u_227.anim.Reload.gun(v231, v232)
			p_u_227.anim.Reload.arm2_start(v230, v232).Completed:Wait()
			if p_u_227.magazine then
				if p_u_227.end_bullet then
					p_u_227.cframes:get(p_u_227.end_bullet):set_pivot("unloaded")
				end
				p_u_227.cframes:get(p_u_227.magazine):set_pivot("reload")
				p_u_227.sound.Reload1(p_u_227.instance.Root)
				p_u_227.states.loaded:set(false)
				v233 = true
			end
		else
			p_u_227.anim.Reload.gun(v231, v232)
		end
	elseif p_u_227.cylinder then
		p_u_227.anim.Reload.arm1_start(v229, v232)
		p_u_227.anim.Reload.gun(v231, v232)
		p_u_227.anim.Reload.arm2_start(v230, v232).Completed:Wait()
		local v235 = p_u_227.cframes:get(p_u_227.cylinder):get_offset("reload")
		p_u_227.sound.Reload1(p_u_227.instance.Root)
		p_u_227.anim.Reload.cylinder_open(v235, v232)
		if p_u_227.states.loaded:get() then
			if p_u_227.anim.Reload.arm1_empty1 then
				p_u_227.anim.Reload.arm2_empty1(v230, v232)
				p_u_227.anim.Reload.arm1_empty1(v229, v232).Completed:Wait()
			end
			if p_u_227.cylinder:FindFirstChild("Eject") then
				for _ = 1, p_u_227.states.mag_size:get() do
					p_u_227:eject_bullet(p_u_227.cylinder.Eject, p_u_227.bullet_type, CFrame.Angles(0, 1.5707963267948966, 1.5707963267948966))
				end
				p_u_227.sound.Cases(p_u_227.instance.Root)
			end
			p_u_227.states.loaded:set(false)
			v233 = true
			if p_u_227.anim.Reload.arm1_empty2 then
				p_u_227.anim.Reload.arm2_empty2(v230, v232)
				p_u_227.anim.Reload.arm1_empty2(v229, v232).Completed:Wait()
			end
		end
	elseif p_u_227.states.loaded:get() and not p_u_227.states.single_load:get() then
		p_u_227:cock(p_u_228, false)
		p_u_227.anim.Reload.arm1_start(v229, v232)
		p_u_227.anim.Reload.gun(v231, v232)
		p_u_227.anim.Reload.arm2_start(v230, v232).Completed:Wait()
		if p_u_227.magazine then
			if p_u_227.end_bullet then
				p_u_227.cframes:get(p_u_227.end_bullet):set_pivot("unloaded")
			end
			p_u_227.cframes:get(p_u_227.magazine):set_pivot("reload")
			p_u_227.sound.Reload1(p_u_227.instance.Root)
			p_u_227.states.loaded:set(false)
			v233 = true
		end
	else
		p_u_227.anim.Reload.gun(v231, v232)
		if p_u_227.magazine then
			if p_u_227.end_bullet then
				p_u_227.cframes:get(p_u_227.end_bullet):set_pivot("unloaded")
			end
			p_u_227.cframes:get(p_u_227.magazine):set_pivot("reload")
			v233 = true
		end
	end
	local v236 = p_u_227.states.mag_size:get() - p_u_227.states.mag:get() + (p_u_227.states.chambered:get() and not p_u_227.cylinder and 1 or 0)
	local v237 = p_u_227.states.bullets
	local v238 = math.min(v236, v237:get())
	if v238 > 0 then
		p_u_227:cock(p_u_228, false)
	end
	for v239 = 1, v238 do
		p_u_227.anim.Reload.arm1_idle1(v229, v232)
		if v233 and p_u_227.anim.Reload.arm2_start2 then
			p_u_227.anim.Reload.arm2_start2(v230, v232).Completed:Wait()
		end
		p_u_228.values.cframes:get("arm2"):set_pivot("reload")
		p_u_227.anim.Reload.base(v230, v232)
		if p_u_227.anim.Reload.gun_idle then
			p_u_227.anim.Reload.gun_idle(v231, v232)
		end
		if p_u_227.states.single_load:get() then
			task.wait(0.15 * v232)
			p_u_227.single_bullet = script.Bullets[p_u_227.bullet_load_type or p_u_227.bullet_type]:Clone()
			p_u_227.single_bullet.Parent = p_u_228.values.viewmodels
			p_u_227.single_bullet.CanCollide = false
			p_u_227.single_bullet:PivotTo(p_u_228.values.viewmodels.arm2.CFrame * p_u_227.hold_bullet_offset)
			v_u_9.weld_c(p_u_227.single_bullet, p_u_228.values.viewmodels.arm2)
		else
			task.wait(0.5 * v232)
			if p_u_227.cylinder and p_u_227.loader then
				p_u_227.loader.Bullets.Transparency = 0
				p_u_227.loader.Parent = p_u_228.values.viewmodels
				p_u_227.loader.Case:PivotTo(p_u_227.cframes:get(p_u_227.loader.Case):render(0.016666666666666666))
			end
		end
		p_u_228.values.cframes:get("arm2"):remove_pivot("reload")
		p_u_227.anim.Reload.arm1_idle2(v229, v232)
		p_u_227.anim.Reload.arm2_idle(v230, v232).Completed:Wait()
		if p_u_227.magazine then
			p_u_227.cframes:get(p_u_227.magazine):remove_pivot("reload")
			p_u_227:hide_mag(false)
			p_u_227.sound.Reload2(p_u_227.instance.Root)
			if p_u_227.feed_cover then
				p_u_227.anim.Reload.arm2_finish(v230, v232)
				p_u_227.anim.Reload.arm1_finish(v229, v232).Completed:Wait()
				p_u_227.sound.Chains(p_u_227.instance.Root)
				if p_u_227.end_bullet then
					p_u_227.cframes:get(p_u_227.end_bullet):remove_pivot("unloaded")
					for _, v240 in p_u_227.end_bullet:GetChildren() do
						if not v240:IsA("BasePart") then
							continue
						end
						v240.Transparency = 0
					end
				end
				p_u_227.anim.Reload.arm2_empty1_2(v230, v232)
				p_u_227.anim.Reload.arm1_empty1(v229, v232).Completed:Wait()
				p_u_227.states.loaded:set(true)
				p_u_227.anim.Reload.gun_empty1(v231, v232)
				p_u_227.anim.Reload.arm2_empty2(v230, v232).Completed:Wait()
				local v241 = p_u_227.cframes:get(p_u_227.feed_cover):get_offset("reload")
				p_u_227.sound.FeedClose(p_u_227.instance.Root)
				v_u_9.tween(v241, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
					["Value"] = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0)
				})
				p_u_227.anim.Reload.arm2_empty1_3(v230, v232).Completed:Wait()
			else
				p_u_227.states.loaded:set(true)
				p_u_227.anim.Reload.arm2_finish(v230, v232)
				p_u_227.anim.Reload.arm1_finish(v229, v232).Completed:Wait()
			end
		elseif p_u_227.states.single_load:get() then
			p_u_227.sound.Reload2(p_u_227.instance.Root)
			p_u_227.single_bullet:Destroy()
			if not p_u_227.cylinder then
				p_u_227.states.loaded:set(true)
				p_u_227.states.load_bullet:fire()
			end
			p_u_227.anim.Reload.arm2_finish(v230, v232)
			p_u_227.anim.Reload.arm1_finish(v229, v232).Completed:Wait()
			if p_u_227.cylinder then
				p_u_227.states.loaded:set(true)
				p_u_227.states.load_bullet:fire()
			end
			if p_u_227.cylinder and (v239 == v238 or (p_u_227.states.mag:get() >= p_u_227.states.mag_size:get() or p_u_227.states.bullets:get() <= 0)) then
				if p_u_227.loader then
					p_u_227.anim.Reload.arm1_start(v229, v232)
					p_u_227.anim.Reload.gun(v231, v232)
					p_u_227.anim.Reload.arm2_start(v230, v232).Completed:Wait()
					p_u_227.sound.Reload1(p_u_227.instance.Root)
					local v242 = p_u_227.cframes:get(p_u_227.cylinder):get_offset("reload")
					p_u_227.anim.Reload.cylinder_close(v242, v232)
				else
					p_u_227.anim.Reload.gun(v231, v232)
					if p_u_227.anim.Reload.arm1_empty2 then
						p_u_227.anim.Reload.arm2_empty2(v230, v232)
						p_u_227.anim.Reload.arm1_empty2(v229, v232).Completed:Wait()
					end
					if p_u_227.anim.Reload.arm1_empty1 then
						p_u_227.anim.Reload.arm2_empty1(v230, v232)

function get_circular_spread(p273, p274) -- name: get_circular_spread

function v_u_3.equip(p47, p48, p49) -- name: equip

	end
end

function v_u_3.prepare(p98, p99) -- name: prepare
	local v100 = p98.owner
	local v101 = p98:can_take_down(v100, true)
	if p99 and v101 then
		local v102 = (p98.owner.values.equipped == p98.owner.values.hands_item and 0 or 0.3) + (v101:HasTag("Reinforcement") and 1.6 or 0.7)
		p98.completion_bar(v102)
		if v100.states.equipped:get() ~= p98.instance then
			v100.states.equipped:set(p98.instance)
			while v100.values.equip_debounce:get() or v100.values.equipped ~= p98 do
				v100.values.equip_debounce:wait()
			end
		end
		p98.states.taking_down:set(v101)
	else
		p98.completion_bar:cancel()
		if p98.states.taking_down:get() == nil then
			if v100.states.equipped:get() == p98.instance then
				v100.values.requip_items()
				return
			end
		else
			p98.states.taking_down:set(nil)
		end
	end
end

	p_u_20.move_position = script.AlignPosition:Clone()
	p_u_20.move_rotation = script.AlignOrientation:Clone()
	p_u_20.placing_thread = v_u_7.ov(p_u_20.placing_begin)
	p_u_20.placing_thread:cancelled(function(...)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_20
		p_u_20.placing_cancel(...)
		p_u_20:prop_clear()
		p_u_20.states.placing:set(nil)
	end)
	p_u_20.placing_thread:done(function(...)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_20
		p_u_20.placing_done(...)
		p_u_20.placing_cancel(...)
	end)
	p_u_20:load_instance()
end
function v_u_3.set_part_pivots(p_u_21) -- name: set_part_pivots
	local v_u_22 = p_u_21.instance.Root.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(p_u_21.instance.Plate1.CFrame)
	p_u_21.cframes:get(p_u_21.instance.Plate1, true):set_pivot("general", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_21, (copy) v_u_22
		return p_u_21.instance.Root.CFrame * v_u_22
	end)
	local v_u_23 = p_u_21.instance.Root.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(p_u_21.instance.Plate2.CFrame)
	p_u_21.cframes:get(p_u_21.instance.Plate2, true):set_pivot("general", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_21, (copy) v_u_23
		return p_u_21.instance.Root.CFrame * v_u_23
	end)
	local v_u_24 = p_u_21.instance.Base.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(p_u_21.instance.Lever.CFrame)
	p_u_21.cframes:get(p_u_21.instance.Lever, true):set_pivot("general", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_21, (copy) v_u_24
		return p_u_21.instance.Base.CFrame * v_u_24.Rotation
	end)
end
function v_u_3.hook_states(p_u_25) -- name: hook_states
	p_u_25.states.placing:hook(function(p26)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_25
		if p_u_25.owner then
			p_u_25:placing(p_u_25.owner, p26)
		end
	end)
	p_u_25.states.amount:hook(function(_)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_25
		p_u_25:update_ui()
	end)
end
function v_u_3.placing_begin(p_u_27, p_u_28, p_u_29) -- name: placing_begin
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_9
	while p_u_28.values.equip_debounce:get() or p_u_28.values.equipped ~= p_u_27 do
		p_u_28.values.equip_debounce:wait()
	end
	local v30 = p_u_28.instance.HumanoidRootPart
	local v31 = p_u_29.CFrame + p_u_29.CFrame.LookVector * (p_u_29.Size.Z * 0.5 + 2.25)
	local v32 = p_u_29.CFrame - p_u_29.CFrame.LookVector * (p_u_29.Size.Z * 0.5 + 2.25)
	local v33 = p_u_29.Size.Y
	local v34 = math.min(8, v33) - p_u_29.Size.Y
	local v35 = math.abs(v34)
	local v36 = p_u_29:GetPivot()
	if v35 > 0 then
		v36 = v36 * CFrame.new(0, -v35 * 0.5, 0)
	end
	local v_u_37, v38
	if (v30.Position - v31.Position).Magnitude < (v30.Position - v32.Position).Magnitude then
		v_u_37 = v36 + v36.LookVector * 0.5 * 0.1
		local _ = v36 + v36.LookVector * p_u_29.Size.Z * 0.4
		v38 = CFrame.new(v31.X, v30.Position.Y, v31.Z) * p_u_29.CFrame.Rotation * CFrame.Angles(0, 3.141592653589793, 0)
	else
		v_u_37 = (v36 - v36.LookVector * 0.5 * 0.1) * CFrame.Angles(0, 3.141592653589793, 0)
		local _ = v36 - v36.LookVector * p_u_29.Size.Z * 0.4
		v38 = CFrame.new(v32.X, v30.Position.Y, v32.Z) * p_u_29.CFrame.Rotation
	end
	p_u_27.move_position.Position = v30.CFrame.Position
	p_u_27.move_rotation.CFrame = v30.CFrame.Rotation
	p_u_27.move_position.Parent = v30
	p_u_27.move_rotation.Parent = v30
	p_u_27.move_position.Attachment0 = v30.RootAttachment
	p_u_27.move_rotation.Attachment0 = v30.RootAttachment
	p_u_27.move_position.Position = v38.Position + v38.LookVector * 0.2
	local _, v39, v40 = v38.Rotation:ToOrientation()
	p_u_27.move_rotation.CFrame = CFrame.Angles(0, v39, v40)
	v_u_7.tween(p_u_27.cframes:get(p_u_27.instance.Plate2):set_offset("placing", CFrame.new()), TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine), {
		["Value"] = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -0.03490658503988659)
	})
	local v41 = v_u_7.tween
	local v42 = p_u_27.instance.Plate1
	local v43 = TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine)
	local v44 = {}
	local v45 = p_u_29.Size.X
	local v46 = p_u_27.instance.Plate1.Size.Y
	local v47 = p_u_27.instance.Plate1.Size.Z
	v44.Size = Vector3.new(v45, v46, v47)
	v41(v42, v43, v44)
	local v48 = v_u_7.tween
	local v49 = p_u_27.instance.Plate2
	local v50 = TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine)
	local v51 = {}
	local v52 = p_u_29.Size.X
	local v53 = p_u_27.instance.Plate2.Size.Y
	local v54 = p_u_27.instance.Plate2.Size.Z
	v51.Size = Vector3.new(v52, v53, v54)
	v48(v49, v50, v51)
	p_u_28.values.cframes:get("torso"):set_pivot("lock")
	p_u_28.values.cframes:get("arm1"):set_pivot("placing", function(_)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_28
		return p_u_28.values.viewmodels.torso.CFrame * CFrame.new(1.125, 1, 0)
	end)
	p_u_28.values.cframes:get("arm2"):set_pivot("placing", function(_)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_28
		return p_u_28.values.viewmodels.torso.CFrame * CFrame.new(-1.125, 1, 0)
	end)
	local v_u_55 = p_u_28.values.cframes:get("arm1"):set_absolute("placing", true)
	local v_u_56 = p_u_28.values.cframes:get("arm2"):set_absolute("placing", true)
	local v_u_57 = p_u_28.values.cframes:get("leg1"):set_absolute("placing", true)
	local v_u_58 = p_u_28.values.cframes:get("leg2"):set_absolute("placing", true)
	local v_u_59 = p_u_28.values.cframes:get("torso"):set_absolute("placing", true)
	local v60 = p_u_27.cframes:get(p_u_27.instance.Lever):set_offset("placing", CFrame.new())
	p_u_27.anim.Place.torso_down(v_u_59)
	p_u_27.anim.Place.leg1_down(v_u_57)
	p_u_27.anim.Place.leg2_down(v_u_58)
	p_u_27.anim.Place.arm1_down(v_u_55)
	p_u_27.anim.Place.arm2_down(v_u_56).Completed:Wait()
	local v61 = p_u_27.cframes:get(p_u_27.instance.Root):set_absolute("placing", true)
	p_u_27.cframes:get(p_u_27.instance.Root):set_pivot("placing", function(_)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_37, (copy) p_u_29
		return v_u_37 * CFrame.new(0, -3.6, -p_u_29.Size.Z * 0.5 - 0.1) * CFrame.Angles(0, -1.5707963267948966, 1.5707963267948966)
	end)
	p_u_27.sound.Place(p_u_27.instance.Root)
	p_u_27.sound.Lattice(p_u_27.instance.Root)
	for _, v62 in pairs(p_u_27.instance:GetChildren()) do
		if not v62:IsA("BasePart") or (v62.Name == "Lever" or v62.Name == "Base") then
			continue
		end
		v_u_7.tween(v62, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine), {
			["Transparency"] = 1
		})
	end
	v_u_7.tween(v61, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine), {
		["Value"] = CFrame.new(3.4, 0, 0)
	})
	local v_u_63 = v_u_13.new()
	local v_u_64 = false
	v_u_63:add(p_u_27.placing_thread:cancelled(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_64, (copy) v_u_63
		v_u_64 = true
		v_u_63:clean()
	end).unhook)
	if p_u_29:GetAttribute("Health") then
		p_u_27.anim.Place.torso_down2(v_u_59)
	else
		task.spawn(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_27, (copy) v_u_57, (copy) v_u_58, (copy) v_u_59, (copy) v_u_55, (copy) v_u_56, (ref) v_u_64
			p_u_27.anim.Place.base2(v_u_57)
			p_u_27.anim.Place.base2(v_u_58)
			p_u_27.anim.Place.base2(v_u_59)
			p_u_27.anim.Place.arm1_up0(v_u_55)
			p_u_27.anim.Place.arm2_up0(v_u_56).Completed:Wait()
			if v_u_64 then
				return
			else
				p_u_27.anim.Place.arm1_up1(v_u_55)
				p_u_27.anim.Place.arm2_up1(v_u_56).Completed:Wait()
				if not v_u_64 then
					p_u_27.anim.Place.arm1_up2(v_u_55)
					p_u_27.anim.Place.arm2_up2(v_u_56).Completed:Wait()
				end
			end
		end)
	end
	local v65 = v_u_7.create_reinforce(p_u_29)
	if p_u_27.prop then
		p_u_27.prop.Parent = nil
	end
	p_u_27.prop = v65
	p_u_27.auto_clear_prop = task.delay(5, function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_27
		task.defer(function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_27
			p_u_27:prop_clear()
		end)
	end)
	v65.Parent = game.Workspace
	v65:PivotTo(v_u_37)
	local v66 = v65:GetChildren()
	for _, v67 in pairs(v66) do
		if not v67:IsA("BasePart") then
			continue
		end
		if v67.Name == "Plate" then
			v67.CFrame = v67.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -1, 0)
		end
		v67.Transparency = 1
	end
	table.sort(v66, function(p68, p69)
		return p68.CFrame.Y < p69.CFrame.Y
	end)
	p_u_27.current_wall = p_u_29
	v_u_11.set_override_muffling(v_u_11.get_zone(p_u_29), 0.95)
	local v70 = v66[1].CFrame.Y
	for _, v71 in v66 do
		if v71.Name ~= "Plate" then
			continue
		end
		v_u_7.tween(v71, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {
			["CFrame"] = nil,
			["Transparency"] = 0,
			["CFrame"] = v71.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1, 0)
		})
		local v72 = v71.CFrame.Y - v70
		if math.abs(v72) <= 0.2 then
			continue
		end
		v70 = v71.CFrame.Y
		task.wait(0.1)
	end
	v_u_7.tween(p_u_27.move_position, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine), {
		["Position"] = v38.Position - v38.LookVector * 0.3
	})
	local v73 = p_u_28.values.cframes:get("camera"):set_offset("placing")
	p_u_27.anim.Place.camera1(v73)
	p_u_27.anim.Place.arm1_pull1(v_u_55)
	p_u_27.anim.Place.arm2_pull1(v_u_56).Completed:Wait()
	p_u_27.sound.Gears(p_u_27.instance.Root)
	v_u_7.tween(p_u_27.move_position, TweenInfo.new(2, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
		["Position"] = v38.Position + v38.RightVector * 0.3
	})
	p_u_27.anim.Place.camera2(v73)
	p_u_27.anim.Place.lever(v60)
	p_u_27.anim.Place.arm1_pull2(v_u_55)
	p_u_27.anim.Place.arm2_pull2(v_u_56).Completed:Wait()
	p_u_27.sound.Place2(p_u_27.instance.Root)
	v_u_9.break_prop(p_u_27.instance, true)
end
function v_u_3.placing_cancel(p74, p75, _) -- name: placing_cancel
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7
	if p74 ~= nil then
		p74.move_position.Parent = nil
		p74.move_rotation.Parent = nil
		p75.values.cframes:get("torso"):remove_pivot("lock")
		p75.values.cframes:get("arm1"):remove_pivot("placing")
		p75.values.cframes:get("arm2"):remove_pivot("placing")
		p75.values.cframes:get("arm1"):remove_absolute("placing")
		p75.values.cframes:get("arm2"):remove_absolute("placing")
		p75.values.cframes:get("leg1"):remove_absolute("placing")
		p75.values.cframes:get("leg2"):remove_absolute("placing")
		p75.values.cframes:get("torso"):remove_absolute("placing")
		p75.values.cframes:get("camera"):remove_offset("placing")
		p74.cframes:get(p74.instance.Root):remove_pivot("placing")
		p74.cframes:get(p74.instance.Root):remove_absolute("placing")
		p74.cframes:get(p74.instance.Plate1):remove_offset("placing")
		p74.cframes:get(p74.instance.Plate2):remove_offset("placing")
		p74.cframes:get(p74.instance.Lever):remove_offset("placing")
		local v76 = p74.instance.Plate1
		local v77 = p74.instance.Plate1.Size.Y
		local v78 = p74.instance.Plate1.Size.Z
		v76.Size = Vector3.new(7, v77, v78)
		local v79 = p74.instance.Plate2
		local v80 = p74.instance.Plate2.Size.Y
		local v81 = p74.instance.Plate2.Size.Z
		v79.Size = Vector3.new(7, v80, v81)
		for _, v82 in pairs(p74.instance:GetChildren()) do
			if not v82:IsA("BasePart") or v82.Name == "Root" then
				continue
			end
			v_u_7.tween(v82, TweenInfo.new(0, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine), {
				["Transparency"] = 0
			})
		end
		if p75.states.equipped:get() == p74.instance then
			p75.values.requip_items()
		end
	end
end
function v_u_3.prop_clear(p83) -- name: prop_clear
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_11
	if p83.current_wall then
		v_u_11.get_zone(p83.current_wall).override_muffling = nil
	end
	if p83.prop then
		p83.prop.Parent = nil
	end
	if p83.instance.Root:FindFirstChild("Lattice") then
		p83.instance.Root.Lattice:Destroy()
	end
	if p83.instance.Root:FindFirstChild("Gears") then
		p83.instance.Root.Gears:Destroy()
	end
	if p83.auto_clear_prop then
		task.cancel(p83.auto_clear_prop)
		p83.auto_clear_prop = nil
	end
end
function v_u_3.placing_done(p_u_84, p85, _) -- name: placing_done
	if not p_u_84.states.placed_model:get() then
		local v_u_86 = nil
		v_u_86 = p_u_84.states.placed_model:hook(function(p87)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_86, (copy) p_u_84
			if p87 then
				v_u_86.unhook()
				p_u_84:prop_clear()
			end
		end)
	end
	p_u_84.states.place_done:fire(p_u_84.states.placing:get())
	p_u_84:holster(p85)
end
function v_u_3.placing(p88, p89, p90) -- name: placing
	if p90 then
		p89.states.lean:set(0)
		p89.states.walk_state:set("stand")
		p88.placing_thread(p88, p89, p90)
	else
		if p88.completion_bar then
			p88.completion_bar:cancel()
		end
		p88.placing_thread:cancel(p88, p89, p90)
	end
end
function v_u_3.equip(p91, p92, p93) -- name: equip
	local v94 = p92.values.cframes:get("arm1"):get_absolute("equipped")
	local v95 = p92.values.cframes:get("arm2"):get_absolute("equipped")
	if p93 == true then
		p92.values.cframes:get("arm1"):set_absolute("equipped", true)
		p91.anim.Equip.arm1_grab(v94).Completed:Wait()
		p91:unholster(p92)
		p91.cframes:get(p91.instance.Root):set_pivot("equipped")
		p92.values.cframes:get("arm1"):set_pivot("equipped")
		p92.values.cframes:get("arm2"):set_pivot("equipped")
		p92.values.cframes:get("arm2"):set_absolute("equipped", true)
		p91.anim.Equip.arm2_hold(v95)
		p91.anim.Equip.arm1_hold(v94)
	else
		p91.states.placing:set(nil)
		p92.values.cframes:get("arm1"):remove_pivot("equipped")
		p92.values.cframes:get("arm2"):remove_pivot("equipped")
		p92.values.cframes:get("arm2"):remove_absolute("equipped")
		p91.cframes:get(p91.instance.Root):remove_pivot("equipped")
		p91.anim.Equip.base(v95)
		p91.anim.Equip.arm1_grab(v94).Completed:Wait()
		p92.values.cframes:get("arm1"):remove_absolute("equipped")
		p91:holster(p92)
	end
end
function v_u_3.render(p96, _, p97) -- name: render
	p96.instance.Root:PivotTo(p96.cframes:get(p96.instance.Root):render(p97))
	p96.instance.Plate1:PivotTo(p96.cframes:get(p96.instance.Plate1):render(p97))
	p96.instance.Plate2:PivotTo(p96.cframes:get(p96.instance.Plate2):render(p97))
	p96.instance.Lever:PivotTo(p96.cframes:get(p96.instance.Lever):render(p97))
end
function v_u_3.can_place(p98, p_u_99, p100) -- name: can_place
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_4
	if not p100 and (p98.prepare.running or p98.placing_thread.running) then
		return true
	end
	local v101 = p_u_99 and (not p_u_99.states.running:get() and (p_u_99.states.climbing:get() == 0 and (p98.states.amount:get() > 0 and p_u_99.states.vault:get() == 0))) and (not p_u_99.values.falling:get() and p_u_99.values.camera:get())
	if v101 then
		local v_u_102 = nil
		v_u_7.parts_on_ray(v101.CFrame.Position - v101.CFrame.LookVector * 2, v101.CFrame.LookVector * 9, { p_u_99.instance, p_u_99.values.viewmodels }, function(p103)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_10, (ref) v_u_14, (ref) v_u_4, (copy) p_u_99, (ref) v_u_102
			local v104 = p103.Instance
			if not v104:HasTag("SoftWall") or v104:GetAttribute("Vertical") and not v104:GetAttribute("Health") or (v104:GetAttribute("Disabled") or (not v_u_10.can_interact(v_u_14, v104) or v_u_4.get("SoftWall", v104).states.reinforced:get()) or (v104:GetAttribute("Health") or p103.Distance > 3) and (not v104:GetAttribute("Health") or (p_u_99.instance.HumanoidRootPart.Position.Y <= p103.Position.Y or v_u_4.get("Breakable", v_u_4.get("SoftWall", v104).states.walled:get()).states.destroyed:get()))) then
				return (v104.CanCollide ~= true or (v104.Transparency >= 1 or v104.Parent:HasTag("Wall"))) and true or false
			end
			v_u_102 = v104
			return false
		end, 2)
		return v_u_102
	end
end
function v_u_3.get_place_wait(p105, p106) -- name: get_place_wait
	return (p105.owner.values.equipped == p105.owner.values.hands_item and 0 or 0.3) + (p106:GetAttribute("Health") and 3.1 or 3.8)
end
function v_u_3.prepare(p107, p108) -- name: prepare
	local v109 = p107.owner
	local v110 = p107:can_place(v109, true)
	if p108 and v110 then
		local v111 = p107:get_place_wait(v110)
		p107.completion_bar(v111)
		if v109.states.equipped:get() ~= p107.instance then
			v109.states.equipped:set(p107.instance)
			while v109.values.equip_debounce:get() or v109.values.equipped ~= p107 do
				v109.values.equip_debounce:wait()
			end
		end
		p107.states.placing:set(v110)
	else
		p107.completion_bar:cancel()
		if p107.states.placing:get() == nil then
			if v109.states.equipped:get() == p107.instance then
				v109.values.requip_items()
				return
			end
		else
			p107.placing_thread:cancel(p107, v109)
			p107.states.placing:set(nil)
		end
	end
end
function v_u_3.hook_inputs(p_u_112) -- name: hook_inputs
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_12
	local v_u_113 = v_u_8.create_input_dictionary(p_u_112.instance)
	p_u_112.inputs = v_u_113
	p_u_112.prepare = v_u_7.ov(p_u_112.prepare)
	local v_u_114 = v_u_12.setup_action(v_u_113, function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_112
		return p_u_112:can_place(p_u_112.owner)
	end, "Reinforce", "interact", true, 3)
	p_u_112.completion_bar = v_u_114.completion
	v_u_7.watch_property(v_u_114.action, "Visible", function(p115)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_113, (copy) v_u_114, (copy) p_u_112
		if p115 and v_u_113:get("interact"):holding() then
			if not v_u_114.action.Visible then
				return
			end
			p_u_112.prepare(p_u_112, true)
		end
	end)
	v_u_113:get("interact"):press(function(p116) -- name: start
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_114, (copy) p_u_112
		if not p116 or v_u_114.action.Visible then

function setup_banned() -- name: setup_banned
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_4
	local v_u_71 = {
		"Primary",
		"Secondary",
		"Gadget1",
		"Gadget2",
		"Utility1",
		"Utility2"
	}
	local v_u_72 = {}
	local function v_u_80() -- name: update_banned
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_72, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_71, (ref) v_u_32
		v_u_72 = {}
		for _, v73 in game.Teams:GetChildren() do
			if not v73:GetAttribute("BannedItems") then
				continue
			end
			for _, v74 in string.split(v73:GetAttribute("BannedItems") or "", ",") do
				if v74 == "" then
					continue
				end
				v_u_72[v74] = true
			end
		end
		if game.Workspace:GetAttribute("BannedItems") then
			for _, v75 in string.split(game.Workspace:GetAttribute("BannedItems"), ",") do
				if v75 == "" then
					continue
				end
				v_u_72[v75] = true
			end
		end
		for _, v76 in v_u_3.get("ItemsMenu").Items:GetChildren() do
			if not v76:GetAttribute("name") then
				continue
			end
			v76.LockedFrame.Visible = v_u_72[v76:GetAttribute("name")] and true or false
		end
		for _, v77 in v_u_71 do
			local v78 = v_u_3.get(v77 .. "Button")
			local v79 = v_u_32[string.lower(v77)]:get()
			if v79 == nil then
				v78.BannedFrame.Visible = false
			else
				v78.BannedFrame.Visible = v_u_72[v79] and true or false
			end
		end
	end
	v_u_4.hook_child_added(game.Teams, function(p81)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_80
		v_u_4.watch_attribute(p81, "BannedItems", v_u_80)
	end)
	v_u_4.watch_attribute(game.Workspace, "BannedItems", v_u_80)
	local v_u_82 = v_u_72
	for _, v83 in v_u_71 do
		local v_u_84 = v_u_3.get(v83 .. "Button")
		v_u_32[string.lower(v83)]:hook(function(p85)
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_84, (ref) v_u_82
			if p85 == nil then
				v_u_84.BannedFrame.Visible = false
			else
				v_u_84.BannedFrame.Visible = v_u_82[p85] and true or false
			end
		end)
	end
	v_u_4.hook_child_added(v_u_3.get("ItemsMenu").Items, function(p86)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_82
		if p86:GetAttribute("name") then
			p86.LockedFrame.Visible = v_u_82[p86:GetAttribute("name")] and true or false
		end
	end)
end

function v_u_32.setup_animations(p87) -- name: setup_animations
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_4
	local v88, v89 = v_u_21.create_character_animator(p87)
	v88:get(p87.arm1):set_absolute("base")
	v88:get(p87.arm2):set_absolute("base")
	v88:get(p87.leg1):set_absolute("base")
	v88:get(p87.leg2):set_absolute("base")
	local v_u_90 = v88:get(p87.arm1):set_offset("wobble")
	local v_u_91 = v88:get(p87.arm2):set_offset("wobble")
	v88:get(p87.leg1):set_offset("wobble")
	v88:get(p87.leg2):set_offset("wobble")
	local v_u_92 = v88:get(p87.head):set_offset("wobble")
	local v_u_93 = TweenInfo.new(1, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
	local v_u_94 = v_u_6.new(1, function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_90, (copy) v_u_93, (copy) v_u_91, (copy) v_u_92
		v_u_4.tween(v_u_90, v_u_93, {
			["Value"] = CFrame.Angles(v_u_4.rand(-0.03, 0.03), v_u_4.rand(-0.03, 0.03), v_u_4.rand(-0.03, 0.03))
		})
		v_u_4.tween(v_u_91, v_u_93, {
			["Value"] = CFrame.Angles(v_u_4.rand(-0.03, 0.03), v_u_4.rand(-0.03, 0.03), v_u_4.rand(-0.03, 0.03))
		})
		v_u_4.tween(v_u_92, v_u_93, {
			["Value"] = CFrame.Angles(v_u_4.rand(-0.03, 0.03), v_u_4.rand(-0.03, 0.03), v_u_4.rand(-0.03, 0.03))
		})
	end)
	v89:hook(function(p95)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_94
		if p95 then
			v_u_94:resume()
		else
			v_u_94:stop()
		end
	end)
	return v88, v89
end

function equip_item(p106, p107, p108) -- name: equip_item
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_1
	if string.find(p107, "gadget") then
		if v_u_32.gadget2:get() == v_u_32.gadget1:get() then
			if p107 == "gadget1" then
				v_u_32.gadget2:set(nil)
				v_u_2.classes[p106].gadget2 = nil
			else
				v_u_32.gadget1:set(nil)
				v_u_2.classes[p106].gadget1 = nil
			end
		end
	elseif string.find(p107, "utility") and v_u_32.utility2:get() == v_u_32.utility1:get() then
		if p107 == "utility1" then
			v_u_32.utility2:set(nil)
			v_u_2.classes[p106].utility2 = nil
		else
			v_u_32.utility1:set(nil)
			v_u_2.classes[p106].utility1 = nil
		end
	end
	local v109 = v_u_1.send("equip_class_" .. p107, p106, p108)
	v_u_2.classes[p106][p107] = p108
	return v109
end
function equip_item_attachment(p110, p111, p112, p113) -- name: equip_item_attachment
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_2
	local v114 = v_u_1.send("equip_class_attachment", p110, p111, p112, p113 or v_u_32[p112]:get())
	v_u_2.classes[p110].attachments = v_u_2.classes[p110].attachments or {}
	v_u_2.classes[p110].attachments[p111] = v_u_2.classes[p110].attachments[p111] or {}
	v_u_2.classes[p110].attachments[p111][p112] = p113 or v_u_32[p112]:get()
	return v114
end

		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_32, (ref) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_3

		elseif v189 == "utility1" then
			equip_item(v190, "utility1", v_u_32.utility1:get())
		elseif v189 == "utility2" then
			equip_item(v190, "utility2", v_u_32.utility2:get())
		else
			if table.find(v_u_16.attachment_types, v189) then
				local v191 = v_u_32.display_model:get()
				equip_item_attachment(v190, v191.Name, v189)
				v_u_32.current_tab:set(v_u_32.previous_tab)
				return
			end
			if v189 == "hat" then
				equip_item(v190, "hat", v_u_32.hat:get())
			elseif v189 == "outfit" then
				equip_item(v190, "outfit", v_u_32.outfit:get())
			elseif v189 == "skin_color" then
				equip_item(v190, "skin_color", v_u_32.skin_color:get())
			else

					if v189 == "loadout" and v_u_32.main_menu:get() then
						practice_function()
						return
					elseif v189 == "play" and v_u_32.play_tab:get() == "custom_match" then
						start_function()
					end
				end
				equip_item(v190, "icon", v_u_32.icon:get())
				for _, v192 in v_u_3.get("ClassTemplate").Parent:GetChildren() do
					if v192.Name ~= "CreatedClass" or v192.LayoutOrder ~= v190 then
						continue
					end
					v_u_16.apply_icon(v192.ImageLabel, v_u_32.icon:get())
				end
				equip_item(v190, "color", v_u_32.color:get())
				for _, v193 in v_u_3.get("ClassTemplate").Parent:GetChildren() do
					if v193.Name ~= "CreatedClass" or v193.LayoutOrder ~= v190 then
						continue
					end
					v193.ImageLabel.ImageColor3 = v_u_16.colors[v_u_32.color:get() or "gray"]

			end
		end

				task.defer(function()
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_199

				end)
			end

	end
	local v_u_200 = nil
	local v_u_201 = v_u_9.new()
	v_u_7.dependency({ v_u_32.enabled, v_u_32.camera_part }, function(p202, p203)

		v_u_201:clean()

			v_u_196:set(p203:GetPivot(), v_u_200 and (v_u_200.Name == "Radio" and p203 ~= v_u_200) and 0.02 or 0.1)
			v_u_201:add(v_u_4.run(function(_)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_32, (ref) v_u_196
				if v_u_32.camera_force:get() == CFrame.new() then
					game.Workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame = v_u_196:get() * v_u_32.camera_offset:get()
				else
					game.Workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame = v_u_32.camera_force:get() * v_u_32.camera_offset:get() * (game.Workspace.CurrentCamera:GetAttribute("Offset") or CFrame.new())

	for _, v204 in v_u_32.character:GetChildren() do

function setup_main_menu() -- name: setup_main_menu
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_33, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_23, (copy) v_u_29
	local v210 = v_u_3.get("PlayButton")

	end
	v_u_3.on_click(v210, function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_32
		v_u_32.current_tab:set("play")
	end)
	v_u_3.on_click(v211, function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_32
		v_u_32.current_tab:set("classes")
		local v214 = v_u_32.chosen_class:get()
		v_u_32.chosen_class:set_instant(nil)
		v_u_32.chosen_class:set_instant(v214)
	end)
	v_u_3.on_click(v212, function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_32
		v_u_32.current_tab:set("crates")
	end)
	local v215 = v_u_3.get("BackButton")
	local function v_u_217() -- name: back_function
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_32, (ref) v_u_3
		local v216 = v_u_32.current_tab:get()
		if v_u_32.main_menu:get() then
			if v216 == "classes" or (v216 == "loadout" or v216 == "play") then
				v_u_32.current_tab:set("main_menu")
				return
			end
			if v216 == "crates" then
				if v_u_3.get("CrateFrame").Visible then
					v_u_32.current_tab:set("main_menu")
					return
				end
				v_u_32.clear_collection_item()
				if v_u_32.current_tab:get() == "crates" then
					v_u_3.get("CrateFrame").Visible = true
				end
			end
		end
	end
	v_u_3.on_click(v215, v_u_217)
	v_u_12.update_key_image(v_u_3.get("BackFrame").Key, "back")
	v_u_32.inputs:get("back"):press(function(p218)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_217
		if p218 and v_u_3.get("BackFrame").Visible then
			v_u_217()
		end
	end)
	hover_animation(v215)
	v_u_32.main_menu:hook(function(p219)

		v_u_3.get("Party").Visible = p219

	end):hook(function(p223)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_3
		v_u_3.get("CurrencyFrame").Visible = p223
	end)
	v_u_23.MenuOpened:Once(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_33
		if game.Workspace:GetAttribute("ServerType") == "ReservedServer" and not (game.Workspace:GetAttribute("CustomMatch") or (game.Workspace:GetAttribute("GameEnded") or v_u_33:GetAttribute("Spectator"))) then
			if game.Workspace:GetAttribute("QueueType") == "ranked" then
				task.spawn(display_notification, "You will NOT get any rewards if you leave the match early! And will face penalties", nil)
				return
			end
			if game.Workspace:GetAttribute("QueueType") == "quick" then
				task.spawn(display_notification, "You will NOT get any rewards if you leave the match early!", nil)
			end
		end
	end)
	v_u_32.current_tab:hook(function(p224, _)

			setup_ban_items()
			for _, v225 in v_u_3.get("BanItemsMenu").Icons:GetChildren() do
				if not v225:IsA("GuiButton") then

				end
				v225.Visible = v225.Name == "BanItemIcon"

		else
			v229 = UDim2.fromScale(0.582, 0.93)
		end
		v228.Position = v229
		local v230 = v_u_3.get("ItemInfo")
		local v231
		if p224 == "ban_items" then
			v231 = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.93)
		else
			v231 = UDim2.fromScale(0.582, 0.93)
		end
		v230.Position = v231

		v_u_3.get("BanMapsMenu").Visible = p224 == "ban_maps"
		v_u_3.get("DarkLoadoutOverlay").Visible = p224 == "ban_items" and true or p224 == "ban_maps"
	end)
	v_u_32.enabled:hook(function(p232)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_3
		v_u_3.get("LoadoutMenu").Enabled = p232
	end)
end
function setup_news() -- name: setup_news
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_6
	local v_u_233 = v_u_3.get("News")
	local v234 = v_u_3.get("NewsButtons")
	local v_u_235 = v_u_233.Frame.List
	local v_u_236 = v_u_3.get("NewsBulinaTemplate")
	v_u_236.Visible = false
	local v_u_237 = v_u_7.new(1)
	local v_u_238 = {}
	local v_u_239 = {}
	v_u_4.hook_child_added(v_u_235, function(p240)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_238, (copy) v_u_236, (copy) v_u_239, (copy) v_u_237
		if p240:IsA("GuiBase2d") and p240.Visible then
			local v241 = v_u_238
			table.insert(v241, p240)
			local v242 = v_u_236:Clone()
			v242.Visible = true
			v242.LayoutOrder = p240.LayoutOrder
			v242.Parent = v_u_236.Parent
			v_u_239[p240.LayoutOrder] = v242
			if v_u_237:get() == p240.LayoutOrder then
				v242.BackgroundTransparency = 0
				v242.UIStroke.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			end
		end
	end)
	table.sort(v_u_238, function(p243, p244)
		return p243.LayoutOrder < p244.LayoutOrder
	end)
	v_u_237:hook(function(p245, p246)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_239, (copy) v_u_236, (ref) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_235
		if p246 and v_u_239[p246] then
			v_u_239[p246].BackgroundTransparency = 1
			v_u_239[p246].UIStroke.Color = v_u_236.UIStroke.Color
		end
		if v_u_239[p245] then
			v_u_239[p245].BackgroundTransparency = 0
			v_u_239[p245].UIStroke.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		end
		v_u_4.tween(v_u_235, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {
			["Position"] = UDim2.fromScale(-1.05 * (p245 - 1), 0)
		})
	end)
	local v247 = v234.Left
	local v248 = v234.Right
	hover_animation(v247.Button)
	hover_animation(v248.Button)
	local v_u_249 = 0
	v_u_3.on_click(v247.Button, function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_237, (copy) v_u_238, (ref) v_u_249
		v_u_237:update(function(p250)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_238
			return p250 == 1 and #v_u_238 or p250 - 1
		end)
		v_u_249 = os.clock()
	end)
	v_u_3.on_click(v248.Button, function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_237, (copy) v_u_238, (ref) v_u_249
		v_u_237:update(function(p251)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_238
			return p251 == #v_u_238 and 1 or p251 + 1
		end)
		v_u_249 = os.clock()
	end)
	local v_u_254 = v_u_7.dependency({ v_u_32.enabled, v_u_32.current_tab }, function(p252, p253)
		if p252 then
			p252 = p253 == "main_menu"
		end
		return p252
	end)
	local v_u_256 = v_u_6.new(5, function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_254, (ref) v_u_249, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_233, (copy) v_u_237, (copy) v_u_238
		task.wait(5)
		if v_u_254:get() then
			if os.clock() - v_u_249 < 5 then
				return
			elseif not v_u_3.is_inside(v_u_233) then
				v_u_237:update(function(p255)
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_238
					return p255 == #v_u_238 and 1 or p255 + 1
				end)
			end
		else
			return
		end
	end)
	v_u_254:hook(function(p257)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_256
		if p257 then
			v_u_256:resume()
		else
			v_u_256:stop()
		end
	end)
end

function setup_classes() -- name: setup_classes
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_17
	v_u_3.auto_scroll_frame_size("Classes")
	v_u_3.get("ClassTemplate").Visible = false
	local v_u_258 = v_u_3.get("ClassInfo")
	v_u_258.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, v_u_258.Size.Y.Scale)
	v_u_258.Visible = false
	v_u_2.hook("classes", function(p259)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_3, (ref) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_9, (ref) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_27, (ref) v_u_32, (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_2
		for _, v260 in v_u_3.get("ClassTemplate").Parent:GetChildren() do
			if v260.Name ~= "CreatedClass" then
				continue
			end
			v260:Destroy()
		end
		for v261, v_u_262 in p259 do
			local v_u_263 = v_u_3.get("ClassTemplate"):Clone()
			v_u_263.Visible = true
			v_u_263.Parent = v_u_3.get("ClassTemplate").Parent
			v_u_263.Name = "CreatedClass"
			v_u_263.LayoutOrder = v261
			v_u_16.apply_icon(v_u_263.ImageLabel, v_u_262.icon)
			v_u_263.ImageLabel.ImageColor3 = v_u_16.colors[v_u_262.color or "gray"]
			hover_animation(v_u_263)
			local v_u_264 = v261
			local v_u_265 = false
			local v_u_266 = v_u_9.new()
			local v_u_267 = false
			local function v_u_301() -- name: start_moving_process
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_265, (ref) v_u_264, (copy) v_u_263, (copy) v_u_266, (ref) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_27, (ref) v_u_3
				if not v_u_265 then
					v_u_265 = true
					v_u_264 = v_u_263.LayoutOrder
					for _, v_u_268 in v_u_263:GetChildren() do
						if v_u_268.Name ~= "Arrow" then
							continue
						end
						v_u_268.Visible = true
						v_u_266:add(function()
							-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_268
							v_u_268.Visible = false
						end)
					end
					v_u_266:add(v_u_4.run(function(_)
						-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_27, (ref) v_u_3, (ref) v_u_263
						local v269 = game:GetService("GuiService"):GetGuiInset()
						local v270 = v_u_27:GetMouseLocation() - v269
						local v271 = v270.X
						local v272 = v270.Y
						local v273 = v_u_3.get("ClassTemplate").Parent
						local v274 = v273:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGridLayout")
						if v274 then
							local v275 = v271 - v273.AbsolutePosition.X
							local v276 = v272 - v273.AbsolutePosition.Y
							local v277 = v274.CellPadding.X.Scale * v273.AbsoluteSize.X + v274.CellPadding.X.Offset
							local v278 = v274.CellPadding.Y.Scale * v273.AbsoluteSize.Y + v274.CellPadding.Y.Offset
							local v279 = v274.AbsoluteCellSize.X + v277
							local v280 = v274.AbsoluteCellSize.Y + v278
							local v281 = (v273.AbsoluteSize.X + v277) / v279
							local v282 = math.floor(v281)
							local v283 = math.max(1, v282)
							local v284 = v275 / v279
							local v285 = math.floor(v284)
							local v286 = v283 - 1
							local v287 = math.clamp(v285, 0, v286)
							local v288 = v276 / v280
							local v289 = math.floor(v288)
							local v290 = math.max(0, v289)
							local v291 = {}
							for _, v292 in v273:GetChildren() do
								if not v292:IsA("GuiObject") or v292.Name ~= "CreatedClass" then
									continue
								end
								table.insert(v291, v292)
							end
							table.sort(v291, function(p293, p294)
								return p293.LayoutOrder < p294.LayoutOrder
							end)
							local v295 = #v291
							local v296 = v290 * v283 + v287 + 1
							local v297 = math.clamp(v296, 1, v295)
							if v_u_263.LayoutOrder ~= v297 then
								local v298 = v_u_263.LayoutOrder
								for _, v299 in ipairs(v291) do
									if v299 == v_u_263 then
										continue
									end
									local v300 = v299.LayoutOrder
									if v298 < v297 then
										if v298 >= v300 or v300 > v297 then
											continue
										end
										v299.LayoutOrder = v299.LayoutOrder - 1
									else
										if v297 > v300 or v300 >= v298 then
											continue
										end
										v299.LayoutOrder = v299.LayoutOrder + 1
									end
								end
								v_u_263.LayoutOrder = v297
							end
						else
							return
						end
					end))
				end
			end
			local v_u_302 = v_u_4.ov(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_301
				task.wait(0.5)
				v_u_301()
			end)
			v_u_3.hover(v_u_263, function(p303)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_262, (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_264, (ref) v_u_267, (copy) v_u_301
				if p303 then
					v_u_32.class_info:set(v_u_262)
					if game.Workspace:GetAttribute("ServerType") == "ReservedServer" then
						v_u_1.send("last_class", v_u_264, os.time())
						return
					end
				else
					if v_u_32.class_info:get() == v_u_262 then
						v_u_32.class_info:set(nil)
					end
					if v_u_267 then
						v_u_301()
					end
				end
			end)
			v_u_3.holding(v_u_263, function(p304)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_267, (ref) v_u_265, (copy) v_u_266, (copy) v_u_302, (ref) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_264, (copy) v_u_263, (ref) v_u_1
				if p304 == true then
					v_u_267 = true
					v_u_265 = false
					v_u_266:clean()
					v_u_302()
				elseif p304 == false then
					v_u_267 = false
					v_u_266:clean()
					v_u_302:cancel()
					if v_u_265 then
						local v305 = v_u_2.classes[v_u_264]
						table.remove(v_u_2.classes, v_u_264)
						local v306 = v_u_2.classes
						local v307 = v_u_263.LayoutOrder
						table.insert(v306, v307, v305)
						v_u_1.send("change_class_order", v_u_264, v_u_263.LayoutOrder)
					end
				end
			end)
			v_u_3.on_click(v_u_263, function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_265, (ref) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_262
				if not v_u_265 then
					v_u_32.class_info:set(nil)
					v_u_32.chosen_class:set(v_u_262)
					v_u_32.current_tab:set("loadout")
				end
			end)
		end
	end)
	local v_u_313 = v_u_4.ov(function(p308)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_258, (ref) v_u_11, (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_4
		if p308 then
			v_u_16.apply_icon(v_u_258.Info.ClassIcon.ImageLabel, p308.icon)
			v_u_258.Info.ClassIcon.ImageLabel.ImageColor3 = v_u_16.colors[p308.color or "gray"]
			v_u_258.Info:FindFirstChild("ClassName").Text = p308.name
			for _, v309 in {
				"Primary",
				"Secondary",
				"Gadget1",
				"Gadget2",
				"Utility1",
				"Utility2"
			} do
				local v310 = v_u_258:FindFirstChild(v309, true)
				local v311 = string.lower(v309)
				if p308[v311] then
					v310.Empty.Visible = false
					v310.ImageLabel.Visible = true
					local v312 = v_u_11.get_item_class(p308[v311])
					if not v312 then
						continue
					end
					v310.ImageLabel.Image = v_u_17.FLAG_IMAGES_INSTEAD_OF_ICONS and v312.image or v312.icon
				else
					v310.Empty.Visible = true
					v310.ImageLabel.Visible = false
				end
			end
			v_u_258.Visible = true
			v_u_4.tween(v_u_258, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {
				["Size"] = UDim2.fromScale(1.5, v_u_258.Size.Y.Scale)
			})
		else
			v_u_4.tween(v_u_258, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {
				["Size"] = UDim2.fromScale(0, v_u_258.Size.Y.Scale)
			}).Completed:Wait()
			v_u_258.Visible = false
		end
	end)
	v_u_32.class_info:hook(function(p314)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_313
		v_u_313(p314)
	end)
	v_u_32.chosen_class:hook(function(p315)
