			v_u_32.gadget2:set(p315.gadget2)
			v_u_32.utility1:set(p315.utility1)
			v_u_32.utility2:set(p315.utility2)
			v_u_32.icon:set(p315.icon)
			v_u_32.color:set(p315.color)
			v_u_32.class_name:set(p315.name)
			v_u_32.hat:set(p315.hat)
			v_u_32.outfit:set(p315.outfit)
		end
	end)
	local v316 = v_u_3.get("AddClassButton")
	v_u_3.on_click(v316, function()

v_u_32.display_model = v_u_7.new(nil)
v_u_32.x_axis_only = v_u_7.new(false)
function setup_panning() -- name: setup_panning
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_4
	local v_u_323 = nil
	local v_u_324 = CFrame.new()
	local v_u_325 = CFrame.new()
	local v_u_326 = CFrame.new()
	local v_u_327 = CFrame.new()
	local v_u_328 = v_u_8.new(CFrame.new(), 0.2)
	v_u_328:hook(function(p329)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_32
		local v330 = v_u_32.display_model:get()
		if v330 ~= nil then
			v330:PivotTo(p329)
		end
	end)
	v_u_32.display_model:hook(function(p331, p332)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_32, (ref) v_u_323, (ref) v_u_324, (ref) v_u_325, (ref) v_u_326, (ref) v_u_327, (copy) v_u_328, (ref) v_u_11, (ref) v_u_17
		v_u_32.x_axis_only:set(p331 == v_u_32.character)
		if p332 then
			if p332 == v_u_32.character then
				p332.Parent = v_u_32.loadout_cubicle:get()
			else
				p332.Parent = nil
			end
		end
		if p331 then
			p331.Parent = v_u_32.loadout_cubicle:get()
			v_u_323 = p331:GetPivot()
			v_u_324 = CFrame.new()
			v_u_325 = CFrame.new()
			v_u_326 = CFrame.new()
			v_u_327 = CFrame.new()
			v_u_328:set(v_u_323)
			v_u_328:set_value(v_u_323)
		end
		if p331 and p331 ~= v_u_32.character then
			local _, v333 = p331:GetBoundingBox()
			local v334 = { v333.X, v333.Y, v333.Z }
			table.sort(v334)
			local v335 = v_u_11.get_item_class(p331.Name).loadout_type
			local v336 = v335 == "hat" and { 1, 1, 1 } or (v335 == "outfit" and { 1, 3, 4.5 } or v334)
			local v337 = v336[3] + v336[2]
			local v338 = v335 == "charm" and 0.7 or 0.3
			local v339 = p331:GetPivot()
			if v_u_17.FLAG_GREENSCREEN_ITEMS then
				local v340 = 0.7
				local v341 = (v336[3] + v336[2]) * 0.5
				local _, _, v342 = v339:ToOrientation()
				local v343 = v_u_32.camera_force
				local v344 = CFrame.new(v339.Position)
				local v345 = CFrame.Angles
				local v346 = 90 - math.deg(v342)
				v343:set(v344 * v345(math.rad(v346), 3.141592653589793, 0) * CFrame.new(0, 0, 1))
				v_u_32.camera_offset:set(CFrame.new(0, 0, v340 * -1 + v341 * v340))
			else
				v_u_32.camera_offset:set(CFrame.new(0, 0, -(v_u_32.camera_part:get().Position - v339.Position).Magnitude * v338 + v337 * v338))
			end
		else
			v_u_32.camera_offset:set(CFrame.new())
			v_u_32.camera_force:set(CFrame.new())
			return
		end
	end)
	local v_u_347 = nil
	v_u_3.current_hovering:hook(function(p348)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_3
		v_u_3.get("PanArea").Visible = p348 == nil
	end)
	v_u_12.current_device:hook(function(p349)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_3
		v_u_3.get("PanArea").Interactable = p349 == "pc" and true or p349 == "mobile"
	end)
	local v_u_350 = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	local function v_u_354(p351) -- name: pan_change
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_347, (ref) v_u_32, (ref) v_u_324, (ref) v_u_325, (ref) v_u_323, (copy) v_u_328
		if v_u_347 == nil then
			v_u_347 = p351.Position
		else
			local v352 = p351.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and 2.5 or 1
			local v353 = (p351.Position - v_u_347) * 0.0025 * v352
			v_u_347 = p351.Position
			if not v_u_32.x_axis_only:get() then
				v_u_324 = v_u_324 * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, v353.Y)
			end
			v_u_325 = v_u_325 * CFrame.Angles(v353.X, 0, 0)
			if v_u_323 then
				v_u_328:set(v_u_323 * v_u_324 * v_u_325)
			end
		end
	end
	v_u_3.get("PanArea").InputBegan:Connect(function(p_u_355)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_32, (ref) v_u_347, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_354
		if v_u_32.display_model:get() == nil then
			return
		elseif p_u_355.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
			if p_u_355.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or p_u_355.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				v_u_347 = nil
				v_u_3.is_panning:set(true)
				p_u_355.Changed:Connect(function()
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_355, (ref) v_u_3, (ref) v_u_354
					if p_u_355.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
						v_u_3.is_panning:set(false)
					elseif p_u_355.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.Change then
						v_u_354(p_u_355)
					end
				end)
			end
		end
	end)
	v_u_27.InputChanged:Connect(function(p356)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_32, (ref) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_350, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_354
		if v_u_32.display_model:get() == nil then
			return
		elseif p356.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Thumbstick2 then
			local v357 = v_u_4.clamp_deadzone(p356.Position, 0.1)
			local v358 = v357.X
			local v359 = v_u_32.x_axis_only:get() and 0 or -v357.Y
			v_u_350 = Vector3.new(v358, v359, 0) * 3
		elseif v_u_3.is_panning:get() and p356.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
			v_u_354(p356)
		end
	end)
	local v_u_360 = nil
	v_u_32.enabled:hook(function(p361)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_360, (ref) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_350, (ref) v_u_32, (ref) v_u_326, (ref) v_u_327, (copy) v_u_328, (ref) v_u_323
		if v_u_360 then
			v_u_360:Disconnect()
			v_u_360 = nil
		end
		if p361 then
			v_u_360 = v_u_4.run(function(p362)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_350, (ref) v_u_32, (ref) v_u_326, (ref) v_u_327, (ref) v_u_328, (ref) v_u_323
				if not v_u_4.is_close(v_u_350, Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.07) then
					if not v_u_32.x_axis_only:get() then
						v_u_326 = v_u_326 * CFrame.Angles(-v_u_350.Y * p362, 0, 0)
					end
					v_u_327 = v_u_327 * CFrame.Angles(0, v_u_350.X * p362, 0)
					v_u_328:set(CFrame.new(v_u_323.Position) * v_u_326 * v_u_327 * v_u_323.Rotation)
				end
			end)
		end
	end)
end
ban_phase_maid = v_u_9.new()
function setup_ban_items() -- name: setup_ban_items
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_33, (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_15, (copy) v_u_32
	v_u_3.auto_scroll_frame_size("BanItemsMenu")
	v_u_3.get("BanItemIconTemplate").Visible = false
	local v_u_363 = v_u_7.new(nil)
	local v_u_364 = v_u_9.new()
	local v_u_365 = v_u_3.get("BanItemButton")
	hover_animation(v_u_365)
	v_u_3.on_click(v_u_365, function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_365, (ref) v_u_33, (copy) v_u_363, (ref) v_u_1
		if v_u_365.LockedFrame.Visible then
			return
		else
			v_u_33:SetAttribute("BannedItem", v_u_363:get():GetAttribute("item_name"))
			if v_u_1.get("ban_item", v_u_33:GetAttribute("BannedItem")) then
				v_u_363:set(nil)
			else
				v_u_33:SetAttribute("BannedItem", nil)
			end
		end
	end)
	local v_u_366 = v_u_3.get("BanItemSearch")
	v_u_4.watch_property(v_u_366, "Text", function(p367)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_3
		for _, v368 in v_u_3.get("BanItemIconTemplate").Parent:GetChildren() do
			if v368.Name ~= "BanItemIcon" then
				continue
			end
			v368.Visible = p367 == "" and true or string.find(string.lower(v368:GetAttribute("display_name")), string.lower(p367))
		end
	end)
	v_u_4.watch_property(v_u_3.get("BanItemsMenu"), "Visible", function(p369)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_366, (copy) v_u_365, (ref) v_u_3
		v_u_366.Visible = p369
		v_u_365.Visible = p369
		v_u_3.get("RedTeamBansPhase").Visible = p369
		v_u_3.get("BlueTeamBansPhase").Visible = p369
	end)
	for _, v_u_370 in game.Teams:GetTeams() do
		ban_phase_maid:add(v_u_4.watch_attribute(v_u_370, "BannedItems", function(p371)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_370, (ref) v_u_11, (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_4
			local v372 = string.split(p371 or "", ",")
			if #v372 > 0 then
				v_u_3.get((("%*TeamBansPhase"):format(v_u_370.Name))).Visible = true
				for _, v373 in v_u_3.get((("%*TeamBansPhase"):format(v_u_370.Name))):GetChildren() do
					if v373.Name ~= "TeamItemBan" or not v373.Visible then
						continue
					end
					v373:Destroy()
				end
				for _, v374 in v372 do
					local v375 = v_u_11.get_item_class(v374)
					if not v375 then
						continue
					end
					local v376 = v_u_3.get("TeamItemBanTemplate"):Clone()
					v376.Name = "TeamItemBan"
					v376.Frame.ImageLabel.Image = v_u_17.FLAG_IMAGES_INSTEAD_OF_ICONS and v375.image or v375.icon
					v376.Visible = true
					v376.Parent = v_u_3.get((("%*TeamBansPhase"):format(v_u_370.Name)))
					v376.LockedFrame.Banned.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1.2, 1.2)
					v_u_4.tween(v376.LockedFrame.Banned, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {
						["Size"] = UDim2.fromScale(0.8, 0.8)
					})
				end
			else
				v_u_3.get((("%*TeamBansPhase"):format(v_u_370.Name))).Visible = false
			end
		end))
	end
	local function v_u_377() -- name: update_ban_button
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_363, (ref) v_u_33, (copy) v_u_365
		if v_u_363:get() == nil or (v_u_363:get().LockedFrame.Visible or v_u_33:GetAttribute("BannedItem") ~= nil) then
			v_u_365.LockedFrame.Visible = true
		else
			v_u_365.LockedFrame.Visible = false
		end
	end
	ban_phase_maid:add(v_u_363:hook(function(p378, p379)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_364, (ref) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_377
		v_u_364:clean()
		if p378 then
			local v380 = {
				["BackgroundColor3"] = Color3.fromRGB(100, 0, 0)
			}
			v_u_4.tween(p378, TweenInfo.new(0.3), v380)
			v_u_364:add(v_u_4.watch_property(p378.LockedFrame, "Visible", v_u_377))
		end
		if p379 then
			local v381 = {
				["BackgroundColor3"] = Color3.fromRGB(57, 57, 57)
			}
			v_u_4.tween(p379, TweenInfo.new(0.3), v381)
		end
	end).unhook)
	ban_phase_maid:add(v_u_4.watch_attribute(v_u_33, "BannedItem", v_u_377))
	ban_phase_maid:add(v_u_363:hook(v_u_377).unhook)
	for _, v382 in v_u_16.item_types do
		for _, v_u_383 in v_u_11.get_all_items_of_loadout(v382) do
			if v_u_383.hidden or v_u_383.release_stamp and (v_u_17.FLAG_RELEASE_WEEK_ITEMS and v_u_15.get_seconds_until_stamp(v_u_383.release_stamp) > 604800) then
				continue
			end
			local v_u_384 = v_u_383.model.Parent.Name
			local v_u_385 = v_u_3.get("BanItemIconTemplate"):Clone()
			v_u_385.Name = "BanItemIcon"
			v_u_385:SetAttribute("item_name", v_u_384)
			v_u_385:SetAttribute("display_name", v_u_383.display_name)
			v_u_385.Visible = true
			v_u_385.ImageLabel.Image = v_u_17.FLAG_IMAGES_INSTEAD_OF_ICONS and v_u_383.image or v_u_383.icon
			v_u_385.Parent = v_u_3.get("BanItemIconTemplate").Parent
			if v_u_383.price == nil then
				v_u_385.LayoutOrder = 1000
			end
			local function v_u_391() -- name: update_banned
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_385, (ref) v_u_33, (copy) v_u_384, (ref) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_383
				if v_u_385:FindFirstChild("LockedFrame") then
					local v386 = string.split(game.Teams.Red:GetAttribute("BannedItems") or "", ",")
					local v387 = string.split(game.Teams.Blue:GetAttribute("BannedItems") or "", ",")
					local v388 = string.split(game.Workspace:GetAttribute("BannedItems") or "", ",")
					local v389 = false
					for _, v390 in game.Players:GetPlayers() do
						if v390.Team ~= v_u_33.Team or v390:GetAttribute("BannedItem") ~= v_u_384 then
							continue
						end
						v389 = true
					end
					if v389 or (table.find(v386, v_u_384) or (table.find(v387, v_u_384) or table.find(v388, v_u_384))) then
						if v_u_385.LockedFrame.Visible == false then
							v_u_385.LockedFrame.Banned.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1.2, 1.2)
							v_u_4.tween(v_u_385.LockedFrame.Banned, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {
								["Size"] = UDim2.fromScale(0.8, 0.8)
							})
						end
						v_u_385.LockedFrame.Visible = true
						v_u_385.LockedFrame.Banned.Visible = true
						return
					elseif v_u_383.price == nil then
						v_u_385.LockedFrame.Visible = true
						v_u_385.LockedFrame.Banned.Visible = false
					else
						v_u_385.LockedFrame.Visible = false
					end
				else
					return
				end
			end
			for _, v392 in game.Teams:GetChildren() do
				ban_phase_maid:add(v_u_4.watch_attribute(v392, "BannedItems", v_u_391))
			end
			ban_phase_maid:add(v_u_1.on_connect(function(p_u_393)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_33, (copy) v_u_391
				ban_phase_maid:add(v_u_4.watch_property(p_u_393, "Team", function(p394)
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_33, (ref) v_u_4, (copy) p_u_393, (ref) v_u_391
					if p394 == v_u_33.Team then
						ban_phase_maid:add(v_u_4.watch_attribute(p_u_393, "BannedItem", v_u_391))
					end
				end))
			end))
			ban_phase_maid:add(v_u_4.watch_attribute(game.Workspace, "BannedItems", v_u_391))
			hover_animation(v_u_385)
			v_u_3.on_click(v_u_385, function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_385, (ref) v_u_33, (copy) v_u_363
				if game.Workspace:GetAttribute("BanPhase") == "Items" then
					if v_u_385.LockedFrame.Visible then
						return
					elseif v_u_33.Team == nil then
						return
					elseif v_u_363:get() == v_u_385 then
						v_u_363:set(nil)
					elseif v_u_33:GetAttribute("BannedItem") == nil then
						v_u_363:set(v_u_385)
					end
				else
					return
				end
			end)
			v_u_3.hover(v_u_385, function(p395)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_383
				if p395 then
					v_u_32.cursor_text:set(v_u_383.display_name)
				elseif v_u_32.cursor_text:get() == v_u_383.display_name then
					v_u_32.cursor_text:set("")
				end
			end)
			v_u_385.Destroying:Connect(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_383
				if v_u_32.gun_info:get() == v_u_383 then
					v_u_32.gun_info:set(nil)
				elseif v_u_32.item_info:get() == v_u_383 then
					v_u_32.item_info:set(nil)
				end
				if v_u_32.cursor_text:get() == v_u_383.display_name then
					v_u_32.cursor_text:set("")
				end
			end)
			ban_phase_maid:add(v_u_385)
		end
	end
end
function setup_ban_maps() -- name: setup_ban_maps
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_33, (copy) v_u_1
	v_u_3.get("MapBanTemplate").Visible = false
	for v_u_396, v397 in v_u_16.maps do
		local v_u_398 = v_u_3.get("MapBanTemplate"):Clone()
		v_u_398.Name = v_u_396
		v_u_398.Visible = true
		v_u_398.ImageLabel.Image = v397.image
		v_u_398.TextLabel.Text = v_u_396
		v_u_398.LayoutOrder = math.random(1, 10)
		v_u_398.Parent = v_u_3.get("MapBanTemplate").Parent
		local function v401() -- name: update_banned
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_398, (copy) v_u_396, (ref) v_u_4
			if v_u_398:FindFirstChild("LockedFrame") then
				local v399 = string.split(game.Teams.Red:GetAttribute("MapBans") or "", ",")
				local v400 = string.split(game.Teams.Blue:GetAttribute("MapBans") or "", ",")
				if table.find(v399, v_u_396) or table.find(v400, v_u_396) then
					if v_u_398.LockedFrame.Visible == false then
						v_u_398.LockedFrame.Banned.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1.2, 1.2)
						v_u_4.tween(v_u_398.LockedFrame.Banned, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {
							["Size"] = UDim2.fromScale(0.8, 0.8)
						})
					end
					v_u_398.LockedFrame.Visible = true
				else
					v_u_398.LockedFrame.Visible = false
				end
			else
				return
			end
		end
		local function v_u_404() -- name: update_votes
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_398, (copy) v_u_396, (ref) v_u_33
			if v_u_398:FindFirstChild("Frame") then
				local v402 = 0
				for _, v403 in game.Players:GetPlayers() do
					if v403:GetAttribute("BannedMap") ~= v_u_396 or v403.Team ~= v_u_33.Team then
						continue
					end
					v402 = v402 + 1
				end
				if v402 > 0 then
					v_u_398.Frame.Dot.Amount.Text = v402
					v_u_398.Frame.Dot.Visible = true
				else
					v_u_398.Frame.Dot.Visible = false
				end
			else
				return
			end
		end
		for _, v405 in game.Teams:GetChildren() do
			ban_phase_maid:add(v_u_4.watch_attribute(v405, "MapBans", v401))
		end
		ban_phase_maid:add(v_u_1.on_connect(function(p406)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_404
			ban_phase_maid:add(v_u_4.watch_attribute(p406, "BannedMap", v_u_404))
		end))
		hover_animation(v_u_398)
		v_u_3.on_click(v_u_398, function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_398, (ref) v_u_33, (copy) v_u_396, (ref) v_u_1
			if game.Workspace:GetAttribute("BanPhase") == "Maps" then
				if v_u_398.LockedFrame.Visible then
					return
				elseif v_u_33.Team == nil then
					return
				elseif v_u_33:GetAttribute("BannedMap") == v_u_396 then
					v_u_33:SetAttribute("BannedMap", nil)
					v_u_1.send("ban_map", nil)
				else
					v_u_33:SetAttribute("BannedMap", v_u_396)
					v_u_1.send("ban_map", v_u_396)
				end
			else
				return
			end
		end)
		ban_phase_maid:add(v_u_398)
	end
end
v_u_32.skin_color = v_u_7.new(nil)
function setup_skin_color() -- name: setup_skin_color
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_9
	v_u_32.skin_color:hook(function(p407)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_32, (ref) v_u_3
		if p407 then
			local v408 = v_u_16.skin_colors[p407] or v_u_16.skin_colors.skin_color3
			for _, v409 in v_u_32.character:GetChildren() do
				if not v409:IsA("BasePart") then
					continue
				end
				v409.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
				if v409.Transparency ~= 0 then
					continue
				end
				v409.Color = v408.color
			end
			v_u_3.get("SkinColorButton").ImageLabel.Visible = true
			v_u_3.get("SkinColorButton").Empty.Visible = false
			v_u_3.get("SkinColorButton").ImageLabel.BackgroundColor3 = v408.color
		else
			for _, v410 in v_u_32.character:GetChildren() do
				if not v410:IsA("BasePart") then
					continue
				end
				v410.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
				if v410.Transparency ~= 0 then
					continue
				end
				v410.Color = Color3.fromRGB(127, 127, 127)
			end
			v_u_3.get("SkinColorButton").ImageLabel.Visible = false
			v_u_3.get("SkinColorButton").Empty.Visible = true
		end
	end)
	local v_u_411 = v_u_9.new()
	v_u_32.current_tab:hook(function(p412)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_411, (ref) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_3, (ref) v_u_32
		v_u_411:clean()
		if p412 == "skin_color" then
			for v_u_413, v414 in v_u_16.skin_colors do
				if v414.hidden then
					continue
				end
				local v_u_415 = v_u_3.get("IconTemplate"):Clone()
				v_u_415.Name = "SkinColor"
				v_u_415.Visible = true
				v_u_415:SetAttribute("name", v_u_413)
				v_u_415:SetAttribute("hidden", v414.hidden)
				v_u_415:SetAttribute("loadout_type", "skin_color")
				v_u_415:SetAttribute("order", v414.order or 1000)
				v_u_415.ImageLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.7, 0.7)
				v_u_415.ImageLabel.Image = ""
				v_u_415.ImageLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 0
				v_u_415.ImageLabel.BackgroundColor3 = v414.color
				v_u_415.LayoutOrder = v414.order or 1000
				v_u_415.Parent = v_u_3.get("IconTemplate").Parent
				v_u_411:add(v_u_415)
				setup_release_week(v414, p412, v_u_415, v_u_413, v_u_411)
				hover_animation(v_u_415)
				v_u_3.on_click(v_u_415, function()
					-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_415, (ref) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_413
					if v_u_415.LockedOverlay.Visible then
						local v416 = {
							["loadout_type"] = "skin_color",
							["name"] = nil,
							["name"] = v_u_413
						}
						v_u_32.buy_frame:set(v416)
					else
						v_u_32.skin_color:set(v_u_413)
					end
				end)
				v_u_3.right_click(v_u_415, function()
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_413
					local v417 = {
						["loadout_type"] = "skin_color",
						["name"] = nil,
						["name"] = v_u_413
					}
					v_u_32.buy_frame:set(v417)
				end)
				v_u_411:add(v_u_32.skin_color:hook(function(p418)
					-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_415, (copy) v_u_413
					local v419 = v_u_415.Frame.Dot.Equipped
					if p418 then
						p418 = p418 == v_u_413
					end
					v419.Visible = p418
				end).unhook)
			end
		end
	end)
	local v420 = v_u_3.get("SkinColorButton")
	v_u_3.on_click(v420, function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_32
		v_u_32.current_tab:set("skin_color")
	end)
	hover_animation(v420)
end
local v_u_424 = v_u_7.dependency({ v_u_32.gun_info, v_u_32.item_info }, function(p421, p422)
	local v423
	if p421 == nil then
		v423 = p422 == nil
	else
		v423 = false
	end
	return v423
end)
function setup_attachment_guis(p_u_425, p_u_426, p427) -- name: setup_attachment_guis
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_33, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_424
	local v_u_428 = p427 or {}
	v_u_4.hook_child_added(p_u_425.Root, function(p429)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_11, (copy) p_u_426, (ref) v_u_33, (copy) p_u_425, (ref) v_u_428, (ref) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_3, (ref) v_u_32, (ref) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_7, (ref) v_u_424
		if string.find(p429.Name, "Attachment") then
			local v_u_430 = string.gsub(p429.Name, "Attachment", "")
			if not table.find(v_u_16.attachment_types, string.lower(v_u_430)) then
				return
			end
			if p429.Name ~= "CharmAttachment" and not v_u_11.has_attachment(p_u_426, string.lower(v_u_430)) then
				return
			end
			local v_u_431 = script.AttachmentGui:Clone()
			v_u_431.Parent = v_u_33.PlayerGui
			v_u_431.Title.Text = v_u_430
			v_u_431.Adornee = p_u_425.Root
			v_u_431.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = p429.CFrame.Position + (v_u_428[v_u_430] or Vector3.new())
			v_u_431.AttachmentButton.ImageLabel.Size = v_u_430 == "Skin" and UDim2.fromScale(0.8, 0.8) or UDim2.fromScale(1.5, 1.5)
			local v_u_433 = v_u_4.ov(function(p432)
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_431, (ref) v_u_4
				if p432 then
					v_u_431.Enabled = true
					v_u_431.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.01, 0.01)
					v_u_4.tween(v_u_431, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {
						["Size"] = UDim2.fromScale(0.35, 0.35)
					})
				else
					v_u_4.tween(v_u_431, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {
						["Size"] = UDim2.fromScale(0.01, 0.01)
					}).Completed:Wait()
					v_u_431.Enabled = false
				end
			end)
			hover_animation(v_u_431.AttachmentButton)
			v_u_3.on_click(v_u_431.AttachmentButton, function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_32, (ref) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_430
				local v434 = v_u_32.current_tab:get()
				if table.find(v_u_16.attachment_types, v434) then
					local v435 = v_u_32.display_model:get()
					local v436 = table.find(v_u_2.classes, v_u_32.chosen_class:get())
					equip_item_attachment(v436, v435.Name, v434)
				end
				v_u_32.current_tab:set(string.lower(v_u_430))
			end)
			v_u_7.dependency({ v_u_424, v_u_32.current_tab }, function(p437, p438)
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_430
				if p437 then
					p437 = p438 ~= string.lower(v_u_430)
				end
				return p437
			end):hook(function(p439)
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_433
				v_u_433(p439)
			end)
			p429.Destroying:Connect(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_431, (ref) p_u_425, (ref) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_430, (ref) v_u_2
				v_u_431:Destroy()
				if p_u_425.Parent then
					v_u_32[string.lower(v_u_430)]:set(nil)
					local v440 = v_u_32.display_model:get()
					local v441 = table.find(v_u_2.classes, v_u_32.chosen_class:get())
					equip_item_attachment(v441, v440.Name, string.lower(v_u_430))
				end
			end)
			p429.Destroying:Connect(v_u_32[string.lower(v_u_430)]:hook(function(p442)
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_431, (ref) v_u_11, (ref) p_u_426, (copy) v_u_430
				if v_u_431 ~= nil and v_u_431.Parent ~= nil then
					if p442 then
						local v443 = v_u_11.get_item_class(p442)
						if v443 and (v443.items[p_u_426] or v_u_430 == "Charm") then
							v_u_431.AttachmentButton.ImageLabel.Visible = true
							v_u_431.AttachmentButton.Empty.Visible = false
							v_u_431.AttachmentButton.ImageLabel.Image = v443.icon ~= "" and v443.icon or v443.image
							v_u_431.AttachmentButton.ImageLabel.ImageColor3 = v443.image_color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
							if v443.bg_color then
								v_u_431.AttachmentButton.ImageLabel.BackgroundColor3 = v443.bg_color
								v_u_431.AttachmentButton.ImageLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 0
							end
							v_u_431.AttachmentButton.ImageLabel.Size = v_u_430 == "Skin" and UDim2.fromScale(0.7, 0.7) or UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
							return
						end
					end
					v_u_431.AttachmentButton.ImageLabel.Visible = false
					v_u_431.AttachmentButton.Empty.Visible = true
				end
			end).unhook)
		end
	end)
	local v444 = v_u_32.chosen_class:get()
	local v445 = v444.attachments
	if v445 then
		v445 = v444.attachments[p_u_426]
	end
	if v445 then
		for _, v446 in v_u_16.attachment_types do
			local v447 = v_u_11.get_item_class(v445[v446])
			if not v447 or not v447.items[p_u_426] and v446 ~= "charm" or v447.loadout_type ~= v446 then
				continue
			end
			v_u_32[v446]:set(v445[v446])
		end
	end
end
function setup_release_week(p_u_448, p_u_449, p_u_450, p_u_451, p452) -- name: setup_release_week
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_33, (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_15, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_32
	local v_u_453 = v_u_3.get("ItemTemplate")
	local function v455() -- name: update_ownership
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_450, (copy) p_u_451, (copy) v_u_453
		local v454 = p_u_450:GetAttribute("new") and true or false
		if owns_item(p_u_451) then
			p_u_450.LockedOverlay.Visible = false
			p_u_450.LayoutOrder = v454 and 0 or (p_u_450:GetAttribute("order") or 1)
			p_u_450.Visible = true
		else
			p_u_450.LockedOverlay.Visible = true
			p_u_450.LayoutOrder = v454 and 99 or 100
			if p_u_450:GetAttribute("hidden") then
				p_u_450.Visible = false
			end
		end
		p_u_450.NewLabel.Visible = v454
		p_u_450.UIStroke.Color = v454 and Color3.fromRGB(157, 133, 0) or v_u_453.UIStroke.Color
		p_u_450.LockedOverlay.Unlock.ImageColor3 = v454 and Color3.fromRGB(255, 247, 11) or v_u_453.LockedOverlay.Unlock.ImageColor3
		p_u_450.LockedOverlay.Lock.ImageColor3 = v454 and Color3.fromRGB(255, 247, 11) or v_u_453.LockedOverlay.Unlock.ImageColor3
		p_u_450.LockedOverlay.ReleaseTimer.TextColor3 = v454 and Color3.fromRGB(255, 247, 11) or v_u_453.LockedOverlay.ReleaseTimer.TextColor3
	end
	p452:add(v_u_2.hook("owned", v455).unhook)
	p452:add(v_u_33:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Subscribed"):Connect(v455))
	p452:add(v_u_13.is_admin:hook(v455).unhook)
	p_u_450:GetAttributeChangedSignal("hidden"):Connect(v455)
	p_u_450:GetAttributeChangedSignal("new"):Connect(v455)
	if p_u_448.new_item then
		p_u_450:SetAttribute("new", p_u_448.new_item)
	end
	local v_u_456 = 0
	if p_u_448.release_stamp and v_u_17.FLAG_RELEASE_WEEK_ITEMS then
		local v_u_457 = nil
		v_u_457 = v_u_6.new(1, function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_456, (ref) v_u_15, (copy) p_u_448, (copy) p_u_450, (ref) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_457
			v_u_456 = v_u_15.get_seconds_until_stamp(p_u_448.release_stamp)
			p_u_450.LockedOverlay.ReleaseTimer.Text = ("Releases in %*"):format((v_u_4.seconds_to_legible_time(v_u_456)))
			p_u_450.LockedOverlay.ReleaseTimer.Visible = v_u_456 > 0
			p_u_450:SetAttribute("hidden", v_u_456 > 604800)
			p_u_450:SetAttribute("new", p_u_448.new_item or v_u_456 > -1209600)
			if v_u_456 <= 0 then
				task.defer(function()
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_457
					v_u_457:stop()
				end)
			end
		end)
		p452:add(function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_457
			v_u_457:stop()
		end)
		local v461 = v_u_7.dependency({ v_u_32.enabled, v_u_32.current_tab }, function(p458, p459)
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_449, (ref) v_u_456
			local v460 = p458 and (p459 and string.find(p459, p_u_449))
			if v460 then
				v460 = v_u_456 > -1209600
			end
			return v460
		end)
		p452:add(v461.unhook)
		p452:add(v461:hook(function(p462)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_457
			if p462 then
				v_u_457:resume()
			else
				v_u_457:stop()
			end
		end).unhook)
	end
end
v_u_32.primary = v_u_7.new(nil)
v_u_32.secondary = v_u_7.new(nil)
function setup_guns() -- name: setup_guns
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_16
	local v_u_463 = v_u_3.get("ItemTemplate")
	local v_u_464 = v_u_7.new(nil)
	v_u_464:hook(function(p465, p466)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_32, (ref) v_u_4
		if p466 and p466.Parent ~= nil then
			local v467 = p466.Root:FindFirstChild("HolsterWeld")
			if v467 then
				v467:Destroy()
			end
			p466:PivotTo(v_u_32.character[p466:GetAttribute("HolsterPart")]:GetPivot() * p466:GetAttribute("HolsterOffset"))
			p466.Parent = v_u_32.character.to_clear
			v_u_4.weld_c(p466.Root, v_u_32.character[p466:GetAttribute("HolsterPart")]).Name = "HolsterWeld"
		end
		if p465 then
			local v468 = p465.Root:FindFirstChild("HolsterWeld")
			if v468 then
				v468:Destroy()
			end
			p465:PivotTo(v_u_32.character.arm1:GetPivot() * p465:GetAttribute("EquipOffset"))
			p465.Parent = v_u_32.character.arm1
			v_u_4.weld_c(p465.Root, v_u_32.character.arm1).Name = "HolsterWeld"
			v_u_32.current_animation:set(p465:GetAttribute("loadout_type") .. "_hold")
		else
			v_u_32.current_animation:set("")
		end
	end)
	local function v_u_471() -- name: update_current_animate_model
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_11, (ref) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_464
		local v469 = v_u_11.get_item_class(v_u_32.primary:get())
		local v470 = v_u_11.get_item_class(v_u_32.secondary:get())
		if v469 == nil or v469.tag ~= "Gun" then
			if v470 == nil or v470.tag ~= "Gun" then
				v_u_464:set(nil)
			else
				v_u_464:set(v_u_32.character:FindFirstChild(v_u_32.secondary:get(), true))
			end
		else
			v_u_464:set(v_u_32.character:FindFirstChild(v_u_32.primary:get(), true))
			return
		end
	end
	local v_u_472 = v_u_9.new()
	v_u_32.current_tab:hook(function(p473)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_472, (ref) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_463, (ref) v_u_3, (ref) v_u_32
		v_u_472:clean()
		if table.find({ "primary", "secondary" }, p473) then
			local v_u_474 = string.lower(p473)
			for _, v_u_475 in v_u_11.get_all_items_of_loadout(v_u_474) do
				local v_u_476 = v_u_475.model.Parent.Name
				local v_u_477 = v_u_463:Clone()
				v_u_477.Visible = true
				v_u_477:SetAttribute("name", v_u_476)
				v_u_477:SetAttribute("hidden", v_u_475.hidden)
				v_u_477:SetAttribute("loadout_type", v_u_475.loadout_type)
				v_u_477.ImageLabel.Image = v_u_475.image
				v_u_472:add(v_u_477)
				v_u_477.Name = "Item"
				v_u_477.Parent = v_u_3.get("ItemTemplate").Parent
				setup_release_week(v_u_475, v_u_474, v_u_477, v_u_476, v_u_472)
				hover_animation(v_u_477)
				v_u_3.hover(v_u_477, function(p478)
					-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_475, (ref) v_u_32
					if p478 then
						if v_u_475.tag == "Gun" then
							v_u_32.gun_info:set(v_u_475)
						else
							v_u_32.item_info:set(v_u_475)
						end
					elseif v_u_32.gun_info:get() == v_u_475 then
						v_u_32.gun_info:set(nil)
					elseif v_u_32.item_info:get() == v_u_475 then
						v_u_32.item_info:set(nil)
					end
				end)
				v_u_3.on_click(v_u_477, function()
					-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_477, (ref) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_474, (copy) v_u_476
					if v_u_477.LockedFrame.Visible then
						return
					elseif v_u_477.LockedOverlay.Visible then
						v_u_32.buy_frame:set({
							["loadout_type"] = v_u_474,
							["name"] = v_u_476,
							["try_out"] = v_u_32.main_menu:get()
						})
					else
						v_u_32[v_u_474]:set(v_u_476)
					end
				end)
				v_u_3.right_click(v_u_477, function()
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_474, (copy) v_u_476
					v_u_32.buy_frame:set({
						["loadout_type"] = v_u_474,
						["name"] = v_u_476,
						["try_out"] = v_u_32.main_menu:get()
					})
				end)
				v_u_472:add(v_u_32[v_u_474]:hook(function(p479)
					-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_477, (copy) v_u_476
					v_u_477.Frame.Dot.Equipped.Visible = p479 == v_u_476
				end).unhook)
			end
		end
	end)
	for _, v480 in { "Primary", "Secondary" } do
		local v_u_481 = string.lower(v480)
		local v_u_482 = nil
		local v_u_483 = nil
		local v_u_484 = v_u_32.loadout_cubicle:get():FindFirstChild("GunAttachment", true)
		local v_u_485 = v_u_3.get(v_u_4.capitalize_first(v_u_481) .. "Button")
		v_u_3.on_click(v_u_485, function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_481
			v_u_32.current_tab:set(v_u_481)
		end)
		hover_animation(v_u_485)
		v_u_32[v_u_481]:hook(function(p486, _)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_481, (ref) v_u_482, (ref) v_u_11, (ref) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_485, (copy) v_u_471, (ref) v_u_483, (copy) v_u_484
			if v_u_32.current_tab:get() ~= v_u_481 then
				if v_u_482 then
					v_u_482:Destroy()
					v_u_482 = nil
				end
				if p486 then
					local v487 = v_u_11.get_item_class(p486)
					if v487 and (v_u_482 == nil and v487.holster_part) then
						local v488 = v487.model:Clone()
						local v489 = v487.holster_offset
						v488.Name = p486
						v488:SetAttribute("loadout_type", v_u_481)
						v488:SetAttribute("HolsterOffset", v489)
						v488:SetAttribute("EquipOffset", v487.equip_offset)
						v488:SetAttribute("HolsterPart", v487.holster_part)
						v488:PivotTo(v_u_32.character[v488:GetAttribute("HolsterPart")]:GetPivot() * v488:GetAttribute("HolsterOffset"))
						v488.Parent = v_u_32.character.to_clear
						v_u_4.weld_c(v488.Root, v_u_32.character[v488:GetAttribute("HolsterPart")]).Name = "HolsterWeld"
						v_u_4.weld_model(v488)
						v_u_482 = v488
						local v490 = v_u_32.chosen_class:get()
						local v491 = v490.attachments
						if v491 then
							v491 = v490.attachments[p486]
						end
						if v491 then
							for _, v492 in v_u_16.attachment_types do
								local v493 = v_u_11.get_item_class(v491[v492])
								if not v493 or (not is_attachment_valid(p486, v491[v492]) or v493.loadout_type ~= v492) then
									continue
								end
								local _, v494 = v493:apply({
									["instance"] = v_u_482
								})
								if not v494 then
									continue
								end
								v494:set(true)
							end
						end
					end
					v_u_485.ImageLabel.Visible = true
					v_u_485.Empty.Visible = false
					if v487 then
						v_u_485.ImageLabel.Image = v487.image
					end
				else
					v_u_485.ImageLabel.Visible = false
					v_u_485.Empty.Visible = true
				end
				v_u_471()
			end
			if v_u_483 then
				v_u_483:Destroy()
				v_u_483 = nil
				for _, v495 in v_u_16.attachment_types do
					v_u_32[v495]:set(nil)
				end
			end
			if v_u_32.current_tab:get() == v_u_481 and p486 then
				local v496 = v_u_11.get_item_class(p486).model:Clone()
				v496.Name = p486
				v496.Parent = game.Workspace
				v496:SetAttribute("loadout_type", v_u_481)
				v496:PivotTo(v_u_484.WorldCFrame)
				v_u_4.center_pivot_longitude(v496)
				v_u_483 = v496
				v_u_32.display_model:set(v_u_483)
				local v497 = {
					["Barrel"] = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0.2),
					["Scope"] = Vector3.new(0.25, 0, 0),
					["Grip"] = Vector3.new(-0.25, 0, 0),
					["Under"] = Vector3.new(0, 0.25, 0),
					["Stock"] = Vector3.new(0, 0, -0.2)
				}
				if not v_u_11.has_attachment(p486, "grip") then
					v497.Under = v497.Grip
				end
				setup_attachment_guis(v496, p486, v497)
			end
		end)
		v_u_32.current_tab:hook(function(p498, p499)
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_481, (ref) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_32
			if p498 == v_u_481 and not table.find(v_u_16.attachment_types, p499) then
				v_u_32[v_u_481]:update()
			elseif p499 == v_u_481 and not table.find(v_u_16.attachment_types, p498) then
				v_u_32[v_u_481]:update()
			end
		end)
	end
end
v_u_32.icon = v_u_7.new(nil)
function setup_icons() -- name: setup_icons
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_4
	v_u_3.get("IconTemplate").Visible = false
	local v_u_500 = v_u_9.new()
	v_u_32.current_tab:hook(function(p501)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_500, (ref) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_3, (ref) v_u_32, (ref) v_u_4
		v_u_500:clean()
		if p501 == "icons" then
			for v_u_502, v503 in v_u_16.icons do
				local v_u_504 = v_u_3.get("IconTemplate"):Clone()
				v_u_504.Name = "Icon"
				v_u_504.Visible = true
				v_u_504:SetAttribute("name", v_u_502)
				v_u_504:SetAttribute("hidden", v503.hidden)
				v_u_504:SetAttribute("loadout_type", "icons")
				v_u_504:SetAttribute("order", v_u_502 == "empty" and 0 or 1)
				v_u_504.Parent = v_u_3.get("IconTemplate").Parent
				script.ClassIconGradient:Clone().Parent = v_u_504.ImageLabel
				v_u_16.apply_icon(v_u_504.ImageLabel, v_u_502)
				v_u_500:add(v_u_504)
				setup_release_week(v503, p501, v_u_504, v_u_502, v_u_500)
				hover_animation(v_u_504)
				v_u_3.on_click(v_u_504, function()
					-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_504, (ref) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_502
					if v_u_504.LockedOverlay.Visible then
						local v505 = {
							["loadout_type"] = "icon",
							["name"] = nil,
							["name"] = v_u_502
						}
						v_u_32.buy_frame:set(v505)
					else
						v_u_32.icon:set(v_u_502)
					end
				end)
				v_u_3.right_click(v_u_504, function()
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_502
					local v506 = {
						["loadout_type"] = "icon",
						["name"] = nil,
						["name"] = v_u_502
					}
					v_u_32.buy_frame:set(v506)
				end)
				v_u_500:add(v_u_32.icon:hook(function(p507)
					-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_504, (copy) v_u_502
					local v508 = v_u_504.Frame.Dot.Equipped
					if p507 then
						p507 = p507 == v_u_502
					end
					v508.Visible = p507
				end).unhook)
				v_u_500:add(v_u_32.color:hook(function(p509)
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_504, (ref) v_u_16
					v_u_4.tween(v_u_504.ImageLabel, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {
						["ImageColor3"] = v_u_16.colors[p509 or "gray"]
					})
				end).unhook)
			end
		end
	end)
	local v_u_510 = v_u_3.get("ClassTitle").ClassIcon
	v_u_3.on_click(v_u_510, function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_32
		v_u_32.current_tab:set("icons")
	end)
	hover_animation(v_u_510)
	v_u_32.icon:hook(function(p511)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_510
		if p511 then
			v_u_16.apply_icon(v_u_510.ImageLabel, p511)
		end
	end)
end

v_u_32.class_name = v_u_7.new(nil)
function setup_class_name() -- name: setup_class_name
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_1
	local v_u_517 = v_u_3.get("ClassTitle")
	v_u_32.class_name:hook(function(p518)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_517
		if p518 then
			v_u_517.Title.Text = p518
		end
	end)
	local v519 = v_u_3.get("EditName")
	local v_u_520 = ""
	v_u_3.on_click(v519, function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_32, (ref) v_u_520, (copy) v_u_517
		if not v_u_17.FLAG_DISPLAY_CLASS_NAMES or v_u_32.confirm("Notice", "Inappropriate names can lead to permanent bans!", "I understand") then
			v_u_520 = v_u_517.Title.Text
			v_u_517.Title.TextEditable = true
			v_u_517.Title.Interactable = true
			v_u_517.Title:CaptureFocus()
		end
	end)
	v_u_517.Title.Focused:Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_517
		v_u_32.inputs:get("back").enabled = false
		v_u_517.Title.UIStroke.Enabled = true
		v_u_517.Title.BackgroundTransparency = 0.7
	end)
	v_u_517.Title.FocusLost:Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_517, (ref) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_520
		v_u_32.inputs:get("back").enabled = true
		v_u_517.Title.Interactable = false
		v_u_517.Title.TextEditable = false
		v_u_517.Title.UIStroke.Enabled = false
		v_u_517.Title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		local v521 = table.find(v_u_2.classes, v_u_32.chosen_class:get())
		local v522, v523 = v_u_1.get("change_class_name", v521, v_u_517.Title.Text)
		if v522 == false then
			v_u_517.Title.Text = v_u_520
			if v523 then
				task.spawn(display_notification, v523, nil)
				return
			end
		else
			v_u_517.Title.Text = v522
			v_u_2.classes[v521].name = v522
		end
	end)
	hover_animation(v519)
end
v_u_32.hat = v_u_7.new(nil)
function setup_hats() -- name: setup_hats
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_16
	local v_u_524 = v_u_9.new()
	v_u_32.current_tab:hook(function(p525)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_524, (ref) v_u_11, (ref) v_u_3, (ref) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_32
		v_u_524:clean()
		if p525 == "hat" then
			for _, v_u_526 in v_u_11.get_all_items_of_loadout("hat") do
				local v_u_527 = v_u_526.model.Parent.Name
				local v_u_528 = v_u_3.get("ItemTemplate"):Clone()
				v_u_528.Visible = true
				v_u_528:SetAttribute("name", v_u_527)
				v_u_528:SetAttribute("hidden", v_u_526.hidden)

function owns_item(p554, p555) -- name: owns_item
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_33, (copy) v_u_11
	if v_u_13.is_admin:get() and not p555 then
		return true
	end
	if v_u_16.bundles[p554] then
		return v_u_2.bundles[p554] and true or false
	end
	local v556 = typeof(p554) == "string" and { p554 } or p554
	if v_u_33:GetAttribute("Subscribed") and not p555 then
		local v557 = true
		for _, v558 in v556 do
			local v559 = v_u_11.get_item_class(v558)
			if v559 and table.find(v_u_16.item_types, v559.loadout_type) then
				continue
			end
			v557 = false
		end
		if v557 then
			return true
		end
	end
	if v_u_2.owned == nil then
		return false
	end
	for _, v560 in v556 do
		if v_u_2.owned[v560] == true then
			continue
		end
		local v561 = v_u_2.owned[v560]
		if typeof(v561) == "table" and v_u_2.owned[v560].owned then
			continue
		end
		return false
	end
	return true
end
function owns_attachment(p562, p563, p564) -- name: owns_attachment
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_2
	if v_u_13.is_admin:get() and not p564 then
		return true
	end
	if v_u_11.get_item_class(p563).loadout_type ~= "charm" then
		v566 = v_u_2.owned[p562]
		if v566 then
			v566 = v_u_2.owned[p562][p563]
		end
		return v566
	end
	if v_u_2.owned[p563] == true then
		v566 = true
		return v566
	end
	local v565 = v_u_2.owned[p563]
	local v566 = typeof(v565) == "table" and v_u_2.owned[p563].owned
	if v566 then
		return v566
	end
	v566 = v_u_2.owned[p562]
	if v566 then
		v566 = v_u_2.owned[p562][p563]
	end
	return v566
end
function is_attachment_valid(p567, p568) -- name: is_attachment_valid
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_11
	local v569 = v_u_11.get_item_class(p567)
	local v570 = v_u_11.get_item_class(p568)
	return v_u_11.get_item_model(p567) and (v569 and (v570 and (v570.items[p567] or v570.loadout_type == "charm"))) and true or false
end
for _, v571 in v_u_16.attachment_types do
	v_u_32[v571] = v_u_7.new(nil)
end
function setup_attachments() -- name: setup_attachments

						v_u_32.item_info:set(v_u_579)
					elseif v_u_32.item_info:get() == v_u_579 then

					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_574, (copy) v_u_580
					local v592 = v_u_32.buy_frame
					local v593 = {
						["loadout_type"] = v_u_574,
						["name"] = v_u_580,
						["try_out"] = v_u_32.main_menu:get()
					}
					local v594
					if v_u_574 == "charm" then
						v594 = false
					else
						v594 = v_u_32.display_model:get().Name
					end
					v593.attachment_for = v594
					v592:set(v593)

	for _, v_u_596 in v_u_16.attachment_types do

						end).unhook)
					end

					end
				end
			end
		end)
	end
end

function setup_gadgets() -- name: setup_gadgets
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_4
	local v_u_606 = v_u_9.new()
	v_u_32.current_tab:hook(function(p_u_607)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_606, (ref) v_u_3, (ref) v_u_32, (ref) v_u_11
		v_u_606:clean()
		if p_u_607 == "gadget1" or p_u_607 == "gadget2" then

function setup_spawning() -- name: setup_spawning
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_33, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_20, (copy) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_19, (copy) v_u_7
	local v_u_662 = v_u_3.get("SpawnButton")
	local v_u_663 = v_u_3.get("SpawnFrame")
	local v_u_667 = v_u_6.new(1, function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_33, (ref) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_662, (copy) v_u_663
		if v_u_33:GetAttribute("RespawnStamp") ~= nil then
			local v664 = v_u_33:GetAttribute("RespawnStamp") - v_u_4.os_time()
			if v_u_33:GetAttribute("CanDrone") then
				v664 = v664 - 30
			end
			if v664 > 0 then
				v_u_662.Cooldown.Text = ("%* Seconds"):format(v664)
				v_u_662.LockedFrame.Visible = true
			else
				v_u_662.Cooldown.Text = ""
				v_u_662.LockedFrame.Visible = false
			end
			v_u_662.Visible = v664 < 1000
			local v665 = v_u_663.Key
			local v666
			if v664 < 1000 then
				v666 = v_u_663.Key:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("GuiBase2d")
			else
				v666 = false
			end
			v665.Visible = v666
		end
	end, nil, "global")
	local v_u_668 = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Modules.SpectateInterface)
	local function v_u_673(p669) -- name: spawn_function
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_32, (ref) v_u_14, (ref) v_u_1
		local v670 = table.find(v_u_2.classes, v_u_32.chosen_class:get())
		v_u_14.start_medium()
		game.Workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame = CFrame.new(game.Workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position)
		local v671, v672 = v_u_1.get("spawn", v670, p669)
		if v671 then
			v_u_32.enabled:set(false)
		else
			v_u_32.current_tab:set("loadout")
			v_u_14.stop_medium()
			task.spawn(display_notification, v672, nil)
		end
	end
	local function v_u_675() -- name: spawn_function_button
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_33, (ref) v_u_14, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_668, (copy) v_u_673
		if is_spawn_on_cooldown() then
			return
		elseif game.Workspace:GetAttribute("Gamemode") == "Bomb" and (v_u_33.Team and v_u_33.Team:GetAttribute("Attack")) then
			v_u_14.transition()
			local v674 = v_u_20.get("Player", v_u_33).states.viewing:get()
			if v674 then
				require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Modules.ObservationsInterface).exit_observation_tool(nil, v_u_20.get(v674.Name, v674))
			end
			v_u_32.enabled:set(true)
			v_u_668.enabled:set(false)
			v_u_32.current_tab:set("spawn_location")
		else
			v_u_673()
		end
	end
	v_u_32.spawn_function_button = v_u_675
	local v_u_676 = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Modules.SpectateInterface)
	v_u_1.hook("spawn", function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_14, (ref) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_676
		game.Workspace:SetAttribute("LoadedScreen", true)
		v_u_14.start_medium()
		v_u_32.enabled:set(false)
		v_u_676.enabled:set(false)
	end)
	v_u_3.on_click(v_u_662, function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_662, (copy) v_u_675
		if not v_u_662.LockedFrame.Visible then
			v_u_675()
		end
	end)
	v_u_12.update_key_image(v_u_663.Key, "spawn_character")
	v_u_32.inputs:get("spawn_character"):press(function(p677)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_663, (copy) v_u_662, (ref) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_675
		if p677 and (v_u_663.Visible and (not v_u_662.LockedFrame.Visible and v_u_32.inputs:get("spawn_character"):holding())) then
			v_u_675()
		end
	end)
	hover_animation(v_u_662)
	v_u_32.enabled:hook(function(p678)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_667, (ref) v_u_32
		if p678 then
			v_u_667:resume()
			if v_u_32.current_tab:get() == "spawn_location" then
				v_u_32.current_tab:set("loadout")
				return
			end
		else
			v_u_667:stop()
		end
	end)
	local v_u_679 = v_u_9.new()
	v_u_19.current_map:hook(function(p680)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_679, (ref) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_33, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_673, (ref) v_u_7, (ref) v_u_32
		v_u_679:clean()
		if p680 then
			local v681 = p680:WaitForChild("SpawnZones")
			v_u_679:add(v_u_4.hook_child_added(v681, function(p_u_682)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_33, (ref) v_u_679, (ref) v_u_3, (ref) v_u_673, (ref) v_u_7, (ref) v_u_32
				local v_u_683 = script.SpawnGui:Clone()
				v_u_683.Parent = v_u_33.PlayerGui
				v_u_683.Adornee = p_u_682
				v_u_679:add(v_u_683)
				hover_animation(v_u_683.SpawnGuiButton)
				v_u_3.on_click(v_u_683.SpawnGuiButton, function()
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_673, (copy) p_u_682
					v_u_673(p_u_682)
				end)
				v_u_679:add(v_u_7.dependency({ v_u_32.enabled, v_u_32.current_tab }, function(p684, p685)
					if p684 then
						p684 = p685 == "spawn_location"
					end
					return p684
				end):hook(function(p686)
					-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_683
					v_u_683.Enabled = p686
				end).unhook)
			end))
		end
	end)
	v_u_7.dependency({ v_u_32.enabled, v_u_32.current_tab }, function(p687, p688)
		if p687 then
			p687 = p688 ~= "spawn_location"
		end
		return p687
	end):hook(function(p689)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_3
		if p689 then
			v_u_3.hook_world_billboards("loadout", function(p690)
				p690.Visible = false
			end)
		else
			v_u_3.unhook_world_billboards("loadout")
			for _, v691 in v_u_3.get_world_billboards() do
				v691.Visible = true
			end
		end
	end)
end
function practice_function() -- name: practice_function
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_32
	if v_u_3.get("ConfirmButton").LockedFrame.Visible then
		return
	else
		v_u_14.start_medium()
		local v692, _ = v_u_1.get("spawn_practice", v_u_32.chosen_class:get())
		if v692 then
			v_u_32.enabled:set(false)
		else
			v_u_14.stop_medium()
		end
	end
end
function setup_spectating() -- name: setup_spectating
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_20, (copy) v_u_4
	local v_u_693 = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Modules.SpectateInterface)
	local v_u_694 = v_u_3.get("SpectateFrame")
	local v_u_695 = v_u_3.get("SpectateButton")
	local function v_u_696() -- name: spectate_function
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_694, (copy) v_u_695, (ref) v_u_14, (ref) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_693
		if v_u_694.Visible and not v_u_695.LockedFrame.Visible then
			v_u_14.transition_on()
			v_u_32.enabled:set(false)
			if not v_u_693.enable_spectating() then
				v_u_32.enabled:set(true)
			end
			v_u_14.transition_off()
		end
	end
	v_u_3.on_click(v_u_695, v_u_696)
	v_u_12.update_key_image(v_u_694.Key, "change_loadout")
	v_u_32.inputs:get("change_loadout"):press(function(p697)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_696
		if p697 then
			v_u_696()
		end
	end)
	hover_animation(v_u_695)
	local v_u_698 = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Modules.ObservationsInterface)
	local v_u_700 = v_u_6.new(0.5, function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_695, (copy) v_u_698
		for _, v699 in v_u_20.get_all("Character") do
			if v_u_4.ownership(v699.owner:get()) ~= 2 or v699.clean:get() then
				continue
			end
			v_u_695.LockedFrame.Visible = false
			v_u_695.Selectable = true
			return
		end
		if #v_u_698.get_observation_devices() > 0 then
			v_u_695.LockedFrame.Visible = false
			v_u_695.Selectable = true
		else
			v_u_695.LockedFrame.Visible = true
			v_u_695.Selectable = false
		end
	end)
	v_u_32.enabled:hook(function(p701)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_700
		if p701 then
			v_u_700:resume()
		else
			v_u_700:stop()
		end
	end)
end
function setup_overlay_menu() -- name: setup_overlay_menu
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_34
	v_u_3.auto_scroll_frame_size(v_u_3.get("LeftOverlayMenu").ScrollingFrame)
	local v_u_702 = { v_u_3.get("BottomOverlayMenu"), v_u_3.get("LeftOverlayMenu") }
	local v_u_706 = v_u_4.ov(function(p703)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_3, (ref) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_702
		if p703 then
			v_u_3.sounds.Overlay()
			v_u_3.get("DarkOverlay").Visible = true
			v_u_4.tween(v_u_3.get("DarkOverlay"), TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
				["BackgroundTransparency"] = 0.3

		end
		for _, v704 in v_u_702 do
			if v704 == p703 then
				v704.Position = v704:GetAttribute("RestingPosition")
				v704.Visible = true

					["Position"] = v704:GetAttribute("OpenPosition")
				})
			else
				v_u_4.tween(v704, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
					["Position"] = v704:GetAttribute("RestingPosition")
				})
			end
		end
		if p703 == nil then
			v_u_4.tween(v_u_3.get("DarkOverlay"), TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
				["BackgroundTransparency"] = 1
			}).Completed:Wait()
			v_u_3.get("DarkOverlay").Visible = false
		end
		for _, v705 in v_u_702 do

	local v_u_710 = nil
	local v_u_711 = nil
	v_u_32.current_overlay:hook(function(p712, p713, p714)

		if p712 == "" then

			end

			v_u_707:enable()
			v_u_706(v_u_3.get(v716))

		v_u_3.get("ItemIconsFrame").Visible = p712 == "item_icons"

function v_u_32.load_team_loadouts(p718)
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_33, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_4
	if v_u_33:GetAttribute("Spectator") or v_u_33.Team == p718 then
		v_u_3.get("TeamClassInfoTemplate").Visible = false
		v_u_32.current_overlay:set("team_loadouts")
		local v719 = v_u_1.get("get_team_loadouts", p718)
		if v719 then
			for _, v720 in v_u_3.get("TeamClassInfoTemplate").Parent:GetChildren() do
				if not (v720:IsA("Frame") and v720.Visible) then
					continue
				end
				v720:Destroy()
			end
			for _, v_u_721 in v719 do
				local v722 = v_u_721.class
				local v_u_723 = game.Players:GetPlayerByUserId(v_u_721.user_id)
				if v_u_723 == nil or v722 == nil then
					continue
				end
				local v_u_724 = v_u_3.get("TeamClassInfoTemplate"):Clone()
				v_u_724.Visible = true
				v_u_724.LayoutOrder = v_u_723:GetAttribute("ID") or 0
				v_u_724.Info:FindFirstChild("ClassName").Text = v_u_17.FLAG_DISPLAY_CLASS_NAMES and (v722.name or "") or ""
				v_u_16.apply_icon(v_u_724.Info.ClassIcon.ImageLabel, v722.icon)
				v_u_724.Info.ClassIcon.ImageLabel.ImageColor3 = v_u_16.colors[v722.color or "gray"]
				if v722.primary and v_u_11.get_item_class(v722.primary) then
					v_u_724.GunsMenu.Primary.Empty.Visible = false
					v_u_724.GunsMenu.Primary.ImageLabel.Image = v_u_11.get_item_class(v722.primary).icon
					v_u_724.GunsMenu.Primary.ImageLabel.Visible = true
				end
				if v722.secondary and v_u_11.get_item_class(v722.secondary) then
					v_u_724.GunsMenu.Secondary.Empty.Visible = false
					v_u_724.GunsMenu.Secondary.ImageLabel.Image = v_u_11.get_item_class(v722.secondary).icon
					v_u_724.GunsMenu.Secondary.ImageLabel.Visible = true
				end
				if v722.gadget1 and v_u_11.get_item_class(v722.gadget1) then
					v_u_724.GadgetsMenu.Gadget1.Empty.Visible = false
					v_u_724.GadgetsMenu.Gadget1.ImageLabel.Image = v_u_11.get_item_class(v722.gadget1).icon
					v_u_724.GadgetsMenu.Gadget1.ImageLabel.Visible = true
				end
				if v722.gadget2 and v_u_11.get_item_class(v722.gadget2) then
					v_u_724.GadgetsMenu.Gadget2.Empty.Visible = false
					v_u_724.GadgetsMenu.Gadget2.ImageLabel.Image = v_u_11.get_item_class(v722.gadget2).icon
					v_u_724.GadgetsMenu.Gadget2.ImageLabel.Visible = true
				end
				if v722.utility1 and v_u_11.get_item_class(v722.utility1) then
					v_u_724.UtilityMenu.Utility1.Empty.Visible = false
					v_u_724.UtilityMenu.Utility1.ImageLabel.Image = v_u_11.get_item_class(v722.utility1).icon
					v_u_724.UtilityMenu.Utility1.ImageLabel.Visible = true
				end
				if v722.utility2 and v_u_11.get_item_class(v722.utility2) then
					v_u_724.UtilityMenu.Utility2.Empty.Visible = false
					v_u_724.UtilityMenu.Utility2.ImageLabel.Image = v_u_11.get_item_class(v722.utility2).icon
					v_u_724.UtilityMenu.Utility2.ImageLabel.Visible = true
				end
				local v_u_725 = v_u_9.new()
				local function v726() -- name: update_defuser
					-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_721, (copy) v_u_723, (copy) v_u_724
					if game.Workspace:GetAttribute("DefuserAvailable") == v_u_721.user_id or v_u_723:GetAttribute("HasDefuser") then
						v_u_724.Info.Folder.Defuser.Visible = true
					else
						v_u_724.Info.Folder.Defuser.Visible = false
					end
				end
				v_u_725:add(v_u_4.watch_attribute(game.Workspace, "DefuserAvailable", v726))
				v_u_725:add(v_u_4.watch_attribute(v_u_723, "HasDefuser", v726))
				v_u_724.Destroying:Connect(function()
					-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_725
					v_u_725:clean()
				end)
				v_u_724.Parent = v_u_3.get("TeamClassInfoTemplate").Parent
			end
		end
	end
end
function setup_team_loadouts() -- name: setup_team_loadouts
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_33, (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_7
	v_u_3.get("TeamClassInfoTemplate").Visible = false
	local v_u_727 = v_u_3.get("TeamLoadoutsButton")
	hover_animation(v_u_727)
	v_u_3.on_click(v_u_727, function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_32, (ref) v_u_33
		v_u_32.load_team_loadouts(v_u_33.Team)
	end)
	v_u_3.get("PickDefuserButton").Visible = false
	local v_u_728 = v_u_3.get("PickDefuserButton")
	hover_animation(v_u_728)
	v_u_3.on_click(v_u_728, function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_33, (ref) v_u_1
		if game.Workspace:GetAttribute("DefuserAvailable") == true or game.Workspace:GetAttribute("DefuserAvailable") == v_u_33.UserId then
			if game.Workspace:GetAttribute("DefuserAvailable") == v_u_33.UserId then
				game.Workspace:SetAttribute("DefuserAvailable", true)
			else
				game.Workspace:SetAttribute("DefuserAvailable", v_u_33.UserId)
			end
			v_u_1.send("pick_up_defuser")
		end
	end)
	local v_u_729 = v_u_9.new()
	v_u_4.watch_property(v_u_728, "Visible", function(p730)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_729, (ref) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_33, (copy) v_u_728
		v_u_729:clean()
		if p730 then
			v_u_729:add(v_u_4.watch_attribute(game.Workspace, "DefuserAvailable", function(p731)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_33, (ref) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_728
				if p731 == v_u_33.UserId then
					v_u_4.tween(v_u_728.Defuser, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {
						["ImageColor3"] = Color3.fromRGB(255, 226, 6)
					})
				elseif p731 == true then
					v_u_4.tween(v_u_728.Defuser, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {
						["ImageColor3"] = Color3.fromRGB(106, 106, 106)
					})
				else
					v_u_4.tween(v_u_728.Defuser, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {
						["ImageColor3"] = Color3.fromRGB(220, 5, 5)
					})
				end
				v_u_728.TextLabel.Visible = p731 == true
			end))
		end
	end)
	local v_u_734 = v_u_7.dependency({ v_u_32.main_menu, v_u_32.enabled }, function(p732, p733)
		return not p732 and p733
	end)
	local function v_u_737() -- name: update_defuser_button_visibility
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_728, (copy) v_u_734, (ref) v_u_33
		local v735 = v_u_728
		local v736 = v_u_734:get() and (v_u_33.Team and v_u_33.Team:GetAttribute("Attack"))
		if v736 then
			v736 = game.Workspace:GetAttribute("Gamemode") == "Bomb"
		end
		v735.Visible = v736
	end
	v_u_734:hook(function(p738)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_727, (copy) v_u_728, (copy) v_u_734, (ref) v_u_33
		v_u_727.Visible = p738
		local v739 = v_u_728
		local v740 = v_u_734:get() and (v_u_33.Team and v_u_33.Team:GetAttribute("Attack"))
		if v740 then
			v740 = game.Workspace:GetAttribute("Gamemode") == "Bomb"
		end
		v739.Visible = v740
	end)
	local v_u_741 = v_u_9.new()
	v_u_4.watch_property(v_u_33, "Team", function(p742)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_741, (ref) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_737
		v_u_741:clean()
		if p742 then
			v_u_741:add(v_u_4.watch_attribute(p742, "Attack", v_u_737))
		end
	end)
	v_u_4.watch_attribute(game.Workspace, "Gamemode", v_u_737)
end
function setup_color_picker() -- name: setup_color_picker
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_34
	local v_u_743 = v_u_3.get("ColorToPick")
	local v744 = v_u_3.get("ConfirmColor")
	local v745 = v_u_3.get("CancelColor")
	local v_u_746 = v_u_7.new(0)
	local v_u_747 = v_u_7.new(0)
	local v_u_748 = v_u_7.new(0)
	local v_u_749 = Color3.new()
	function v_u_32.pick_color(p750)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_34, (ref) v_u_749, (copy) v_u_746, (copy) v_u_747, (copy) v_u_748, (ref) v_u_32
		v_u_34:fire_instant(false)
		v_u_749 = p750
		local v751 = v_u_746
		local v752 = p750.R * 255
		v751:set((math.round(v752)))
		local v753 = v_u_747
		local v754 = p750.G * 255
		v753:set((math.round(v754)))
		local v755 = v_u_748
		local v756 = p750.B * 255
		v755:set((math.round(v756)))
		v_u_32.current_overlay:set_instant("color_picker")
		local v_u_757 = nil
		v_u_757 = v_u_34:hook(function(p758)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_757, (ref) v_u_746, (ref) v_u_749, (ref) v_u_747, (ref) v_u_748
			v_u_757.unhook()
			if not p758 then
				local v759 = v_u_746
				local v760 = v_u_749.R * 255
				v759:set((math.round(v760)))
				local v761 = v_u_747
				local v762 = v_u_749.G * 255
				v761:set((math.round(v762)))
				local v763 = v_u_748
				local v764 = v_u_749.B * 255
				v763:set((math.round(v764)))
			end
		end)
		v_u_34:wait()
		v_u_757.unhook()
		return Color3.fromRGB(v_u_746:get(), v_u_747:get(), v_u_748:get())
	end
	hover_animation(v744)
	hover_animation(v745)
	v_u_3.on_click(v744, function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_34, (ref) v_u_32
		v_u_34:fire_instant(true)
		v_u_32.current_overlay:set("")
	end)
	v_u_3.on_click(v745, function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_34, (ref) v_u_32
		v_u_34:fire_instant(false)
		v_u_32.current_overlay:set("")
	end)
	v_u_7.dependency({ v_u_746, v_u_747, v_u_748 }, function(p765, p766, p767)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_743
		v_u_743.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(p765, p766, p767)
	end)
	local function v803(p768, p769, p770, p_u_771, p_u_772) -- name: setup_slider_button
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_3, (ref) v_u_7
		local v773 = v_u_3.get("SettingSliderFrameTemplate"):Clone()
		v773.Visible = true
		v773.Name = "SettingSlider"
		v773.TextLabel.Text = p768
		v773.LayoutOrder = 1
		local v774 = v773:FindFirstChild("HelpIcon", true)
		if v774 then
			v774:Destroy()
		end
		v773.Parent = v_u_3.get(p770)
		local v775 = v773.Bar
		local v_u_776 = v775.Fill
		local v_u_777 = v775.Button
		local v_u_778 = v_u_777.TextLabel
		local v_u_779 = v773.Folder.SlideArea
		local v780 = p769
		if not v780 then
			local v781 = v_u_7.new
			local v782 = (p_u_771 + p_u_772) * 0.5
			v780 = v781((math.floor(v782)))
		end
		local v_u_783 = v780
		v_u_783:hook(function(p784)
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_771, (copy) p_u_772, (copy) v_u_776, (copy) v_u_777, (copy) v_u_778
			local v785 = math.map(p784, p_u_771, p_u_772, 0, 1)
			v_u_776.Size = UDim2.fromScale(v785, 1)
			v_u_777.Position = UDim2.fromScale(v785, 0.5)
			v_u_778.Text = ("%*"):format(p784)
		end)
		local function v_u_790(p786) -- name: update_value
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_779, (copy) p_u_771, (copy) p_u_772, (ref) v_u_783
			local v787 = (Vector2.new(p786.Position.X, p786.Position.Y) - v_u_779.AbsolutePosition).X / v_u_779.AbsoluteSize.X
			local v788 = math.clamp(v787, 0, 1)
			local v789 = math.map(v788, 0, 1, p_u_771, p_u_772)
			v_u_783:set((math.round(v789)))
		end
		v_u_3.holding(v_u_779, function(p791, p792)
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_790
			if p791 or p791 == nil then
				v_u_790(p792)
			end
		end)
		local v793 = v773.Folder.Minus
		local v794 = v773.Folder.Plus
		hover_animation(v793)
		hover_animation(v794)
		v_u_3.on_click(v793, function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_783, (copy) p_u_771, (copy) p_u_772
			v_u_783:update(function(p795)
				-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_771, (ref) p_u_772
				local v796 = p795 - 1
				local v797 = p_u_771
				local v798 = p_u_772
				return math.clamp(v796, v797, v798)
			end)
		end)
		v_u_3.on_click(v794, function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_783, (copy) p_u_771, (copy) p_u_772

				local v801 = p_u_771
				local v802 = p_u_772
				return math.clamp(v800, v801, v802)
			end)

	end

					v_u_804.IconButton.ImageLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 0
				end

			elseif p808.loadout_type == "crate_pack" then
				v_u_804.ItemButton.ImageLabel.Image = v_u_16.crates[p808.name].image

				v_u_804.ItemButton.Visible = true
				v813 = v_u_804.ItemButton

			if v813 then

	local function v_u_850() -- name: go_to
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_32, (ref) v_u_11
		local v_u_844 = v_u_32.buy_frame:get()
		local v845 = v_u_844.attachment_for and v_u_11.get_item_class(v_u_844.attachment_for)
		if v845 then
			local v846
			if string.find(v_u_32.current_tab:get(), v845.loadout_type) then
				v846 = v_u_32.current_tab:get()
			elseif v_u_32[v845.loadout_type] then
				v846 = v845.loadout_type
			else
				v846 = ("%*1"):format(v845.loadout_type)
			end
			v_u_32.current_tab:set_instant(v846)
			v_u_32[v846]:set_instant(v_u_844.attachment_for)
		end
		if v_u_844.loadout_type == "hat" then
			local v_u_847 = v_u_11.get_item_class(v_u_844.name)
			v_u_32[v_u_844.loadout_type]:update(function(p848)
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_847, (copy) v_u_844
				local v849 = typeof(p848) ~= "table" and {} or p848
				v849[v_u_847.hat_type] = v_u_844.name
				return v849
			end)
		else
			v_u_32[v_u_844.loadout_type]:set(v_u_844.name)
		end
		v_u_32.current_tab:set(v_u_844.loadout_type)
		v_u_32.current_overlay:set("")
	end
	local function v_u_857(p851, p852, p853) -- name: confirm_purchase
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_32, (ref) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_850, (ref) v_u_16
		local v854 = v_u_32.buy_frame:get()
		if p851 then
			task.spawn(display_notification, "Success", nil)
			if p852 == "gift" then
				v_u_32.current_overlay:set("logs")
				return
			end
			if p852 == "item" then
				if v854.attachment_for and v854.loadout_type ~= "charm" then
					v_u_2.owned[v854.attachment_for] = v_u_2.owned[v854.attachment_for] or {}
					v_u_2.owned[v854.attachment_for][v854.name] = true
				elseif v854.loadout_type == "icon" or v854.loadout_type == "skin_color" then
					v_u_2.owned[v854.name] = true
				else
					v_u_2.owned[v854.name] = v_u_2.owned[v854.name] or {}
					v_u_2.owned[v854.name].owned = true
				end
				v_u_2.force_update("owned")
				if v854.try_out then
					v_u_850()
				end
				v_u_32.current_overlay:set("")
				return
			end
			if p852 == "crate_pack" then
				v_u_32.current_overlay:set("")
				return
			end
			if p852 == "bundle" then
				for _, v855 in v_u_16.bundles[v854.name].contents do
					local v856 = string.split(v855, "/")
					if not v856[1] then
						continue
					end
					v_u_2.owned[v856[1]] = v_u_2.owned[v856[1]] or {}
					if v856[2] then
						v_u_2.owned[v856[1]][v856[2]] = true
					else
						v_u_2.owned[v856[1]].owned = true
					end
				end
				v_u_2.bundles[v854.name] = true
				v_u_2.force_update("owned")
				if v854.try_out then
					v_u_850()
				end
				v_u_32.current_overlay:set("")
				return
			end
		else
			task.spawn(display_notification, p853 or "Something went wrong", nil)
		end
	end

function setup_unowned_items() -- name: setup_unowned_items
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_2
	v_u_3.get("MissingItemTemplate").Visible = false
	local function v_u_891() -- name: refresh
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_3, (ref) v_u_32, (ref) v_u_11, (ref) v_u_16
		for _, v878 in v_u_3.get("MissingItems"):GetChildren() do
			if not (v878:IsA("GuiBase2d") and v878.Visible) then
				continue
			end
			v878:Destroy()
		end
		local v879 = v_u_32.chosen_class:get()
		for _, v_u_880 in {
			"primary",
			"secondary",
			"gadget1",
			"gadget2",
			"utility1",
			"utility2",
			"hat",
			"outfit"
		} do
			local v_u_881 = v879[v_u_880]
			if not v_u_881 then
				continue
			end
			for _, v_u_882 in typeof(v_u_881) ~= "table" and { v_u_881 } or v_u_881 do
				local v883 = v_u_11.get_item_class(v_u_882)
				if not v883 or owns_item(v_u_882) then
					continue
				end
				local v884 = v_u_3.get("MissingItemTemplate"):Clone()
				v884.Name = "Missing"
				v884.MissingItemButton.ImageLabel.Image = v883.image
				if v883.rarity then
					v884.MissingItemButton.Frame.BackgroundColor3 = v_u_16.rarities[v883.rarity].color
					v884.MissingItemButton.Frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0
				else
					v884.MissingItemButton.Frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				end
				v884.Visible = true
				v884.Parent = v_u_3.get("MissingItems")
				hover_animation(v884.MissingItemButton)
				v_u_3.on_click(v884.MissingItemButton, function()
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_880, (copy) v_u_882
					local v885 = {
						["loadout_type"] = nil,
						["name"] = nil,
						["try_out"] = true,
						["loadout_type"] = v_u_880,
						["name"] = v_u_882
					}
					v_u_32.buy_frame:set(v885)
				end)
			end
			if not (v879.attachments and v879.attachments[v_u_881]) then
				break
			end
			for v_u_886, v_u_887 in v879.attachments[v_u_881] do
				if owns_attachment(v_u_881, v_u_887) then
					continue
				end
				local v888 = v_u_11.get_item_class(v_u_887)
				if not v888 then
					continue
				end
				local v889 = v_u_3.get("MissingItemTemplate"):Clone()
				v889.Name = "Missing"
				v889.MissingItemButton.ImageLabel.Image = v888.image
				v889.MissingItemButton.ImageLabel.ImageColor3 = v888.image_color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
				if v888.bg_color then
					v889.MissingItemButton.ImageLabel.BackgroundColor3 = v888.bg_color
					v889.MissingItemButton.ImageLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 0
				end
				if v_u_886 == "skin" then
					Instance.new("UIAspectRatioConstraint").Parent = v889.MissingItemButton.ImageLabel
					v889.MissingItemButton.ImageLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.7, 0.7)
					v889.MissingItemButton.ImageLabel.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
				end
				if v888.rarity then
					v889.MissingItemButton.Frame.BackgroundColor3 = v_u_16.rarities[v888.rarity].color
					v889.MissingItemButton.Frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0
				else
					v889.MissingItemButton.Frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				end
				v889.Visible = true
				v889.Parent = v_u_3.get("MissingItems")
				hover_animation(v889.MissingItemButton)
				v_u_3.on_click(v889.MissingItemButton, function()
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_886, (copy) v_u_887, (copy) v_u_881
					local v890 = {
						["loadout_type"] = nil,
						["name"] = nil,
						["try_out"] = true,
						["attachment_for"] = nil,
						["loadout_type"] = v_u_886,
						["name"] = v_u_887,
						["attachment_for"] = v_u_881
					}
					v_u_32.buy_frame:set(v890)
				end)
			end
		end
	end
	v_u_32.current_tab:hook(function(p892)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_891

			v_u_3.get("MissingItems").Visible = true

	end)

function get_profile_data(p894) -- name: get_profile_data
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_33, (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_2
	local v895 = {}
	if p894 ~= v_u_33 then
		return v_u_1.get("request_profile_data", p894)
	end
	v895.xp = v_u_2.xp
	v895.ranked = v_u_2.ranked
	v895.match_history = {}
	v895.stats = {
		["kills"] = 0,
		["deaths"] = 0,
		["wins"] = 0,
		["losses"] = 0
	}
	for v896 = #v_u_2.match_history, 1, -1 do
		local v897 = v_u_2.match_history[v896]
		if #v895.match_history < 10 then
			local v898 = v895.match_history
			table.insert(v898, 1, v897)
		end
		local v899 = v897.stats
		local v900 = p894.UserId
		local v901 = v899[tostring(v900)]
		if v897.match_type == "Custom" or (v897.gamemode == "Zombies" or not v901) then
			continue
		end
		if v897.winner == v901.team then
			local v902 = v895.stats
			v902.wins = v902.wins + 1
		elseif v897.winner ~= nil then
			local v903 = v895.stats
			v903.losses = v903.losses + 1
		end
		local v904 = v895.stats
		v904.kills = v904.kills + v901.kills
		local v905 = v895.stats
		v905.deaths = v905.deaths + v901.deaths
	end
	return v895
end

		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1020, (copy) v_u_1019, (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_33, (ref) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_906, (ref) v_u_3, (ref) v_u_32
		v_u_1020:clean()

			for v_u_1023, _ in p1021 do
				local v_u_1024 = v_u_1019:Clone()
				v_u_1024.Visible = true
				v_u_1024.Parent = v_u_1019.Parent
				v_u_1020:add(v_u_1024)
				v_u_1024.SeasonTitle.Text = ("Season %*"):format(v_u_1023)
				v_u_1024.LayoutOrder = 100 - v_u_1023
				local v_u_1025 = v_u_1023 == v_u_17.RANKED_SEASON
				local v_u_1026 = 0
				if v_u_33 == p1022 then
					v_u_1020:add(v_u_2.hook("ranked", function(p1027)
						-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1025, (ref) v_u_1026, (copy) v_u_1023, (ref) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_1024
						if v_u_1025 then

function setup_leaderboard() -- name: setup_leaderboard
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_32
	local v_u_1218 = v_u_3.get("LeaderboardEntryTemplate")
	v_u_1218.Visible = false
	local v_u_1232 = v_u_4.ov(function(p1219)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_1218, (ref) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_3
		for v1220, v1221 in v_u_1.get("request_top_leaderboard", p1219) do
			local v1222 = v_u_1218:Clone()
			v1222.Name = "LeaderboardEntry"

			v1222.PlayerName.Text = ("%*. %*"):format(v1220, v1221.name)

			local v1223
			if v1221.mmr then
				local v1224 = v_u_4.get_rank_from_mmr(v1221.mmr)
				v1223 = v_u_16.ranks[v1224]
			else
				if not (v1221.progress and v_u_16.tracks[p1219]) then
					return
				end
				local v1225 = 0
				for v1226, v1227 in v_u_16.tracks[p1219] do

						continue
					end
					v1225 = v1226
				end
				v1223 = v_u_16.tracks[p1219][v1225]
			end
			v1222.RankedCircle.ImageLabel.Image = v1223.image
			v1222.RankedCircle.ImageLabel.ImageColor3 = v1223.color
			v1222.RankedCircle.TopRanked.ImageColor3 = v1223.color
			v1222.RankedCircle.TopRanked.TextLabel.TextColor3 = v1223.color
			v1222.RankedCircle.TopRanked.TextLabel.Text = ("%*"):format(v1220)

			if v_u_3.get("TopLeaderboardFrame").Visible then

							["BackgroundTransparency"] = v1229

						v_u_4.tween(v1228, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
							["TextTransparency"] = v1230

							continue
						end
						local v1231 = v1228.ImageTransparency
						v1228.ImageTransparency = 1
						v_u_4.tween(v1228, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
							["ImageTransparency"] = v1231
						})
					end
				end
			end
			task.wait(0.05)
		end
	end)
	local v1233 = v_u_3.get("TopLeaderboardButton")
	hover_animation(v1233)
	v_u_3.on_click(v1233, function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_1232

end

function setup_region() -- name: setup_region
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_1577, (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_34
	v_u_32.current_region:hook(function(p1578, _)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1577, (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_3
		local v1579 = v_u_1577[p1578]
		if v1579 and v_u_17.FLAG_REGION_SELECTION then
			v_u_3.get("RegionButton").ImageLabel.Image = v1579.image
			v_u_3.get("RegionButton").ImageLabel.Visible = true
		else
			v_u_3.get("RegionButton").ImageLabel.Visible = false
		end
		if v1579 and v_u_17.FLAG_MATCHMAKING_SETTINGS then
			v_u_3.get("RegionSelectedButton").ImageLabel.Image = v1579.image
			v_u_3.get("RegionSelectedButton").ImageLabel.Visible = true
			v_u_3.get("RegionSelectedButton").TextLabel.Text = v1579.name
		else
			v_u_3.get("RegionSelectedButton").ImageLabel.Visible = false
			v_u_3.get("RegionSelectedButton").TextLabel.Text = "None"
		end
	end)
	v_u_2.hook("region", function(p1580)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_32
		if p1580 then
			v_u_32.current_region:set(p1580)
		end
	end)
	local v1581 = v_u_3.get("RegionButton")
	if v_u_17.FLAG_REGION_SELECTION then
		v1581.Visible = true
		hover_animation(v1581)
		v_u_3.on_click(v1581, function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_32
			v_u_32.current_overlay:set("region")
		end)
	else
		v1581.Visible = false
	end
	local v_u_1582 = nil
	function v_u_32.pick_region(p1583)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_34, (ref) v_u_1582, (ref) v_u_3, (ref) v_u_32
		v_u_34:fire_instant(false)
		v_u_1582 = nil
		local v1584 = p1583 or {}
		for _, v1585 in v_u_3.get("ChooseRegionFrame"):GetChildren() do
			if v1585.Name ~= "Region" then
				continue
			end
			if table.find(v1584, v1585:GetAttribute("RegionName")) then
				v1585.LockedFrame.Visible = false
			else
				v1585.LockedFrame.Visible = true
			end
		end
		v_u_32.current_overlay:set_instant("region")
		v_u_34:wait()
		return v_u_1582
	end
	v_u_3.get("RegionTemplate").Visible = false
	local v_u_1586 = v_u_1582
	for v_u_1587, v1588 in v_u_1577 do
		local v_u_1589 = v_u_3.get("RegionTemplate"):Clone()
		v_u_1589.Name = "Region"
		v_u_1589.Visible = true
		v_u_1589:SetAttribute("RegionName", v_u_1587)

function setup_matchmaking() -- name: setup_matchmaking
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_1577, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_12

	if v_u_17.FLAG_MATCHMAKING_SETTINGS then

				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_32

		end
		v_u_3.get("RegionSelectedButton").Parent.Visible = false
		local v_u_1592 = v_u_3.get("RegionSelectedButtonTemplate")
		v_u_1592.Visible = false
		local v1593 = {}
		for v_u_1594, v1595 in v_u_1577 do
			if v1595.hidden then
				continue
			end
			local v_u_1596 = v_u_1592:Clone()
			v_u_1596.Name = "RegionSelectedButton"
			v_u_1596.ImageLabel.Image = v1595.image
			v_u_1596.TextLabel.Text = v1595.name
			v_u_1596.Visible = true
			v_u_1596:SetAttribute("Order", v1595.order)
			table.insert(v1593, v_u_1596)
			hover_animation(v_u_1596)
			local v_u_1598 = v_u_4.ov(function(p1597)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_1596, (ref) v_u_32
				if p1597 then
					v_u_4.tween(v_u_1596.Deselected, TweenInfo.new(v_u_32.current_overlay:get() == "" and 0 or 0.3), {
						["ImageTransparency"] = 1
					})
					v_u_4.tween(v_u_1596.LockedFrame, TweenInfo.new(v_u_32.current_overlay:get() == "" and 0 or 0.3), {
						["BackgroundTransparency"] = 1
					}).Completed:Wait()
					v_u_1596.LockedFrame.Visible = false
					v_u_1596.Deselected.Visible = false
				else
					v_u_1596.LockedFrame.Visible = true
					v_u_1596.Deselected.Visible = true

function setup_logs() -- name: setup_logs
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_30, (copy) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_33, (copy) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_16
	v_u_3.get("LogEntryTemplate").Visible = false
	local function v_u_1645(p1643) -- name: extract_code
		local v1644 = string.match(p1643, "%w%w%w%w%-%w%w%w%w%-%w%w%w%w")
		if v1644 then
			return p1643:gsub("%w%w%w%w%-%w%w%w%w%-%w%w%w%w", ""):gsub("%s%s+", " "):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""), v1644
		else
			return p1643, nil
		end
	end
	local function v_u_1651(p1646) -- name: create_log
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_3, (ref) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_1645, (ref) v_u_30, (ref) v_u_32
		local v1647 = v_u_3.get("LogEntryTemplate"):Clone()
		v1647.Visible = true
		v1647.Name = "LogEntry"
		v1647.Date.Text = v_u_4.time_ago(p1646.stamp)
		local v1648, v_u_1649 = v_u_1645(p1646.text)
		local v1650 = 0.45 * v_u_30:GetTextSize(v1648, 16, Enum.Font.Sarpanch, Vector2.new(192, 96)).Y / 16
		v1647.LogText.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, v1650)
		v1647.LogText.Text = v1648
		if v_u_1649 then
			script.GiftCode:Clone().Parent = v1647
			v1647.GiftCode.Text = v_u_1649
			v1647.GiftCode.Visible = true
			if not string.find(v1648, "Redeemed") then
				script.RedeemButton:Clone().Parent = v1647.GiftCode
				v1647.GiftCode.RedeemButton.Visible = true
				hover_animation(v1647.GiftCode.RedeemButton)
				v_u_3.on_click(v1647.GiftCode.RedeemButton, function()
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_1649
					v_u_32.current_overlay:set("", true)
					v_u_32.redeem_code_function(v_u_1649)
				end)
			end
		end
		return v1647
	end
	local v_u_1652 = v_u_9.new()
	v_u_32.current_overlay:hook(function(p1653, _)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1652, (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_33, (copy) v_u_1651, (ref) v_u_3
		v_u_1652:clean()
		if p1653 == "logs" then
			local v1654, _, v1655 = v_u_1.get("request_logs", v_u_33)
			if v1654 then
				for v1656, v1657 in v1655 do
					local v1658 = v_u_1651(v1657)
					v1658.LayoutOrder = 1000 - v1656
					v1658.Parent = v_u_3.get("LogsFrame")
					v_u_1652:add(v1658)
				end
				return
			end
		elseif p1653 == "medal" then
			local v1659, _, v1660 = v_u_1.get("request_logs", v_u_33)
			if v1659 then
				for v1661, v1662 in v1660 do
					if not string.find(v1662.text, "from Medal Event") then
						continue
					end
					local v1663 = v_u_1651(v1662)
					v1663.LayoutOrder = 1000 - v1661
					v1663.Parent = v_u_3.get("MedalLogs")
					v_u_1652:add(v1663)
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	local v_u_1664 = v_u_3.get("CodeTextBox")
	v_u_4.watch_property(v_u_1664, "Text", function(p1665)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1664
		local v1666 = p1665:gsub("-", "")
		if #v1666 > 12 then
			v1666 = v1666:sub(1, 12)
		end
		local v1667 = v1666:gsub("(%w%w%w%w)", "%1-"):gsub("%-$", "")
		if v1667 ~= p1665 then
			v_u_1664.Text = v1667
			v_u_1664.CursorPosition = #v1667 + 1
		end
	end)
	function v_u_32.redeem_code_function(p1668)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_14, (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_32, (ref) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_16
		v_u_14.start_small()
		local v1669, v1670, v1671 = v_u_1.get("redeem_code", p1668)
		v_u_14.stop_small()
		v_u_32.notify(v1670)
		if v1669 and v1671 then
			if v1671.type == "item" then
				v_u_2.owned[v1671.name] = v_u_2.owned[v1671.name] or {}
				v_u_2.owned[v1671.name].owned = true
				v_u_2.force_update("owned")
			elseif v1671.type == "attachment" then
				v_u_2.owned[v1671.name] = v_u_2.owned[v1671.name] or {}
				v_u_2.owned[v1671.name][v1671.att_name] = true
				v_u_2.force_update("owned")
			elseif v1671.type == "crates" then
				v_u_2.crates[v1671.name] = v_u_2.crates[v1671.name] or 0
				local v1672 = v_u_2.crates
				local v1673 = v1671.name
				v1672[v1673] = v1672[v1673] + v1671.amount
				v_u_2.force_update("crates")
			elseif v1671.type == "bundle" then
				for _, v1674 in v_u_16.bundles[v1671.name].contents do
					local v1675 = string.split(v1674, "/")
					if not v1675[1] then
						continue
					end
					v_u_2.owned[v1675[1]] = v_u_2.owned[v1675[1]] or {}
					if v1675[2] then
						v_u_2.owned[v1675[1]][v1675[2]] = true
					else
						v_u_2.owned[v1675[1]].owned = true
					end
				end
				v_u_2.bundles[v1671.name] = true
				v_u_2.force_update("owned")
			end
			v_u_32.current_overlay:set("logs")
		end
	end
	local v1676 = v_u_3.get("RedeemCodeButton")
	hover_animation(v1676)
	v_u_3.on_click(v1676, function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_1664
		v_u_32.redeem_code_function(v_u_1664.Text)
	end)
end
