function setup_queue() -- name: setup_queue
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_33, (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_22
	v_u_3.get("QueueFrame").Visible = false
	v_u_1.hook("teleporting", function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_14
		v_u_14.lock:set(true)
		v_u_14.start_medium()
	end)
	v_u_1.hook("teleport_failed", function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_14
		v_u_14.lock:set(false)
		v_u_14.stop_small()
		task.spawn(display_notification, "Teleport failed", nil)
	end)
	game:GetService("TeleportService").TeleportInitFailed:Connect(function(p1712)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_33, (ref) v_u_14
		if p1712 == v_u_33 then
			v_u_14.lock:set(false)
			v_u_14.stop_small()
			task.spawn(display_notification, "Teleport failed", nil)
		end
	end)
	v_u_3.get("QueueFrame").Visible = false
	local v_u_1713 = {
		["quick"] = "Quick Match",
		["ranked"] = "Ranked",
		["zombies"] = "Zombies"
	}
	local v_u_1714 = nil
	local v_u_1715 = 0
	local v_u_1722 = v_u_6.new(1, function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1715, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_1713, (ref) v_u_1714, (ref) v_u_33
		v_u_1715 = v_u_1715 + 1
		local v1716 = v_u_1715 % 60
		if v1716 <= 9 then
			v1716 = string.rep("0", 1) .. tostring(v1716)
		end
		local v1717 = v_u_3.get("QueueFrame").QueueTop.QueueType
		local v1718 = v_u_1713[v_u_1714]
		local v1719 = v_u_1715 / 60
		v1717.Text = ("%* - %*:%*"):format(v1718, math.floor(v1719), v1716)
		local v1720 = v_u_3.get("LongQueueNotice")
		local v1721
		if v_u_1715 >= 120 and (v_u_33:GetAttribute("Party") == nil or v_u_33:GetAttribute("Party") == v_u_33.UserId) then
			v1721 = v_u_33:GetAttribute("Region") ~= "Auto"
		else
			v1721 = false
		end
		v1720.Visible = v1721
	end, nil, "global")
	local v_u_1724 = v_u_4.ov(function(p1723)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1715, (ref) v_u_1714, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_1713, (ref) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_1722, (ref) v_u_22
		if p1723 then
			v_u_1715 = 0
			v_u_1714 = p1723
			v_u_3.get("QueueFrame").QueueTop.QueueType.Text = ("%* - 0:00"):format(v_u_1713[v_u_1714])
			v_u_3.get("QueueFrame").Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, -0.15)
			v_u_3.get("QueueFrame").Visible = true
			v_u_4.tween(v_u_3.get("QueueFrame"), TweenInfo.new(0.1), {
				["Position"] = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0)
			})
			v_u_3.get("QueueSizeFrame").Visible = false
			v_u_1722:resume()
			v_u_22.Queue()
		else
			v_u_4.tween(v_u_3.get("QueueFrame"), TweenInfo.new(0.1), {
				["Position"] = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, -0.15)
			}).Completed:Wait()
			v_u_3.get("QueueFrame").Visible = false
			v_u_1722:stop()
		end
	end)
	v_u_1.on_connect(function(p_u_1725)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_33, (copy) v_u_1724
		v_u_4.watch_attribute(p_u_1725, "InQueue", function(p1726)
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_1725, (ref) v_u_33, (ref) v_u_1724

			end
		end)
	end)
	hover_animation(v_u_3.get("CancelQueueButton"))
	v_u_3.on_click("CancelQueueButton", function()

	end)

		v_u_3.get("QueueSizeFrame").Visible = true
	end)
end

function v_u_32.add_crate_options(p_u_1853) -- name: add_crate_options
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_28, (copy) v_u_33, (copy) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_1
	for _, v1854 in v_u_3.get("BuyCrateFrame"):GetChildren() do
		if not (v1854:IsA("GuiBase2d") and v1854.Visible) then
			continue
		end
		v1854:Destroy()
	end
	local v_u_1855 = v_u_16.crates[p_u_1853]
	for v_u_1856, v_u_1857 in v_u_1855.packs do
		local v_u_1858 = v_u_3.get("CratePackTemplate"):Clone()
		v_u_1858.Visible = true
		v_u_1858.Name = "CratePack"
		v_u_1858.Crate.Symbol.Image = v_u_1855.image
		local v1859 = v_u_1858.Crate.Amount
		local v1860 = v_u_1857.amount
		v1859.Text = tostring(v1860)
		v_u_1858.Parent = v_u_3.get("BuyCrateFrame")
		if v_u_1857.price then
			v_u_1858.Currency.Visible = true
			local v1861 = v_u_1858.Currency.Amount
			local v1862 = v_u_1857.price
			v1861.Text = tostring(v1862)
		elseif v_u_1857.product_id then
			v_u_1858.Robux.Visible = true
			v_u_1858.Robux.Amount.Text = "?"
			task.spawn(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_28, (copy) v_u_1857, (copy) v_u_1858
				local v1863 = v_u_28:GetProductInfoAsync(v_u_1857.product_id, Enum.InfoType.Product)
				if v1863 and v1863.PriceInRobux then
					local v1864 = v_u_1858.Robux.Amount
					local v1865 = v1863.PriceInRobux
					v1864.Text = tostring(v1865)
				end
			end)
		end
		hover_animation(v_u_1858)
		v_u_3.on_click(v_u_1858, function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1857, (ref) v_u_33, (ref) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_1855, (copy) p_u_1853, (copy) v_u_1856, (ref) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_14, (ref) v_u_1
			if v_u_1857.product_id then
				if v_u_33:GetAttribute("CountryRestricted") then
					v_u_32.notify("Country Restrictions! Cannot buy crates with Robux")
				else
					v_u_32.product_options({
						["display_name"] = nil,
						["loadout_type"] = "crate_pack",
						["name"] = nil,
						["index"] = nil,
						["display_name"] = ("%* %*%*"):format(v_u_1857.amount, v_u_1855.name, v_u_1857.amount > 1 and "s" or ""),
						["name"] = p_u_1853,
						["index"] = v_u_1856
					})
				end
			elseif v_u_1857.price and (v_u_2.currency < v_u_1857.price and not v_u_33:GetAttribute("CountryRestricted")) then
				v_u_32.current_overlay:set("buy_currency")
			elseif v_u_32.confirm("Confirm Purchase?") then
				v_u_14.start_small()
				local v1866, v1867 = v_u_1.get("buy_crates", p_u_1853, v_u_1856)
				if v1866 then
					task.spawn(display_notification, "Success", nil)
					v_u_32.current_overlay:set("")
					v_u_2.crates[p_u_1853] = v_u_2.crates[p_u_1853] or 0
					local v1868 = v_u_2.crates
					local v1869 = p_u_1853
					v1868[v1869] = v1868[v1869] + v_u_1857.amount
					v_u_2.force_update("crates")
				else
					task.spawn(display_notification, v1867 or "Something went wrong", nil)
				end
				v_u_14.stop_small()
			end
		end)
	end
end

				v2008.OwnedOverlay.Visible = owns_item(v_u_2006[1], true)
			end

				v2008.CurrencyRefund.Amount.Text = ("%*"):format(v_u_16.rarities[v2007.rarity].duplicate_value)

			end
			if v2007.bg_color then

				v2008.ImageLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 0
			end
			if v2007.loadout_type == "skin" then

				v2008.ParentItemIcon.Visible = true
			end
			if v2007.rarity then

				v2008.Frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0

				local v2010 = v_u_2.pity_chances and v_u_2.pity_chances[v1993] and (v_u_2.pity_chances[v1993][v2007.rarity] or 0) or 0
				local v2011 = 0
				if v_u_1990.unowned[v2007.rarity] == 0 then
					v2011 = v2009
				elseif not v2008.OwnedOverlay.Visible then
					v2011 = v_u_16.crates[v_u_32.current_crate:get()].rarities[v2007.rarity] / v_u_1990.unowned[v2007.rarity]
				end
				local v2012 = (v2010 * v2011 + (1 - v2010) * v2009) * 10000
				local v2013 = math.round(v2012) / 100
				v2008.RarityPercentage.Text = ("%*%%"):format(v2013)
				v2008.RarityPercentage.Visible = true
			else
				v2008.Frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			end
			if v2007.rarity then
				v2008.LayoutOrder = v_u_16.rarities[v2007.rarity].order
			end
			v2008.Parent = v_u_3.get("CollectionFrame")
			hover_animation(v2008)
			v_u_3.on_click(v2008, function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1905, (ref) v_u_1919, (copy) v_u_2006
				v_u_1905()
				v_u_1919(v_u_2006)
			end)
		end
		v_u_32.current_overlay:set("collection")
	end)

function v_u_32.confirm(p2114, p2115, p2116, p2117, p2118)
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_34, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_30, (copy) v_u_32
	v_u_34:fire_instant(false)
	local v2119 = v_u_3.get("ConfirmationFrame")
	v2119.Title.Text = p2114
	if p2115 then
		local v2120 = p2115
		while string.find(p2115, "<") do
			local v2121 = string.find(p2115, "<")
			local v2122 = string.find(p2115, ">")
			local v2123 = v2121 - 1
			local v2124 = string.sub(p2115, 1, v2123)
			local v2125 = v2122 + 1
			p2115 = v2124 .. string.sub(p2115, v2125)
		end
		local v2126 = 0.175 * v_u_30:GetTextSize(p2115, 16, Enum.Font.Sarpanch, Vector2.new(192, 288)).Y / 16
		v2119.Subtitle.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, v2126)
		p2115 = v2120
	end
	if p2118 then
		local v2127 = p2118
		while string.find(p2118, "<") do
			local v2128 = string.find(p2118, "<")
			local v2129 = string.find(p2118, ">")
			local v2130 = v2128 - 1
			local v2131 = string.sub(p2118, 1, v2130)
			local v2132 = v2129 + 1
			p2118 = v2131 .. string.sub(p2118, v2132)
		end
		local v2133 = 0.125 * v_u_30:GetTextSize(p2118, 16, Enum.Font.Sarpanch, Vector2.new(192, 32)).Y / 16
		v2119.Subsubtitle.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, v2133)
		p2118 = v2127
	end
	v2119.Subtitle.Visible = p2115 ~= nil
	v2119.Subtitle.Text = p2115 or ""
	v2119.Subsubtitle.Visible = p2118 ~= nil
	v2119.Subsubtitle.Text = p2118 and ("<i>%*</i>"):format(p2118) or ""
	v2119.ConfirmYes.TextLabel.Text = p2116 or "Confirm"
	v2119.ConfirmNo.TextLabel.Text = p2117 or "Cancel"
	v_u_32.current_overlay:set_instant("confirmation")

function v_u_14.get_observation_devices(p17, p18) -- name: get_observation_devices
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_6
	local v19 = {}
	for _, v20 in v_u_16 do
		if not v_u_3.classes[v20] then
			continue
		end
		for _, v21 in v_u_3.classes[v20].objects do
			local v22 = v21.owner:get()
			if not v21.values.camera or not p18 and (p17 ~= nil and p17.instance:GetAttribute("Disabled") or (v21.instance:GetAttribute("Disabled") or v_u_6.ownership(v22) < 2)) then
				continue
			end
			table.insert(v19, v21)
		end
	end
	return v19
end

end
function v_u_14.enter_observation_tool(p26, p27) -- name: enter_observation_tool
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_15, (copy) v_u_14
	local v28 = p26 or v_u_3.get("Player", v_u_15)
	if p27 == nil or (p27.owner == nil or p27.instance:GetAttribute("Disabled")) then
		local v29 = v_u_14.get_observation_devices(v28)
		p27 = v29[#v29]
	end
	if p27 then
		v28.states.viewing:set(p27.instance)

	end
end
function v_u_14.switch_observation_tool(p30, p31) -- name: switch_observation_tool
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_15
	local v32 = v_u_3.get("Player", v_u_15)
	local v33 = v_u_15.Character
	if v33 then
		if v_u_15.Character.Parent == game.Workspace then
			v33 = v_u_3.get("Character", v_u_15.Character)
		else
			v33 = false
		end
	end
	if v32.states.viewing:get() == p30.instance then
		v32.states.viewing:set(p31.instance)
	elseif v33.states.viewing:get() == p30.instance then
		v33.states.viewing:set(p31.instance)
	end
end

		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1, (copy) p_u_46, (ref) v_u_14, (ref) v_u_3

				if not v58:FindFirstChild("Object") then
					continue
				end
				local v59 = v58.Object
				table.insert(v56, v59)
				if v58.Object.Value ~= p_u_46.instance then
					continue
				end
				v57 = #v56
			end

function setup_scanning(p_u_68) -- name: setup_scanning
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_7
	local v69 = p_u_68.values.inputs
	local v_u_70 = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Modules.FirstPersonInterface).setup_action(v69, function()
		return true
	end, "Scan", "scan", true, 1)
	local v_u_71 = v_u_70.completion
	v_u_71:done(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_3, (ref) v_u_6, (copy) p_u_68, (ref) v_u_7
		local v72 = game.Workspace.CurrentCamera
		local v73 = {}
		for _, v74 in v_u_3.get_all("Character") do
			if v74.clean:get() or (v_u_6.ownership(v74.owner:get()) > 0 or v74.values.veiled) then
				continue
			end
			local v75 = v74.instance.HumanoidRootPart.Position
			if not v_u_6.is_looking_towards(v72.CFrame, v75, 90) then
				continue
			end
			local v76 = CFrame.lookAt(v72.CFrame.Position, v75).LookVector
			local v77 = (v72.CFrame.Position - v74.instance.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
			local v_u_78 = false
			v_u_6.parts_on_ray(v72.CFrame.Position, v76 * v77, { p_u_68.instance, v74.instance }, function(p79)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_78
				local v80 = p79.Instance
				if not v80.CanCollide or (v80:GetAttribute("Weak") or (v80.CollisionGroup == "prop" or (v80.LocalTransparencyModifier == 1 or v80.Transparency == 1))) then
					return true
				end
				v_u_78 = true
				return false
			end)
			if v_u_78 then
				continue
			end
			local v81 = v74.instance
			table.insert(v73, v81)
		end
		if #v73 > 0 then
			p_u_68.states.scan:fire(v73)
		else
			v_u_7.notify("No enemies detected")
		end
	end)
	local v_u_83 = v_u_6.ov(function(p82)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_70, (copy) v_u_71
		if p82 then
			if v_u_70.action.Visible then
				v_u_71(1)
			end
		else
			v_u_71:cancel()
			return
		end
	end)
	v69:get("scan"):press(function(p84)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_83
		v_u_83(p84)
	end)
	v69.enabled:hook(function(p85)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_71
		if not p85 then
			v_u_71:cancel()
		end
	end)
end
function render_busola(p86) -- name: render_busola
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local _, v87, _ = p86.values.camera:get().CFrame:ToOrientation()
	v_u_1.get("Minimap").Rotation = math.deg(v87) - 90
end
function create_radial_value(p_u_88) -- name: create_radial_value
	local v89 = Instance.new("NumberValue")
	v89.Changed:Connect(function(p90)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_88
		p_u_88.Rotation = 90 - 180 * p90
		local v91 = {}
		local v92 = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new
		table.insert(v91, v92(0, 0))
		local v93 = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new
		local v94 = p90 - 0.001
		local v95 = math.max(0, v94)
		table.insert(v91, v93(v95, 0))
		local v96 = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new
		local v97 = p90 + 0.001
		local v98 = math.min(0.999, v97)
		table.insert(v91, v96(v98, 1))
		local v99 = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new
		table.insert(v91, v99(1, 1))
		p_u_88.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(v91)
	end)
	return v89
end

	v_u_102.UIStroke.UIGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 200))

	local v103 = v_u_3.get("Electronic", p100.instance)
	v_u_10.dependency({ v103.states.concealed, p100.clean, p100.values.inputs.enabled }, function(p104, p105, p106)

		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_102, (copy) v_u_101
		v_u_102.Parent = p108 and v_u_101 or nil
	end)
end

function v_u_14.load_inputs(p_u_112) -- name: load_inputs
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_15, (copy) v_u_14
	local v_u_113 = v_u_2.create_input_dictionary(p_u_112.instance)
	p_u_112.values.inputs = v_u_113
	setup_pinging(p_u_112)
	setup_phone(p_u_112)
	setup_cameras(p_u_112)
	setup_effect(p_u_112)
	setup_busola(p_u_112)
	setup_scanning(p_u_112)
	setup_effects(p_u_112)
	p_u_112:destroying(v_u_1.red_dot(p_u_112.values.inputs.enabled, function(p114)
		return p114
	end).unhook)
	local function v_u_115(_) -- name: render_function
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_112
		if p_u_112.values.inputs.enabled:get() and p_u_112.values.camera:get() ~= nil then
			render_busola(p_u_112)
		end
	end
	local v_u_119 = v_u_6.db(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_3, (ref) v_u_15, (copy) v_u_113, (copy) p_u_112, (ref) v_u_14, (ref) v_u_1
		local v116 = v_u_3.get("Player", v_u_15)
		local v117
		if v_u_15.Character and v_u_15.Character.Parent == game.Workspace then
			v117 = v_u_3.get("Character", v_u_15.Character)
		else
			v117 = nil
		end
		v_u_113:disable()
		local v118 = nil
		if v116.states.viewing:get() == p_u_112.instance then
			v117 = v116
		elseif v117 then
			if v117.states.viewing:get() ~= p_u_112.instance then
				v117 = v118
			end
		else
			v117 = v118
		end
		if v117 then
			v_u_14.static:set(true)
			v_u_1.get("CameraEffect").Enabled = true
			task.wait(0.5)
			v_u_1.get("CameraEffect").Enabled = false
			v_u_14.static:set(false)
			v117.values.last_observation_tool = p_u_112
			v117.states.viewing:set(nil)
		end
	end)
	v_u_6.watch_attribute(p_u_112.instance, "Disabled", function(p120)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_112, (copy) v_u_119
		if p120 and p_u_112.values.camera:get() then
			v_u_119()
		end
	end)
	p_u_112.owner:hook(function(p121)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_6, (copy) p_u_112, (copy) v_u_119
		if v_u_6.ownership(p121) < 2 and p_u_112.values.camera:get() then
			v_u_119()
		end
	end)
	local v_u_122 = nil
	v_u_113.enabled:hook(function(p123)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_122, (ref) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_115
		if v_u_122 then
			v_u_122:Disconnect()
			v_u_122 = nil
		end
		if p123 then
			v_u_122 = v_u_6.run(v_u_115)
		end
	end)
end
function get_bulina_from_instance(p124) -- name: get_bulina_from_instance
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	for _, v125 in v_u_1.get("Cameras"):GetChildren() do
		if not v125:FindFirstChild("Object") or v125.Object.Value ~= p124 then
			continue
		end
		return v125
	end
end
function update_cameras_list(p126) -- name: update_cameras_list
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_4
	if p126 then
		local v127 = nil
		for _, v128 in v_u_16 do
			if not p126:HasTag(v128) then
				continue
			end
			v127 = v128
		end
		if v127 then
			local v129 = v_u_3.get(v127, p126)
			local v130 = 0
			local v131 = 0
			for _, v132 in v_u_1.get("Cameras"):GetChildren() do
				if v132:IsA("GuiBase2d") then
					v130 = v130 + 1
				end
				if not v132:FindFirstChild("Object") then
					continue
				end
				if v132.Object.Value == v129.instance then
					v132.BackgroundTransparency = 0
					v_u_1.get("Observations").Current.ImageLabel.Image = v_u_4.get_item_class(v129.tag).icon
					local v133 = v129.owner:get()
					if v133 then
						v_u_1.get("ObservationOwner").Visible = true
						v_u_1.get("ObservationOwner").Text = ("Owned by %*"):format(v133.Name)
					else
						v_u_1.get("ObservationOwner").Visible = false
					end
					v131 = v130
				else
					v132.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				end
			end
			if v131 <= 5 or v130 <= 9 then
				v_u_1.get("Cameras").Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0)
			elseif v131 + 4 < v130 then
				v_u_1.get("Cameras").Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5 - (v131 - 5) * 0.11, 0)
			else
				v_u_1.get("Cameras").Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5 - (v130 - 9) * 0.11, 0)
			end
		end
	end
	v_u_1.get("Observations").Visible = p126 ~= nil
end
function v_u_14.load_first_person(p_u_134) -- name: load_first_person
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_15, (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_7
	local v_u_135 = v_u_13.new()
	for _, v_u_136 in v_u_16 do
		v_u_135:add(v_u_3.hook(v_u_136, function(p_u_137)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_135, (ref) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_136, (copy) p_u_134, (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_4
			local v_u_138 = v_u_13.new()
			v_u_135:add(p_u_137.owner:hook(function(p139)
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_138, (ref) v_u_6, (copy) p_u_137, (ref) v_u_136, (ref) p_u_134, (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_4
				v_u_138:clean()
				if v_u_6.ownership(p139) >= 2 then
					if p_u_137.values.camera then
						local v_u_140 = get_bulina_from_instance(p_u_137.instance)
						if v_u_140 == nil then
							v_u_140 = script.Bulina:Clone()
							v_u_140.Name = v_u_136
							local v141 = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
							v141.Name = "Object"
							v141.Value = p_u_137.instance
							v141.Parent = v_u_140
							if p_u_134 then
								p_u_134.values.last_observation_tool = p_u_137
							end
							v_u_138:add(v_u_140)
						end
						v_u_138:add(v_u_6.watch_attribute(p_u_137.instance, "Disabled", function(p142)
							-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_140, (ref) v_u_1
							if p142 then
								v_u_140.Parent = nil
							else
								v_u_140.Parent = v_u_1.get("Cameras")
							end
						end))
					end
					local v_u_143 = script.Owner:Clone()
					v_u_143.Parent = p_u_137.instance
					if p_u_137.instance:HasTag("Thrown") then
						v_u_143.Adornee = v_u_6.wait_for_property(p_u_137.instance:WaitForChild("ClientModel"), "Value").PrimaryPart
					else
						v_u_143.Adornee = p_u_137.instance.PrimaryPart
					end
					v_u_143.Icon.Image = v_u_4.get_item_class(v_u_136).icon
					v_u_143.Username.Text = p_u_137.owner:get().Name
					v_u_138:add(v_u_143)
					v_u_138:add(v_u_6.watch_property(v_u_1.get("KillCam"), "Enabled", function(p144)
						-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_143
						v_u_143.Enabled = not p144

		local v179 = v176.Z
		v178 = math.abs(v179) <= p173.Z * 0.5 + v175
	else
		v178 = false
	end
	return v178
end
function v_u_1.is_point_inside_part(p180, p181, p182) -- name: is_point_inside_part

function v_u_1.get_zone_is_in(p188) -- name: get_zone_is_in
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_186, (ref) v_u_187, (copy) v_u_1
	if v_u_186 == nil or not v_u_186:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
		v_u_186 = workspace:FindFirstChild("SoundZones", true)

			return
		end
		v_u_187 = OverlapParams.new()
		v_u_187.MaxParts = 12
		v_u_187.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
		v_u_187.FilterDescendantsInstances = { v_u_186 }
	end
	local v189 = (1 / 0)
	local v190 = (1 / 0)

	for _, v192 in workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(p188, 0.1, v_u_187) do
		local v193 = v_u_1.get_point_to_part_distance(p188, v192)
		if v193 >= 0.1 then
			continue

		local v195 = v194.X * v194.Y * v194.Z
		if v193 >= v189 - 0.01 and (v193 >= v189 + 0.01 or v195 >= v190) then
			continue
		end

		v190 = v195
		v189 = v193
	end

function normalize_angle(p196) -- name: normalize_angle

end

function v_u_1.clampAngle(p201, p202, p203) -- name: clampAngle

		return p202
	elseif p203 < p201 then
		return p203

function v_u_1.clampCFrameRotation(p204, p205, p206) -- name: clampCFrameRotation
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v207, v208, v209 = p205:ToOrientation()
	local v210, v211, v212 = p204:ToOrientation()
	local v213 = v_u_1.clampAngle(v210, v207 - p206, v207 + p206)
	local v214 = v_u_1.clampAngle(v211, v208 - p206, v208 + p206)

function v_u_1.clip_angle(p216, p217, p218, p219) -- name: clip_angle
	local v220 = normalize_angle(p216)
	local v221 = normalize_angle(p217)
	local v222 = normalize_angle(v221 + p218)
	local v223 = normalize_angle(v221 + p219)
	if v222 <= v223 then
		if v220 < v222 then
			return v222
		elseif v223 < v220 then
			return v223
		else
			return v220
		end
	elseif v222 <= v220 or v220 <= v223 then
		return v220
	else
		local v224 = v220 - v222
		local v225 = math.abs(v224)
		local v226 = v220 - v223
		if v225 < math.abs(v226) then
			return v222
		else
			return v223
		end
	end
end
function v_u_1.angle_distance_and_direction(p227, p228) -- name: angle_distance_and_direction
	local v229 = p228 - p227
	local v230 = math.abs(v229) % 6.283185307179586
	local v231 = p228 < p227 and -1 or 1
	if v230 > 3.141592653589793 then
		v230 = 6.283185307179586 - v230
		v231 = -v231
	end
	return v230, v231
end

function v_u_1.weighted_random(p247, p248) -- name: weighted_random
	local v249 = 0
	for _, v250 in p247 do
		v249 = v249 + v250
	end
	local v251
	if p248 then
		v251 = p248:NextNumber() * v249
	else
		math.random()
		math.random()
		math.random()
		math.random()
		math.random()
		v251 = math.random() * v249
	end
	local v252 = 0
	for v253, v254 in p247 do
		v252 = v252 + v254
		if v251 > v252 then
			continue
		end
		return v253
	end
end

function v_u_1.ease_in_out_expo(p298) -- name: ease_in_out_expo
	if p298 == 0 or p298 == 1 then
		return p298
	elseif p298 < 0.5 then
		local v299 = p298 * 20 - 10
		return math.pow(2, v299) / 2
	else
		local v300 = p298 * -20 + 10
		return (2 - math.pow(2, v300)) / 2
	end

function v_u_1.seconds_to_legible_time(p360) -- name: seconds_to_legible_time
	if p360 < 60 then
		if p360 == 1 then
			return ("%* second"):format(p360)
		else
			return ("%* seconds"):format(p360)
		end
	elseif p360 < 3600 then
		local v361 = p360 / 60
		local v362 = math.floor(v361)
		if v362 == 1 then
			return ("%* minute"):format(v362)
		else
			return ("%* minutes"):format(v362)
		end
	elseif p360 < 86400 then
		local v363 = p360 / 3600
		local v364 = math.floor(v363)
		if v364 == 1 then
			return ("%* hour"):format(v364)
		else
			return ("%* hours"):format(v364)
		end
	else
		local v365 = p360 / 86400
		local v366 = math.floor(v365)
		if v366 == 1 then
			return ("%* day"):format(v366)
		else
			return ("%* days"):format(v366)
		end
	end
end
function v_u_1.seconds_to_time_full(p367) -- name: seconds_to_time_full
	local v368 = p367 / 3600
	local v369 = math.floor(v368)
	local v370 = p367 - v369 * 3600
	local v371 = v370 / 60
	local v372 = math.floor(v371)
	local v373 = v370 - v372 * 60
	if v369 < 10 then
		v369 = "0" .. v369 or v369
	end
	local v374 = ":"
	if v372 < 10 then
		v372 = "0" .. v372 or v372
	end
	local v375 = ":"
	if v373 < 10 then
		v373 = "0" .. v373 or v373
	end
	return v369 .. v374 .. v372 .. v375 .. v373
end
function v_u_1.time_ago(p376) -- name: time_ago
	local v377 = os.time() - p376
	if v377 < 0 then
		return "just now"
	end
	if v377 < 1 then
		return "just now"
	end
	if v377 < 60 then
		return string.format("%d second%s ago", v377, v377 == 1 and "" or "s")
	end
	if v377 < 3600 then
		local v378 = v377 / 60
		local v379 = math.floor(v378)
		return string.format("%d minute%s ago", v379, v379 == 1 and "" or "s")
	end
	if v377 < 86400 then
		local v380 = v377 / 3600
		local v381 = math.floor(v380)
		return string.format("%d hour%s ago", v381, v381 == 1 and "" or "s")
	end
	if v377 >= 604800 then
		local v382 = os.date("*t", p376)
		return string.format("%04d-%02d-%02d %02d:%02d", v382.year, v382.month, v382.day, v382.hour, v382.min)
	end
	local v383 = v377 / 86400
	local v384 = math.floor(v383)
	return string.format("%d day%s ago", v384, v384 == 1 and "" or "s")
end
function v_u_1.get_adjacent(p385, p386, p387) -- name: get_adjacent
	local v388 = p387 or 0.1
	if p386 == nil then
		p386 = OverlapParams.new()
		p386.RespectCanCollide = true
		p386.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		p386.FilterDescendantsInstances = { p385 }
	end
	if p385:IsA("BasePart") then
		local v389 = p385.CFrame
		local v390 = p385.Size
		return game.Workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(v389, v390 + Vector3.new(1, 1, 1) * v388, p386)
	end
	if p385:IsA("Model") then
		local v391, v392 = p385:GetBoundingBox()
		return game.Workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(v391, v392 + Vector3.new(1, 1, 1) * v388, p386)
	end
	error("Not supported part type")
end
local v_u_393 = {}
local v_u_399 = {
	["add_item"] = function(p_u_394, p_u_395) -- name: add_item
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
		local v396 = p_u_394.items
		table.insert(v396, p_u_395)
		if p_u_394.destroy_time then
			v_u_1.debris(p_u_395, p_u_394.destroy_time)
		end
		p_u_395.Destroying:Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_394, (copy) p_u_395
			local v397 = table.find(p_u_394.items, p_u_395)
			if v397 then
				table.remove(p_u_394.items, v397)
			end
		end)
		while #p_u_394.items > p_u_394.max do
			local v398 = p_u_394.items[1]
			table.remove(p_u_394.items, 1)
			v398:Destroy()
		end
	end
}
function v_u_1.create_debris_queue(p_u_400, p401, p402) -- name: create_debris_queue

		p_u_400.Destroying:Connect(function()

end
function v_u_1.get_closest_tagged_instance(p405, p406) -- name: get_closest_tagged_instance

	local v408 = nil
	for _, v409 in v_u_1.get_tagged(p406) do
		local v410 = (v409:GetPivot().Position - p405).Magnitude
		if v410 >= v407 then

		end
		v408 = v409
		v407 = v410
	end

end

function v_u_1.create_cache_table(p_u_475, p_u_476) -- name: create_cache_table
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v482 = {
		["__index"] = function(p477, p478) -- name: __index
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_476
			if not p477.tab[p478] then
				return nil
			end

				p477.tab[p478].destroy()
			end

		end,
		["__newindex"] = function(p_u_479, p_u_480, p481) -- name: __newindex
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1, (copy) p_u_475
			if p481 == nil then
				if p_u_479.tab[p_u_480] then
					p_u_479.tab[p_u_480].destroy:cancel()

				p_u_479.tab[p_u_480] = nil

					["destroy"] = nil,
					["value"] = nil,
					["destroy"] = v_u_1.ov(function()
						-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_475, (copy) p_u_479, (copy) p_u_480
						task.wait(p_u_475)
						p_u_479.tab[p_u_480] = nil
					end)
				}
				p_u_479.tab[p_u_480].value = p481
				p_u_479.tab[p_u_480].destroy()
			end
		end
	}
	return setmetatable({
		["tab"] = {}
	}, v482)
end

function v_u_1.are_points_collinear(p593, p594) -- name: are_points_collinear
	if #p593 < 3 then
		return true
	end
	local v595 = (p593[2] - p593[1]).unit
	for v596 = 3, #p593 do
		local v597 = 1 - v595:Dot((p593[v596] - p593[1]).unit)
		if p594 >= math.abs(v597) then
			continue
		end
		return false
	end
	return true
end
function v_u_1.is_close(p598, p599, p600) -- name: is_close
	local v601 = p600 or 0.001
	if typeof(p598) ~= typeof(p599) then
		return false
	end
	if typeof(p598) == "number" then
		local v602 = p598 - p599
		return math.abs(v602) <= v601
	end
	if typeof(p598) == "Vector3" or typeof(p598) == "Vector2" then
		return (p598 - p599).Magnitude <= v601
	end
	if typeof(p598) == "CFrame" then
		local v603, v604, v605 = p598:ToOrientation()
		local v606, v607, v608 = p599:ToOrientation()
		local v609
		if (p598.Position - p599.Position).Magnitude <= v601 then
			local v610 = v603 - v606
			if math.abs(v610) <= v601 then
				local v611 = v604 - v607
				if math.abs(v611) <= v601 then
					local v612 = v605 - v608
					v609 = math.abs(v612) <= v601
				else
					v609 = false
				end
			else
				v609 = false
			end
		else
			v609 = false
		end
		return v609
	end
	error("Unsupported types: values must be numbers, vectors, or CFrames.")
end
function v_u_1.frame_dt(p613, p614) -- name: frame_dt
	return 1 - (1 - p613) ^ (p614 * 60)
end
function v_u_1.frame_lerp(p615, p616, p617, p618) -- name: frame_lerp
	local v619 = 1 - (1 - p617) ^ (p618 * 60)
	if typeof(p615) == "number" then
		return p615 + v619 * (p616 - p615)
	else
		return p615:Lerp(p616, v619)
	end
end
